info.description: Nuvectis Pharma, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on the development of innovative precision medicines for the treatment of serious conditions of unmet medical need in oncology. Its product pipeline includes NXP800 and NXP900. The company was founded by Ronald E. Bentsur, Enrique Poradosu, and Shay Shemesh on July 27, 2020 and is headquartered in Fort Lee, NJ.
info.description_zh: Nuvectis Pharma, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發創新精準藥物，用於治療腫瘤學中未滿足醫療需求的嚴重病症。其產品線包括NXP800和NXP900。該公司由 Ronald E. Bentsur、Enrique Poradosu 和 Shay Shemesh 於 2020 年 7 月 27 日創立，總部位於新澤西州李堡。

info.description: Apollomics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery and development of oncology therapies to address unmet medical needs. The company was founded by Liang Yu Guo and Sanjeev Redkar in May 2015 and is headquartered in Foster City, CA.
info.description_zh: Apollomics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於發現和開發腫瘤療法，以滿足未滿足的醫療需求。該公司由梁宇國和 Sanjeev Redkar 於 2015 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州福斯特城。

info.description: Fuel Tech, Inc. engages in the development, commercialization and application of proprietary technologies for air pollution control, process optimization, water treatment, and advanced engineering services. It operates through the following segments: Air Pollution Control, Fuel Chem Technologies, and Other. The Air Pollution Control Technology segment includes technologies to reduce nitrogen oxides emissions in flue gas from boilers, incinerators, furnaces, and other stationary combustion sources. The Fuel Chem Technology segment uses chemical processes in combination with computational fluid dynamics, and chemical kinetics modeling boiler modeling, for the control of slagging, fouling, corrosion, opacity, and other sulfur trioxide-related issues in furnaces, and boilers. The Other segment includes those profit and loss items not allocated to either reportable segment. The company was founded by Burr T. Walter in 1987 and is headquartered in Warrenville, IL.
info.description_zh: Fuel Tech, Inc. 從事空氣污染控制、製程優化、水處理和先進工程服務專有技術的開發、商業化和應用。它透過以下部門運作：空氣污染控制部門、燃料化學技術部門和其他部門。空氣污染控制技術部門包括減少鍋爐、焚化爐、熔爐和其他固定燃燒源煙氣中氮氧化物排放的技術。燃料化學技術部門將化學過程與計算流體動力學和化學動力學建模鍋爐建模相結合，用於控制熔爐和鍋爐中的結渣、結垢、腐蝕、不透明和其他與三氧化硫相關的問題。其他分部包括未分配至任一報告分部的損益項目。該公司由 Burr T. Walter 於 1987 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州沃倫維爾。

info.description: Arqit Quantum, Inc. engages in the provision of cybersecurity services via satellite and terrestrial forms. Its product is QuantumCloud which secures devices with cloud-based quantum encryption. The company was founded by David John Williams and David James Bestwick on April 26, 2021 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Arqit Quantum, Inc. 致力於透過衛星和地面形式提供網路安全服務。其產品是 QuantumCloud，它透過基於雲端的量子加密來保護設備。該公司由 David John Williams 和 David James Bestwick 於 2021 年 4 月 26 日創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Scilex Holding Co. engages in the acquisition, development, and commercialization of non-opioid pain management products for the treatment of acute and chronic pain. Its products include ZTLido, Elyxyb, and Gloperba. The company was founded on February 21, 2020 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: Scilex Holding Co. 從事用於治療急性和慢性疼痛的非鴉片類疼痛管理產品的收購、開發和商業化。其產品包括 ZTLido、Elyxyb 和 Gloperba。該公司成立於2020年2月21日，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: REGENXBIO, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development, commercialization, and licensing of recombinant adeno-associated virus gene therapy. Its product candidates include the NAV Technology Platform, which consists of exclusive rights to novel adeno-associated viral vectors, and therapeutic programs such as RGX-314, RGX-202, RGX-121, RGX-111, RGX-181, and RGX-381. The company was founded by Kenneth T. Mills and James M. Wilson on July 16, 2008 and is headquartered in Rockville, MD.
info.description_zh: REGENXBIO, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，從事重組腺相關病毒基因療法的開發、商業化和許可。其候選產品包括 NAV 技術平台，該平台擁有新型腺相關病毒載體的獨家權利，以及 RGX-314、RGX-202、RGX-121、RGX-111、RGX-181 和 RGX-381 等治療項目。該公司由 Kenneth T. Mills 和 James M. Wilson 於 2008 年 7 月 16 日創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州羅克維爾。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long GEV Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of GEV. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of GEV, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.

info.description: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the identification, acquisition, development, and commercialization of novel products for the treatment of genetic diseases. Its products include Crysvita, Mepsevii, Dojolvi, and Evkeeza. The company was founded by Emil D. Kakkis in April 2010 and is headquartered in Novato, CA.
info.description_zh: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，從事治療遺傳疾病的新產品的鑑定、收購、開發和商業化。其產品包括 Crysvita、Mepsevii、Dojolvi 和 Evkeeza。該公司由 Emil D. Kakkis 於 2010 年 4 月創立，總部位於加州諾瓦托。

info.description: Western Digital Corp. engages in the development, manufacture, marketing, and sale of data storage devices and solutions. The company was founded by Alvin B. Phillips in 1970 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: 西部數據公司從事數據儲存設備和解決方案的開發、製造、行銷和銷售。該公司由 Alvin B. Phillips 於 1970 年創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: The RealReal, Inc. is an online marketplace for consigned luxury goods, which engages in the consignment of luxury goods across multiple categories, including women's, men's, kids, jewelry, watches, home, and art. It sells pieces from designers such as Chanel, Christian Louboutin, Gucci, Hermes, Louis Vuitton, Prada, Celine, Jimmy Choo, Burberry, and Valentino. The company was founded by Julie Wainwright and Marcy Carmack on March 29, 2011 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: The RealReal, Inc. 是一家寄售奢侈品的線上市場，從事多個類別的奢侈品寄售，包括女裝、男裝、兒童、珠寶、手錶、家居和藝術品。它出售香奈兒 (Chanel)、克里斯提·魯布托 (Christian Louboutin)、古馳 (Gucci)、愛馬仕 (Hermes)、路易威登 (Louis Vuitton)、普拉達 (Prada)、賽琳 (Celine)、週仰傑 (Jimmy Choo)、巴寶莉 (Burberry) 和華倫天奴 (Valentino) 等設計師的作品。該公司由 Julie Wainwright 和 Marcy Carmack 於 2011 年 3 月 29 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Direxion Daily INTC Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of INTC. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of INTC and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to INTC, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily INTC Bull 2X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 INTC 每日業績的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 INTC 的證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 INTC 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與該基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long INTC Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Intel Corp. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long INTC Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果為英特爾公司普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long BE Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of BE. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of BE, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 BE 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 BE 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的 BE 價格每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Rocket Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of gene therapy treatment options for rare and devastating pediatric diseases. The firm's multi-platform development approach applies the lentiviral vector and adeno-associated viral vector gene therapy platforms. Its clinical program is an LVV-based gene therapy for the treatment of Fanconi Anemia (FA), a difficult to treat genetic disease that leads to bone marrow failure and potentially cancer. The company was founded on July 7, 1999 and is headquartered in Cranbury, NJ.
info.description_zh: Rocket Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於開發針對罕見和毀滅性兒科疾病的基因療法。該公司的多平台開發方法應用了慢病毒載體和腺相關病毒載體基因治療平台。其臨床計畫是基於 LVV 的基因療法，用於治療範可尼貧血 (FA)，這是一種難以治療的遺傳性疾病，會導致骨髓衰竭和潛在的癌症。該公司成立於1999年7月7日，總部位於新澤西州克蘭伯里。

info.description: AN2 Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a global health biopharmaceutical company. The firm focuses on modern biomedical and drug development to provide transformational medicines for patients suffering from infectious diseases. The company was founded by Eric Easom, George Harrison Talbot, Joseph S. Zakrzewski and Michael R.K. Alley in 2017 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.
info.description_zh: AN2 Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家全球健康生物製藥公司。該公司專注於現代生物醫學和藥物開發，為傳染病患者提供轉化藥物。該公司由 Eric Easom、George Harrison Talbot、Joseph S. Zakrzewski 和 Michael R.K. 創立。 Alley 於 2017 年成立，總部位於加州門洛帕克。

info.description: PepGen Inc. develops oligonucleotide therapies. It is a clinical-stage biotechnology company advancing the next generation of oligonucleotide therapeutics with the goal of transforming the treatment of severe neuromuscular and neurologic diseases. The company was founded on November 9, 2020 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: PepGen Inc. 開發寡核苷酸療法。它是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於推進下一代寡核苷酸療法，目標是改變嚴重神經肌肉和神經系統疾病的治療方法。該公司成立於2020年11月9日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: GE Vernova, Inc. engages in the electric power industry. It operates through the following segments: Power, Wind, and Electrification. The Power segment offers design, manufacture, and servicing gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies, providing a critical foundation of dispatchable, flexible, stable, and reliable power. The Wind segment manages wind generation technologies, including onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades. The Electrification segment refers to the grid solutions, power conversion, electrification software, and solar and storage solutions technologies required for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption. The company was founded November 9, 2021 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: GE Vernova, Inc. 從事電力業。它透過以下部門運作：電力、風能和電氣化。電力部門提供設計、製造和維修天然氣、核能、水力和蒸汽技術，為可調度、靈活、穩定和可靠的電力提供關鍵基礎。風能部門管理風力發電技術，包括陸上和離岸風力渦輪機和葉片。電氣化部分是指從發電點到用電點的電力傳輸、分配、轉換、儲存和編排所需的電網解決方案、電力轉換、電氣化軟體以及太陽能和儲存解決方案技術。該公司成立於 2021 年 11 月 9 日，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Seagate Technology Holdings Plc operates as holding company that is engaged in the development, production, and distribution of data storage products and electronic data storage solutions. Its products include hard disk drives, solid state hybrid drives, solid state drives, peripheral component interconnect express cards, serial advanced technology attachment controllers, storage subsystems and computing solutions. The firm offers its products under the Backup Plus and Expansion product lines, and Maxtor and LaCie brands. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Seagate Technology Holdings Plc 作為控股公司運營，從事資料儲存產品和電子資料儲存解決方案的開發、生產和分銷。其產品包括硬碟、固態混合​​驅動器、固態驅動器、週邊組件互連快速卡、串列先進技術附件控制器、儲存子系統和運算解決方案。該公司提供 Backup Plus 和 Expansion 產品線以及 Maxtor 和 LaCie 品牌的產品。該公司成立於 1978 年，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Hubbell, Inc. engages in the designing, manufacturing, and sale of electrical and electronic products for non-residential and residential construction, industrial, and utility applications. It operates through the Electrical Solutions and Utility Solutions segments. The Electrical Solutions segment manufactures and sells wiring and electrical, lighting fixtures, and controls for indoor and outdoor applications as well as specialty lighting and communications products. The Utility Solutions segment is involved in the design, manufacture, and sale of electrical distribution, transmission, substation, and telecommunications products. The company was founded by Harvey Hubbell II in 1888 and is headquartered in Shelton, CT.
info.description_zh: Hubbell, Inc. 從事非住宅和住宅建築、工業和公用事業應用的電氣和電子產品的設計、製造和銷售。它透過電氣解決方案和公用事業解決方案部門運作。電氣解決方案部門製造和銷售室內和室外應用的佈線和電氣、照明燈具和控制裝置以及特殊照明和通訊產品。公用事業解決方案部門從事配電、輸電、變電站和電信產品的設計、製造和銷售。該公司由 Harvey Hubbell II 於 1888 年創立，總部位於康乃狄克州謝爾頓。

info.description: Amylyx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biotechnology company focused on the discovery and development of therapies for diseases with significant unmet medical need, with an emphasis on endocrine and neurodegenerative disorders. Its program, avexitide, is a once-daily GLP-1 receptor antagonist being developed for the treatment of post-bariatric hypoglycemia. Amylyx's pipeline also includes investigational programs targeting Wolfram syndrome and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). The company was founded by Joshua Cohen and Justin Klee in 2013 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.

info.description_zh: Amylyx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家生物技术公司，专注于发现和开发针对医疗需求未得到满足的疾病的疗法，重点关注内分泌和神经退行性疾病。其產品 avexitide 是一種每日一次的 GLP-1 受體拮抗劑，正在開發用於治療減肥後低血糖。 Amylyx 的管道還包括針對 Wolfram 症候群和肌萎縮側索硬化症 (ALS) 的研究項目。該公司由 Joshua Cohen 和 Justin Klee 於 2013 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Micron Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of innovative memory and storage solutions. It operates through the following segments: Compute and Networking Business Unit (CNBU), Mobile Business Unit (MBU), Embedded Business Unit (EBU), and Storage Business Unit (SBU). The CNBU segment includes memory products and solutions sold into client, cloud server, enterprise, graphics, and networking markets. The MBU segment is involved in memory and storage products sold into smartphone and other mobile-device markets. The EBU segment focuses on memory and storage products sold into automotive, industrial, and consumer Markets. The SBU segment consists of SSDs and component-level solutions sold into enterprise and cloud, client, and consumer storage markets. The company was founded by Ward D. Parkinson, Joseph Leon Parkinson, Dennis Wilson, and Doug Pitman on October 5, 1978 and is headquartered in Boise, ID.
info.description_zh: Micron Technology, Inc. 致力於提供創新的記憶體和儲存解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：運算和網路業務部門（CNBU）、行動業務部門（MBU）、嵌入式業務部門（EBU）和儲存業務部門（SBU）。 CNBU 部門包括銷售給客戶端、雲端伺服器、企業、圖形和網路市場的記憶體產品和解決方案。 MBU 部門涉及銷往智慧型手機和其他行動裝置市場的記憶體和儲存產品。 EBU 部門專注於銷往汽車、工業和消費市場的記憶體和儲存產品。 SBU 部門包括企業和雲端、用戶端和消費者儲存市場銷售的 SSD 和組件級解決方案。該公司由 Ward D. Parkinson、Joseph Leon Parkinson、Dennis Wilson 和 Doug Pitman 於 1978 年 10 月 5 日創立，總部位於愛達荷州博伊西。

info.description: First Trust International Equity Opportunities ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the IPOX  International Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is a market-cap weighted portfolio measuring the performance of the top 50 companies domiciled outside the United States ranked quarterly by market capitalization in the IPOX  Global Composite Index and represents, on average, 25% of the total market capitalization of the base index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust International Equity Opportunities ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 IPOX International Index 的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數是一個市值加權投資組合，衡量美國境外註冊的前 50 名公司的業績，按季度在 IPOX 全球綜合指數中的市值排名，平均佔基礎指數總市值的 25%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Bicara Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company and develops biologics engineered to combine the precision of well validated, tumor-targeting antibodies with the power of tumor microenvironment modulators. The company's bi-functional antibodies are designed to deliver an immunomodulatory payload directly to the tumor microenvironment to ramp up immune cell activity, offering the potential for synergistic therapeutic impact at the site of the tumor. Its products include BCA101, a first-in-class EGFR/TGF-ß-trap bifunctional antibody in clinical development for multiple tumor types. The company was founded on December 12, 2018 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Bicara Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於開發生物製劑，將經過充分驗證的腫瘤靶向抗體的精度與腫瘤微環境調節劑的強大功能相結合。該公司的雙功能抗體旨在直接向腫瘤微環境提供免疫調節有效負載，以增強免疫細胞活性，從而為腫瘤部位提供協同治療影響的潛力。其產品包括 BCA101，這是一種針對多種腫瘤類型的一流 EGFR/TGF-ß-trap 雙功能抗體，處於臨床開發階段。該公司成立於2018年12月12日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Engine No. 1 Transform Climate ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to invest in companies that are creating value by transforming themselves and others to meet the growing demands of climate change. The Advisor intends to initially invest primarily in U.S. listed equity and American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") securities of companies relevant to its investment theme and over time may invest in non-U.S. listed securities as market and investment opportunities change. The fund's investments may include micro-, small-, medium- and large-capitalization companies. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 一號引擎轉型氣候 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。 The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to invest in companies that are creating value by transforming themselves and others to meet the growing demands of climate change. The Advisor intends to initi invest primari ins. securities of companies relevant to its investment theme and over time may invest in non-U.S. listed securities as market and investment opportunities change.該基金的投資可能包括微型、小型、中型和大型資本公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Kiniksa Pharmaceuticals International Plc is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company. It engages in discovering, acquiring, developing, and commercializing therapeutic medicines for patients suffering from debilitating diseases with significant unmet medical need. The company was founded on April 9, 2024 and is headquartered in London, United Kingdom.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Kiniksa Pharmaceuticals International Plc 是一家商業階段的生物製藥公司。它致力於發現、取得、開發和商業化治療藥物，幫助患有衰弱性疾病且醫療需求未滿足的患者。該公司成立於2024年4月9日，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Intel Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of computer products and technologies. It delivers computer, networking, data storage, and communications platforms. The firm operates through the following segments: Client Computing Group (CCG), Data Center and AI (DCAI), Intel Foundry Services (IFS), and All Other. The CCG segment consists of platforms designed for notebooks, 2-in-1 systems, desktops, tablets, phones, wireless and wired connectivity products, and mobile communication components. The DCAI segment delivers solutions to cloud service providers and enterprise customers, along with silicon devices for communications service providers and high-performance computing customers. The IFS segment refers to full stack solutions created from the foundry industry ecosystem. The All Other segment represents results from other non-reportable segments and corporate-related charges. The company was founded by Robert Norton Noyce and Gordon Earle Moore on July 18, 1968, and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: 英特爾公司從事電腦產品和技術的設計、製造和銷售。它提供電腦、網路、資料儲存和通訊平台。該公司透過以下部門運作：客戶端計算部門 (CCG)、資料中心和人工智慧 (DCAI)、英特爾代工服務 (IFS) 和所有其他部門。 CCG 部門包括專為筆記型電腦、二合一系統、桌上型電腦、平板電腦、手機、無線和有線連接產品以及行動通訊組件設計的平台。 DCAI部門為雲端服務供應商和企業客戶提供解決方案，並為通訊服務供應商和高效能運算客戶提供矽設備。 IFS 部分是指從代工產業生態系統創建的全端解決方案。所有其他部門代表其他非報告部門的績效和公司相關費用。該公司由羅伯特·諾頓·諾伊斯 (Robert Norton Noyce) 和戈登·厄爾·摩爾 (Gordon Earle Moore) 於 1968 年 7 月 18 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖克拉拉。

info.description: FreightCar America, Inc. engages in the manufacturing of railcars and railcar components. The firm offers freight cars including box cars, covered hoppers, open top hoppers, gondolas, intermodal, and non-intermodal flat cars that transport dry bulk and containerized freight products. It operates through the Manufacturing and Aftermarket segments. The Manufacturing segment includes new railcar manufacturing, used railcar sales, and railcar conversions and rebodies. The Aftermarket segment deals with the selling of forged, cast and fabricated railcar parts and supplies for all railcar types, and provides aftermarket services including safety training, railcar inspections, and preventative maintenance. The company was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: FreightCar America, Inc. 從事軌道車和軌道車零件的製造。該公司提供的貨運車輛包括棚車、有蓋料斗、開頂料斗、吊艙、聯運和非聯運平板車，用於運輸乾散貨和貨櫃貨運產品。它透過製造和售後市場部門運作。製造部門包括新軌道車製造、二手軌道車銷售以及軌道車改裝和改造。售後市場部門負責銷售所有類型軌道車的鍛造、鑄造和組裝式軌道車零件和用品，並提供包括安全培訓、軌道車檢查和預防性維護在內的售後服務。該公司成立於 1901 年，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long VST ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Vistra Corp. (NYSE: VST). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long VST ETF 尋求 Vistra Corp.（NYSE：VST）每日股價變動百分比兩倍（200%）的每日槓桿投資結果。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: American Airlines Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the operation of a network carrier through its principal wholly owned mainline operating subsidiary, American. The firm offers air transportation for passengers and cargo. It operates through the following geographical segments: Domestic, Latin America, Atlantic, and Pacific. The company was founded on December 9, 2013, and is headquartered in Fort Worth, TX.
info.description_zh: 美國航空集團公司是一家控股公司，透過其主要全資擁有的幹線運營子公司美國航空從事網路承運商的營運。該公司為乘客和貨物提供航空運輸。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：國內、拉丁美洲、大西洋和太平洋。該公司成立於2013年12月9日，總部位於德州沃思堡。

info.description: Qnity Electronics, Inc. engages in the manufacturing of electronic materials to the semiconductor and electronics industries. Its brands include Acuplane, Circuposit, Duroptix, EPIC, Ikonic, Kalrez, Kapton, Laird, Microfill, Pyralux, Riston, Solderon Tin, and Silveron Silver. Its products include printed circuit board materials, display materials, electrical insulation materials, electronic components, semiconductor fabrication and packaging materials, thermal management materials, general metal finishing, plating on plastics, silver nanowire technologies, and other related products. It operates through the Semiconductor Technologies and Interconnect Solutions segments. The Semiconductor Technologies segment provides a portfolio of innovative materials and solutions utilized across multiple stages of the semiconductor manufacturing process. The Interconnect Solutions segment offers solutions for advanced electronics hardware, including complex printed circuit boards and advanced semiconductor packaging. The company was founded on December 6, 2024 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Qnity Electronics, Inc. 從事半導體和電子行業電子材料的製造。其品牌包括 Acuplane、Circuposit、Duroptix、EPIC、Ikonic、Kalrez、Kapton、Laird、Microfill、Pyralux、Riston、Solderon Tin 和 Silveron Silver。其產品包括印刷電路板材料、顯示材料、電氣絕緣材料、電子元件、半導體製造和封裝材料、熱管理材料、一般金屬表面處理、塑膠電鍍、銀奈米線技術和其他相關產品。它透過半導體技術和互連解決方案部門運作。半導體技術部門提供在半導體製造過程的多個階段使用的創新材料和解決方案組合。互連解決方案部門為先進電子硬體提供解決方案，包括複雜的印刷電路板和先進的半導體封裝。該公司成立於2024年12月6日，總部位於德拉瓦州威爾明頓。

info.description: Portfolio Building Block European Banks Index ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the BITA European Banks Index (the "Index"). The fund uses a "passive management" approach to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index is constructed using a rules-based methodology that identifies companies in the banking industry with publicly traded ordinary shares listed on major stock exchanges in developed European markets, as classified by BITA GmbH. The index's initial universe consists of all publicly listed equity securities for which sufficient relevant information is available from public sources. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 投资组合构建模块欧洲银行指数 ETF 旨在跟踪 BITA 欧洲银行指数（“指数”）扣除费用和开支之前的表现。该基金采用“被动管理”方法来跟踪该指数未计费用和开支之前的表现。該指數採用基於規則的方法構建，該方法識別在已開發歐洲市場主要證券交易所上市的公開交易普通股的銀行業公司（按 BITA GmbH 的分類）。该指数的初始范围包括所有公开上市的股本证券，这些证券可从公共来源获得足够的相关信息。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Construction Partners, Inc. is a civil infrastructure company, which engages in the construction and maintenance of roadways and highways. The firm is also involved in the provision of products and services to both public and private infrastructure projects, with an emphasis on highways, roads, bridges, airports, and commercial and residential developments. The company was founded by Ned N. Fleming, III, R. Alan Palmer, and Charles E. Owens in 1999 and is headquartered in Dothan, AL.
info.description_zh: Construction Partners, Inc. 是一家民用基礎設施公司，從事道路和高速公路的建設和維護。該公司還為公共和私人基礎設施項目提供產品和服務，重點是高速公路、道路、橋樑、機場以及商業和住宅開發項目。該公司由 Ned N. Fleming, III、R. Alan Palmer 和 Charles E. Owens 於 1999 年創立，總部位於阿拉巴馬州多森。

info.description: Ocular Therapeutix, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapies for diseases and conditions of the eye. Its product pipeline includes Dextenza, OTX-TP, and OTX-TIC. The company was founded by Amarpreet S. Sawhney and Farhad Khosravi on September 12, 2006 and is headquartered in Bedford, MA.
info.description_zh: Oural Therapeutix, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於眼部疾病和病症療法的開發和商業化。其產品線包括Dextenza、OTX-TP和OTX-TIC。該公司由 Amarpreet S. Sawhney 和 Farhad Khosravi 於 2006 年 9 月 12 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州貝德福德。

info.description: Pulmatrix, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development and discovery of novel inhaled therapeutics products. The company was founded by David Alan Edwards, Mark J. Gabrielson, Alexander M. Klibanov, and Robert S. Langer, Jr. in April 2003 and is headquartered in Framingham, MA.
info.description_zh: Pulmatrix, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於新型吸入治療產品的開發和發現。該公司由 David Alan Edwards、Mark J. Gabrielson、Alexander M. Klibanov 和 Robert S. Langer, Jr. 於 2003 年 4 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州弗雷明漢。

info.description: NestYield Visionary ETF seeks long-term growth; the fund's secondary investment objective is to seek current income. The fund's strategy involves two components: (1) purchasing a portfolio of equity securities either directly, or "synthetically" by using options to gain exposure to one or more equity securities; and (2) generating income through an options portfolio. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: NestYield Visionary ETF尋求長期成長；該基金的次要投資目標是尋求當前收入。本基金的策略涉及兩個組成部分：(1) 直接購買股權證券投資組合，或透過使用選擇權「綜合」購買一種或多種股權證券； (2) 透過選擇權投資組合產生收入。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Astec Industries, Inc. engages in the design, engineering, manufacture, and marketing of equipment and components used in road building and construction activities. It operates through the following segments: Infrastructure Solutions, Material Solutions, and Corporate and Other. The Infrastructure Solutions segment designs, engineers, manufactures, and markets a complete line of asphalt plants, concrete plants, and ancillary equipment, as well as supplying asphalt road construction equipment, industrial thermal systems, and heavy equipment. The Material Solutions segment designs and manufactures heavy processing equipment, in addition to servicing and supplying parts for the aggregate, metallic mining, recycling, ports, and bulk handling industries. The Corporate and Other segment is involved in the controls and automation business through the firm's parent company, Astec Insurance. The company was founded by J. Don Brock on August 9, 1972 and is headquartered in Chattanooga, TN.
info.description_zh: Astec Industries, Inc. 從事道路建設和施工活動中使用的設備和零件的設計、工程、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：基礎設施解決方案部門、材料解決方案部門以及企業及其他部門。基礎設施解決方案部門設計、工程、製造和銷售全系列的瀝青廠、混凝土廠和輔助設備，並供應瀝青道路施工設備、工業熱系統和重型設備。材料解決方案部門設計和製造重型加工設備，此外還為骨材、金屬採礦、回收、港口和散裝裝卸產業提供零件服務和供應。企業及其他部門透過該公司的母公司 Astec Insurance 涉足控制和自動化業務。該公司由 J. Don Brock 於 1972 年 8 月 9 日創立，總部位於田納西州查塔努加。

info.description: Invesco DWA Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Technical Leaders Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of approximately 100 securities from an eligible universe of approximately 1,000 securities of the largest constituents by market capitalization within the NASDAQ US Benchmark Index.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Technical Leaders Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the 10% 只证券组成，这些证券来自纳斯达克美国基准指数中市值最大的成分股的约 1,000 只合格证券。

info.description: Xtrackers Semiconductor Select Equity ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Semiconductor ESG Screened Index. The fund, using a "passive" or indexing investment approach, seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the underlying index, which is comprised of companies that have business operations in the semiconductor industry and that fulfill certain sustainability criteria. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers Semiconductor Select Equity ETF 尋求與 Solactive Semiconductor ESG 篩選指數的績效（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金採用「被動」或指數投資方法，尋求與相關指數（未計費用和開支）的表現大致相對應的投資結果，該指數由在半導體行業開展業務並滿足某些可持續性標準的公司組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Energy Storage & Materials ETF seeks to track the investment results of STOXX Global Energy Storage and Materials Index. The index measures the performance of equity securities of companies involved in energy storage solutions aiming to support the transition to a low carbon economy, including hydrogen, fuel cells, and batteries as determined by STOXX Ltd. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 儲能和材料 ETF 旨在追蹤 STOXX 全球儲能和材料指數的投資結果。該指數衡量參與能源儲存解決方案的公司的股本證券的表現，這些解決方案旨在支持向低碳經濟轉型，包括由 STOXX Ltd 確定的氫、燃料電池和電池。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其基礎指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ARS Focused Opportunities Strategy ETF seeks to achieve long-term growth of capital and generate current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"), sub-advised by ARS Investment Partners, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser"). The fund invests either directly in the equity securities of companies the Sub-Adviser deems to be high-quality, defined by strong balance sheets, reasonable earnings growth, and above-average dividend yields with the prospect for dividend growth, or indirectly through one or more underlying ETFs, that have exposure to the same companies. The fund manager intends to invest across a variety of sectors. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ARS 聚焦機會策略 ETF 尋求實現資本的長期成長並產生當前收入。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），由 ARS Investment Partners, LLC（「副顧問」）提供次級顧問服務。該基金直接投資於副顧問認為高品質的公司的股本證券，這些公司的資產負債表強勁、盈利增長合理、股息收益率高於平均水平且有股息增長的前景，或者通過一隻或多只投資於同一公司的基礎 ETF 間接投資。基金經理人打算投資多個產業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Smith & Wesson Brands, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the manufacture, design, and provision of firearms. Its portfolio includes handguns, long guns, handcuffs, suppressor, and other firearm-related products. The firm's brands are Smith & Wesson, M&P, Thompson/Center Arms, and Gemtech. The company was founded by Horace Smith and Daniel Baird Wesson in 1852 and is headquartered in Maryville, TN.
info.description_zh: Smith & Wesson Brands, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事槍支的製造、設計和供應。其產品組合包括手槍、長槍、手銬、消音器和其他槍支相關產品。該公司的品牌包括 Smith & Wesson、M&P、Thompson/Center Arms 和 Gemtech。該公司由 Horace Smith 和 Daniel Baird Wesson 於 1852 年創立，總部位於田納西州瑪麗維爾。

info.description: Vistra Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of electricity and power generation. It operates through the following segments: Retail, Texas, East, West, and Asset Closure. The Retail segment includes sale of electricity and natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The Texas and East segments are involved in electricity generation, wholesale energy sales and purchases, commodity risk management activities, fuel production and fuel logistics management. The West segment represents the company's electricity generation operations in CAISO. The Asset Closure segment refers to the decommissioning and reclamation of retired plants and mines. The company was founded in 1882 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 獨立電力生產商
info.description_zh: Vistra Corp.是一家控股公司，從事提供電力和發電業務。該公司透過以下部門營運：零售部門、德州部門、東部部門、西部部門和資產關閉部門。零售部門包括向住宅、商業和工業客戶銷售電力和天然氣。德州和東部部門從事發電、批發能源銷售和採購、商品風險管理活動、燃料生產和燃料物流管理。西部部門代表該公司在 CAISO 的發電業務。資產關閉部分是指退役工廠和礦山的退役和復墾。該公司成立於 1882 年，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

info.description: Tema Electrification ETF seeks to provide long-term growth of capital. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets, which include borrowings for investment purposes, common and preferred stocks of publicly listed companies that are directly or indirectly economically tied to global electrification. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tema Electrification ETF 致力於提供長期的資本成長。在正常情況下，該基金尋求透過投資至少80%的淨資產來實現其投資目標，其中包括用於投資目的的借款、與全球電氣化經濟直接或間接相關的上市公司的普通股和優先股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR S&P Emerging Markets ex-China ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the S&P Emerging ex-China BMI. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities comprising the index. The index is a float-adjusted market capitalization weighted index designed to define and measure the investable universe of publicly traded companies domiciled in emerging markets, excluding China. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR 標普新興市場（中國除外）ETF 尋求提供在扣除費用和支出之前大致與標普新興市場（中國除外）BMI 相對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於構成指數的證券。該指數是一個浮動調整市值加權指數，旨在定義和衡量新興市場（不包括中國）上市公司的可投資範圍。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco PHLX Semiconductor ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the PHLX Semiconductor Sector Index . The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, Nasdaq compiles the underlying index, which is a modified market-capitalization weighted index designed to measure the performance of the 30 largest companies listed in the United States that are engaged in the semiconductor business, as determined by the index Provider. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco PHLX Semiconductor ETF 旨在追蹤 PHLX 半導體產業指數的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。納斯達克嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制基礎指數，該指數是經過修改的市值加權指數，旨在衡量美國最大的 30 家從事半導體業務的上市公司的業績，由指數提供商確定。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF  is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the underlying security while managing potential downside through a specific volatility-linked framework.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤 CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV) 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌選擇權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎證券的敞口，同時透過特定的波動性相關框架管理潛在的下行風險。

info.description: The Goldman Sachs India Equity ETF (the "Fund") seeks long-term capital appreciation. The Fund invests, at least 80% of its net assets in a portfolio of equity investments in issuers economically tied to India. Equity investments include common stocks, preferred stocks, American depositary receipts ("ADRs") and global depositary receipts ("GDRs") of all market capitalizations. Equity investments include securities that trade on local Indian exchanges and securities denominated in Rupee ("INR"), the official currency of India. The Fund may use derivatives, including options, futures, and forward contracts, both to seek to increase the return of the Fund and to hedge (or protect) the value of its assets against adverse movements in currency exchange rates, interest rates and movements in the securities markets. The Fund may invest in the aggregate up to 20% of its Net Assets in equity and fixed income securities that are not economically tied to India. The Fund may also invest up to 15% of its Net Assets in initial public offerings ("IPOs"). The Fund may invest in real estate investment trusts ("REITs").
info.description_zh: 高盛印度股票ETF（「基金」）尋求長期資本增值。該基金至少 80% 的淨資產投資於與印度經濟相關的發行人的股權投資組合。股權投資包括普通股、優先股、所有市值的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。股權投資包括在印度當地交易所交易的證券以及以印度官方貨幣盧比（「INR」）計價的證券。本基金可能使用衍生性商品，包括選擇權、期貨和遠期合約，以尋求增加本基金的回報並對沖（或保護）其資產價值免受貨幣匯率、利率和證券市場變動的不利變動的影響。該基金最多可將其淨資產的 20% 投資於與印度經濟無關的股票和固定收益證券。該基金還可將其淨資產最多 15% 投資於首次公開募股（「IPO」）。本基金可投資於房地產投資信託（「REIT」）。

info.description: First Trust Large Cap Growth AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Large Cap Growth Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select growth stocks from the NASDAQ US 500 Large Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Large Cap Growth AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX Large Cap Growth Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在從納斯達克美國 500 大盤指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇成長型股票，透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，相對於傳統指數，這些股票可能會產生正的 alpha 或風險調整回報。

info.description: AMETEK, Inc. engages in the manufacture of electronic instruments and electromechanical devices. It operates through the following segments: Electronic Instruments (EIG), Electromechanical (EMG), and Corporate. The EIG segment focuses on the design and manufacture of analytical, test, and measurement instruments for the process, aerospace, medical, research, power, and industrial markets. The EMG segment is involved in the design and manufacture of medical components and devices, automation solutions, thermal management systems, specialty metals, and electrical interconnects. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Berwyn, PA.
info.description_zh: AMETEK, Inc. 從事電子儀器和機電設備的製造。它透過以下部門運作：電子儀器部門 (EIG)、機電部門 (EMG) 和企業部門。 EIG 部門專注於為製程、航空航太、醫療、研究、電力和工業市場設計和製造分析、測試和測量儀器。 EMG 部門涉及醫療組件和設備、自動化解決方案、熱管理系統、特殊金屬和電氣互連的設計和製造。該公司成立於 1930 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州伯文。

info.description: Xtrackers Nifty 500 India ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Nifty 500 Index. The underlying index measures the equity performance of the top 500 companies traded on the NSE based on full market capitalization that meet certain eligibility requirements. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in component securities of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers Nifty 500 India ETF 尋求與 Nifty 500 指數未計費用和開支的表現大致相符的投資結果。基礎指數根據滿足特定資格要求的總市值衡量 NSE 交易的前 500 家公司的股票表現。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於相關指數的組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Trane Technologies Plc engages in providing solutions to buildings, homes, and transportation. It operates through the following business segments: Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific. The Americas segment encompasses commercial heating and cooling systems, building controls, and energy services and solutions, residential heating and cooling, and transport refrigeration systems, and solutions in North America and Latin America regions. The EMEA segment includes heating and cooling systems, services and solutions for commercial buildings, and transport refrigeration systems and solutions in Europe, Middle East, and Africa regions. The Asia Pacific segment is involved in heating and cooling systems, services and solutions for commercial buildings and transport refrigeration systems and solutions in Asia Pacific region. The company was founded in 1871 and is headquartered in Swords, Ireland.
info.description_zh: 特靈科技有限公司致力於為建築、住宅和交通提供解決方案。它透過以下業務部門運作：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲和亞太地區。美洲部門包括商業供暖和製冷系統、樓宇控制、能源服務和解決方案、住宅供暖和製冷、運輸冷卻系統以及北美和拉丁美洲地區的解決方案。歐洲、中東和非洲地區包括商業建築的暖氣和冷氣系統、服務和解決方案，以及歐洲、中東和非洲地區的運輸冷卻系統和解決方案。亞太地區業務涉及亞太地區商業建築的供暖和製冷系統、服務和解決方案以及運輸冷卻系統和解決方案。該公司成立於 1871 年，總部位於愛爾蘭索茲。

info.description: Ferrovial NV provides infrastructure construction and transportation services. It offers all kinds of services related to urban and interurban transport infrastructure, either by land, sea or air. The company was founded by Rafael del Pino y Moreno on December 18, 1952 and is headquartered Amsterdam, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: Ferrovial NV 提供基礎建設和運輸服務。它提供與城市和城際交通基礎設施相關的各種陸路、海上或空中服務。該公司由 Rafael del Pino y Moreno 於 1952 年 12 月 18 日創立，總部位於荷蘭阿姆斯特丹。

info.description: Lazard Next Gen Technologies ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the portfolio invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity and equity-related securities (namely, common and preferred stock, American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"), Global Depositary Receipts, warrants, rights and participatory notes) of or related to Next Gen Technologies Companies located throughout the world. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Lazard Next Gen Technologies ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，投資組合將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於位於世界各地的下一代技術公司或與其相關的股票和股票相關證券（即普通股和優先股、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）、全球存託憑證、認股權證、權利和參與票據）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WisdomTree Japan Hedged SmallCap Equity Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the WisdomTree Japan Hedged SmallCap Equity Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in component securities of the index and investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of such component securities. The index is a dividend weighted index designed to provide exposure to Japanese equity markets while at the same time neutralizing exposure to fluctuations of the value of the Japanese yen relative to the U.S. dollar. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 日本對沖小型股股票基金旨在追蹤 WisdomTree 日本對沖小型股股票指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於指數的組成證券以及具有與此類組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是股息加權指數，旨在提供對日本股市的曝險，同時抵消日圓相對美元價值波動的曝險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Celldex Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the business of development, manufacturing and commercialization of novel therapeutics for human health care. Its drug candidates have the ability to engage the human immune system and directly inhibit tumors to treat specific types of cancer and other diseases. Its pipeline includes Varlilumab, CDX-1140, and CDX-301, and CDX-3379. The company was founded by Anthony S. Marucci and Tibor Keler in 1983 and is headquartered in Hampton, NJ.
info.description_zh: Celldex Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the business of development, manufacturing and commercialization of novel therapeutics for human health care. Its drug candidates have the ability to engage the human immune system and directly in speccess have the ability to engage the human immune system and directly in species soo diseases.其管道包括 Varlilumab、CDX-1140、CDX-301 和 CDX-3379。该公司由 Anthony S. Marucci 和 Tibor Keler 于 1983 年创立，总部位于新泽西州汉普顿。

info.description: Ingersoll Rand Inc. engages in the provision of services and solutions through air, fluid, energy, and medical technologies. It operates through the Industrial Technologies and Services, and Precision and Science Technologies segments. The Industrial Technologies and Services segment provides compressor, vacuum, blower solutions, and industrial technologies such as power tools and lifting equipment. The Precision and Science Technologies segment includes fluid management solutions such as precision liquid and gas pumps, and niche compression technologies. The company was founded in 1872 and is headquartered in Davidson, NC.
info.description_zh: Ingersoll Rand Inc. 致力於透過空氣、流體、能源和醫療技術提供服務和解決方案。它透過工業技術和服務以及精密和科學技術部門運作。工業技術和服務部門提供壓縮機、真空、鼓風機解決方案以及電動工具和起重設備等工業技術。精密和科學技術部門包括流體管理解決方案，例如精密液體和氣體泵以及利基壓縮技術。該公司成立於 1872 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州戴維森。

info.description: MeiraGTx Holdings Plc is a clinical-stage genetic medicines company with a broad pipeline of late-stage clinical programs, including Parkinson's disease, radiation-induced xerostomia and AIPL1-associated retinal dystrophy. It targets local delivery of small doses of genetic medicines to treat both inherited and more common conditions with severe unmet needs. The company was founded on March 20, 2015 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: MeiraGTx Holdings Plc 是一家臨床階段的基因藥物公司，擁有廣泛的後期臨床項目，包括帕金森氏症、輻射引起的口乾症和 AIPL1 相關的視網膜營養不良。它的目標是在當地提供小劑量的基因藥物，以治療嚴重未滿足需求的遺傳性疾病和更常見的疾病。該公司成立於2015年3月20日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Pacer ActiveAlpha India Quality ETF is a concentrated equity strategy providing targeted exposure to Indian companies, specifically designed to capture the structural growth of the Indian economy through a rigorous, rules-based selection process. The fund employs a proprietary factor-based methodology that identifies and holds a limited portfolio of approximately 20 to 30 companies deemed to be of high quality, while simultaneously applying screens for value and momentum to optimize the risk-return profile.
info.description_zh: Pacer ActiveAlpha India Quality ETF 是一項集中式股票策略，為印度公司提供有針對性的投資，專門旨在透過嚴格的、基於規則的選擇流程來捕捉印度經濟的結構性成長。該基金採用專有的基於因素的方法，識別並持有約 20 至 30 家被視為高品質公司的有限投資組合，同時應用價值和動量篩選以優化風險回報狀況。

info.description: VanEck Semiconductor ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS US Listed Semiconductor 25 Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The index includes common stocks and depositary receipts of U.S. exchange-listed companies in the semiconductor industry. Such companies may include medium-capitalization companies and foreign companies that are listed on a U.S. exchange. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Semiconductor ETF 尋求盡可能接近複製未計費用和支出之前的 MVIS 美國上市半導體 25 指數的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。該指數包括美國交易所上市的半導體產業公司的普通股和存託憑證。此類公司可能包括中等資本公司和在美國交易所上市的外國公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The Travelers Cos., Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and personal property and casualty insurance products and services. It operates through the following business segments: Business Insurance, Bond and Specialty Insurance, and Personal Insurance. The Business Insurance segment offers an array of property and casualty insurance, and insurance related services to its customers primarily in the U.S., as well as in Canada, the United Kingdom, the Republic of Ireland and throughout other parts of the world as a corporate member of Lloyd's. The Bond and Specialty Insurance segment includes surety, fidelity, management of liability, professional liability, and other property and casualty coverage and related risk management services. The Personal Insurance segment is involved in a range of property and casualty insurance products and services covering individuals' personal risks, primarily in the U.S. and Canada. The company was founded in 1853 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: The Travelers Cos., Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供商業和個人財產及傷亡保險產品和服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：商業保險、債券和專業保險以及個人保險。商業保險部門作為勞合社的企業會員，主要向美國、加拿大、英國、愛爾蘭共和國和世界其他地區的客戶提供一系列財產和傷亡保險以及保險相關服務。債券和專業保險部門包括擔保、保真度、責任管理、專業責任以及其他財產和傷亡保險以及相關風險管理服務。個人保險部門提供一系列涵蓋個人風險的財產和傷亡保險產品和服務，主要在美國和加拿大。該公司成立於 1853 年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index. The initial Index universe is typically derived from the component companies of the Nasdaq-100 Index. The initial universe of companies is typically screened based on their average projected free cash flows and earnings (if available) over each of the next two fiscal years. Under normal circumstances, the fund will seek to invest at least 80% of the fund's total assets in growth securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤 Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index 扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。最初的指數範圍通常源自於納斯達克 100 指數的成分公司。公司的初始範圍通常是根據未來兩個財政年度的平均預期自由現金流和收益（如果有）進行篩選的。一般情況下，基金會尋求將基金總資產的至少80%投資於成長型證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares India 50 ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Nifty 50 IndexTM composed of 50 of the largest Indian equities. The underlying index measures the equity performance of the top 50 companies by free float market capitalization whose equity securities trade in the Indian securities markets. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares India 50 ETF 旨在追蹤由 50 隻最大的印度股票組成的 Nifty 50 IndexTM 的投資結果。該指數衡量在印度證券市場進行股票交易的自由流通市值排名前 50 名的公司的股票表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Intelligent Livermore ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund uses Intelligent Alpha, LLC's proprietary artificial intelligence-powered stock selection strategy to create an intelligent equal weight portfolio of global large cap stocks with over $1 billion in market capitalization. The securities selected will be based on the major trading trends inspired by the greatest traders in the world. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 智能利弗莫爾 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金採用Intelligent Alpha, LLC專有的人工智慧選股策略，創造出市值超過10億美元的全球大盤股的智慧等權重投資組合。所選的證券將基於受世界上最偉大的交易者啟發的主要交易趨勢。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Bel Fuse, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of products that power, protect, and connect electronic circuits. It operates through the following segments: Power Solutions & Protection, Connectivity Solutions, and Magnetic Solutions. The Power Solutions & Protection segment includes internal and external AC/DC power supplies, DC/DC converters and DC/AC inverters utilized in defense, commercial aerospace, industrial, networking and consumer applications. The Connectivity Solutions segment focuses on high speed and harsh environment copper and optical fiber connectors and integrated assemblies, providing connectivity solutions within the commercial aerospace, military communications, defense, network infrastructure, structured building cabling, and several industrial applications. The Magnetic Solutions segment is involved in integrating RJ45 connectors with discrete magnetic components to provide better performance and a more robust device, substantially reducing board space and optimizing performance. The company was founded by Elliot Bernstein in 1949 and is headquartered in West Orange, NJ.
info.description_zh: Bel Fuse, Inc. 從事為電子電路供電、保護和連接的產品的設計、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：電源解決方案和保護、連接解決方案和磁性解決方案。電源解決方案和保護部門包括用於國防、商業航空航太、工業、網路和消費應用的內部和外部交流/直流電源、直流/直流轉換器和直流/交流逆變器。連接解決方案部門專注於高速和惡劣環境銅和光纖連接器和整合組件，為商業航空航太、軍事通訊、國防、網路基礎設施、結構化建築佈線和多種工業應用提供連接解決方案。磁性解決方案部門致力於將 RJ45 連接器與分離磁性組件集成，以提供更好的性能和更穩健的設備，從而大幅減少電路板空間並優化性能。該公司由 Elliot Bernstein 於 1949 年創立，總部位於新澤西州西奧蘭治。

info.description: Structure Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical stage global biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing novel oral therapeutics to treat a wide range of chronic diseases with unmet medical needs. Its pipeline includes Aleniglipron GSBR-1290, ACCG-2671, GIPR, GCGR, ANPA-0073, and LTSE-2578. The company was founded by Raymond C. Stevens in 2016 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Structure Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的全球生物製藥公司，致力於開發新型口服療法，以治療各種醫療需求未滿足的慢性疾病。 Its pipeline includes Aleniglipron GSBR-1290, ACCG-2671, GIPR, GCGR, ANPA-0073, and LTSE-2578. The company was founded by Raymond C. Stevens in 2016 and is Francis Sanquart in CA.

info.description: EyePoint, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapeutics that treat eye disorders. It offers FDA-approved sustained-release treatments in ophthalmology under the DEXYCU, ILUVIEN, Verisome, Retisert, and Durasert brands. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Watertown, MA.
info.description_zh: EyePoint, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於治療眼部疾病的療法的開發和商業化。它以 DEXYCU、ILUVIEN、Verisome、Retisert 和 Durasert 品牌提供經 FDA 批准的眼科緩釋治療藥物。該公司成立於 1987 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃特敦。

info.description: Illinois Tool Works, Inc. engages in the manufacture of industrial products and equipment. It operates through the following segments: Automotive OEM, Food Equipment, Test and Measurement and Electronics, Welding, Polymers and Fluids, Construction Products, and Specialty Products. The Automotive OEM segment produces components and fasteners for automotive-related applications. The Food Equipment segment supplies commercial food equipment and provides related services. The Test and Measurement and Electronics segment focuses on manufacturing equipment, consumables, and related software for testing and measuring of materials, structures, gases, and fluids. The Welding segment is involved in the arc of welding equipment, consumables, and accessories for a wide array of industrial and commercial applications. The Polymers and Fluids segment provides adhesives, sealants, lubrication and cutting fluids, janitorial and hygiene products, and fluids and polymers for auto aftermarket maintenance and appearance. The Construction Products segment refers to the construction of fastening systems and solutions. The Specialty Products segment represents the manufacturing of beverage packaging equipment and consumables, product coding and marking equipment and consumables, and appliance components and fasteners. The company was founded by Byron L. Smith in 1912 and is headquartered in Glenview, IL.
info.description_zh: 伊利諾工具廠有限公司從事工業產品和設備的製造。它透過以下部門運作：汽車 OEM、食品設備、測試和測量及電子、焊接、聚合物和流體、建築產品和特殊產品。汽車 OEM 部門為汽車相關應用生產零件和緊固件。食品設備部門供應商業食品設備並提供相關服務。測試和測量及電子部門專注於製造設備、消耗品以及用於測試和測量材料、結構、氣體和流體的相關軟體。焊接部門涉及廣泛的工業和商業應用的焊接設備、耗材和配件的電弧。聚合物和流體部門提供黏合劑、密封劑、潤滑和切削液、清潔和衛生產品以及用於汽車售後維護和外觀的流體和聚合物。建築產品部門是指緊固系統和解決方案的建造。特種產品部門代表飲料包裝設備和消耗品、產品編碼和標記設備和消耗品以及器具零件和緊固件的製造。該公司由 Byron L. Smith 於 1912 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州格倫維尤。

info.description: Natera, Inc. is a diagnostics company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of genetic testing services. It provides Panorama non-invasive prenatal test (NIPT), Vistara, horizon carrier screening (HCS), spectrum pre-implantation genetic screening and spectrum pre-implantation genetic diagnosis, Anora products of conception (POC) and non-invasive paternity testing (PAT). The company was founded by Matthew Rabinowitz and Jonathan Sheena in November 2003 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Natera, Inc. 是一家診斷公司，致力於基因檢測服務的發現、開發和商業化。它提供Panorama非侵入性產前檢測（NIPT）、Vistara、地平線帶因者篩檢（HCS）、頻譜植入前基因篩檢和頻譜植入前遺傳診斷、Anora受孕產品（POC）和非侵入性親子鑑定（PAT）。該公司由 Matthew Rabinowitz 和 Jonathan Sheena 於 2003 年 11 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Cummins, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and distribution of diesel, natural gas, electric and hybrid powertrains and powertrain-related components including filtration, aftertreatment, turbochargers, fuel systems, valvetrain technologies, controls systems, air handling systems, automated transmissions, axles, drivelines, brakes, suspension systems, electric power generation systems, batteries, electrified power systems, hydrogen production technologies, and fuel cell products. It operates through the following segments: Engine, Distribution, Components, Power Systems, and Accelera. The Engine segment manufactures and markets diesel and natural gas-powered engines under the Cummins brand name, for the heavy- and medium-duty truck, bus, recreational vehicle, light-duty automotive, construction, mining, marine, rail, oil and gas, defense, and agricultural markets. The Distribution segment includes power generation systems, high-horsepower engines, heavy-duty and medium-duty engines designed for on- and off-highway use, application engineering services, custom-designed assemblies, retail and wholesale aftermarket parts, and in-shop and field-based repair service. The Components segment supplies products including axles, drivelines, brakes and suspension systems for commercial diesel and natural gas applications, aftertreatment systems, turbochargers, fuel systems, valvetrain technologies, filtration products, automated transmissions, and electronics. The Power Systems segment engages in power generation, industrial, and generator technologies. The Accelera segment designs, manufactures, sells, and supports hydrogen production technologies, as well as electrified power systems, including battery, fuel cell, and electric powertrain technologies. The company was founded by Clessie Lyle Cummins and William Glanton Irwin on February 3, 1919 and is headquartered in Columbus, IN.
info.description_zh: 康明斯公司從事柴油、天然氣、電動和混合動力系統以及動力系統相關組件的設計、製造和分銷，包括過濾、後處​​理、渦輪增壓器、燃油系統、氣門系統技術、控制系統、空氣處理系統、自動變速箱、車軸、傳動系統、制動器、懸吊系統、發電系統、電池、電氣化電力系統、制氫技術和燃料電池產品。它透過以下部門運作：引擎部門、分銷部門、零件部門、電力系統部門和 Accelera 部門。發動機部門以康明斯品牌製造和銷售柴油和天然氣動力發動機，適用於重型和中型卡車、巴士、休閒車、輕型汽車、建築、採礦、船舶、鐵路、石油和天然氣、國防和農業市場。分銷部門包括發電系統、大馬力發動機、專為公路和非公路使用而設計的重型和中型發動機、應用工程服務、定制設計組件、零售和批發售後零件以及店內和現場維修服務。零件部門提供的產品包括用於商業柴油和天然氣應用的車軸、傳動系統、煞車和懸吊系統、後處理系統、渦輪增壓器、燃油系統、氣門機構技術、過濾產品、自動變速箱和電子產品。電力系統部門從事發電、工業和發電機技術。 Accelera 部門設計、製造、銷售和支援氫氣生產技術以及電氣化電力系統，包括電池、燃料電池和電動動力總成技術。該公司由 Clessie Lyle Cummins 和 William Glanton Irwin 於 1919 年 2 月 3 日創立，總部位於印第安納州哥倫布。

info.description: Man Active Emerging Markets Alternative ETF seeks to provide capital growth over the medium to long term. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity and equity-related securities of emerging market issuers. Equity and equity-related securities include exchange-traded and over-the-counter common and preferred stocks, warrants, options, rights, convertible securities, sponsored and unsponsored depositary receipts, trust certificates, partnership interests and shares of other investment companies (including other exchange-traded funds ("ETFs")). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Man Active Emerging Markets Alternative ETF 尋求在中長期內提供資本增長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於新興市場發行人的股票和股票相關證券。股票和股票相關證券包括交易所交易和場外交易的普通股和優先股、認股權證、選擇權、權利、可轉換證券、保薦和非保薦存託憑證、信託證書、合夥權益以及其他投資公司的股份（包括其他交易所交易基金（「ETF」））。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vistance Networks, Inc. engages in the provision of infrastructure solutions for communication, data center, and entertainment networks. It operates through the following segments: Connectivity and Cable Solutions (CCS), Networking, Intelligent Cellular and Security Solutions (NICS), Access Network Solutions (ANS), and Corporate and Other. The CCS segment focuses on fiber optic, copper connectivity, and cable solutions for use in telecommunications, cable television, residential broadband networks, data centers, and business enterprises. The NICS segment provides wireless networks for enterprises and service providers. The ANS segment refers to the cable modem termination systems, video infrastructure, distribution and transmission equipment, and cloud solutions that enable facility-based service providers to construct a residential and metro distribution network. The company was founded by Frank M. Drendel in 1976 and is headquartered in Richardson, TX.
info.description_zh: Vistance Networks, Inc. 致力於為通訊、資料中心和娛樂網路提供基礎設施解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：連接和電纜解決方案（CCS）、網路、智慧蜂窩和安全解決方案（NICS）、接取網路解決方案（ANS）以及企業和其他。 CCS 部門專注於用於電信、有線電視、住宅寬頻網路、資料中心和商業企業的光纖、銅連接和電纜解決方案。 NICS 部門為企業和服務供應商提供無線網路。 ANS 部門是指電纜數據機終端系統、視訊基礎設施、分配和傳輸設備以及雲端解決方案，使基於設施的服務供應商能夠建立住宅和城域分配網路。該公司由 Frank M. Drendel 於 1976 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州理查森。

info.description: Axogen, Inc. engages in the development and marketing of surgical solutions for peripheral nerve regeneration and repair. It provides products and educational resources to improve surgical treatment algorithms for peripheral nerve damage or discontinuity. Its products include Avance Nerve Graft, Axoguard Nerve Connector, Axoguard Nerve Protector, Avive Soft Tissue Membrane, AcroVal Neurosensory and Motor Testing System, and AxoTouch Two-Point Discriminator. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Alachua, FL.

info.description: Lazard Japanese Equity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the portfolio invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equities and equity-related securities (i.e., shares, including common and preferred stock, warrants and rights) traded on markets in Japan. The investment manager seeks to invest in the equity and equity-related securities of companies operating in sectors which have been identified through research undertaken by the Investment Manager as showing greater potential for growth at any given point of the economic cycle. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Lazard 日本股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，投資組合將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於在日本市場交易的股票和股票相關證券（即股票，包括普通股和優先股、認股權證和權利）。投資經理尋求投資於投資經理進行的研究已確定在經濟週期的任何給定點顯示出更大增長潛力的行業中運營的公司的股權和股權相關證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VictoryShares Free Cash Flow Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Victory Free Cash Flow Growth Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index. VettaFi LLC constructs the index in accordance with a rules-based methodology that screens for positive free cash flow and selects 100 growth companies with the highest score within the VettaFi US Equity Large/Mid-Cap 1000 Index (the "Parent Index").
info.description_zh: VictoryShares 自由現金流成長 ETF 力求提供在費用和支出之前與 Victory 自由現金流成長指數的表現密切對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金尋求透過將至少80%的資產投資於指數證券來實現其投資目標。 VettaFi LLC 根據基於規則的方法建立該指數，該方法篩選正的自由現金流，並選擇 VettaFi 美國股票大/中型股 1000 指數（「母指數」）中得分最高的 100 家成長型公司。

info.description: iShares MSCI All Country Asia ex Japan ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI AC Asia ex Japan Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization index designed to measure equity market performance of securities from the following 10 developed and emerging market countries or regions: China, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan and Thailand.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI All Country Asia（日本除外）ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI AC Asia（日本除外）指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券以及具有與該指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通市值指數，旨在衡量以下 10 個已開發和新興市場國家或地區證券的股票市場表現：中國、香港、印度、印尼、馬來西亞、菲律賓、新加坡、韓國、台灣和泰國。

info.description: Finward Bancorp is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It offers checking and savings accounts, loans, eBanking, cash management, investments, retirement plans, and trust funds. The company was founded on January 31, 1994 and is headquartered in Munster, IN.
info.description_zh: Finward Bancorp 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供金融服務。它提供支票和儲蓄帳戶、貸款、電子銀行、現金管理、投資、退休計劃和信託基金。該公司成立於1994年1月31日，總部位於印第安納州蒙斯特。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST MU ETF is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks Micron Technology, Inc. (MU). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the performance of the underlying leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST MU ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤美光科技 (MU) 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌期權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 績效的曝險，但須遵守潛在投資收益的上限。

info.description: Bel Fuse, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of products that power, protect, and connect electronic circuits. It operates through the following segments: Power Solutions & Protection, Connectivity Solutions, and Magnetic Solutions. The Power Solutions & Protection segment includes internal and external AC/DC power supplies, DC/DC converters and DC/AC inverters utilized in defense, commercial aerospace, industrial, networking and consumer applications. The Connectivity Solutions segment focuses on high speed and harsh environment copper and optical fiber connectors and integrated assemblies, providing connectivity solutions within the commercial aerospace, military communications, defense, network infrastructure, structured building cabling, and several industrial applications. The Magnetic Solutions segment is involved in integrating RJ45 connectors with discrete magnetic components to provide better performance and a more robust device, substantially reducing board space and optimizing performance. The company was founded by Elliot Bernstein in 1949 and is headquartered in West Orange, NJ.
info.description_zh: Bel Fuse, Inc. 從事為電子電路供電、保護和連接的產品的設計、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：電源解決方案和保護、連接解決方案和磁性解決方案。電源解決方案和保護部門包括用於國防、商業航空航太、工業、網路和消費應用的內部和外部交流/直流電源、直流/直流轉換器和直流/交流逆變器。連接解決方案部門專注於高速和惡劣環境銅和光纖連接器和整合組件，為商業航空航太、軍事通訊、國防、網路基礎設施、結構化建築佈線和多種工業應用提供連接解決方案。磁性解決方案部門致力於將 RJ45 連接器與分離磁性組件集成，以提供更好的性能和更穩健的設備，從而大幅減少電路板空間並優化性能。該公司由 Elliot Bernstein 於 1949 年創立，總部位於新澤西州西奧蘭治。

info.description: iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ex China ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets ex China Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index that captures large- and mid-capitalization stocks across 23 of the 24 Emerging Markets countries, excluding China.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 新興市場（中國除外）ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場（中國除外）指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，涵蓋 24 個新興市場國家中 23 個國家（不包括中國）的大中型股票。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HOOD ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Robinhood Markets, Inc.'s common stock by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. A downside protection may be implemented which could affect the net income level. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HOOD ETF 旨在通过出售杠杆交易所交易基金的期权来实现 2 倍 (200%) 出售 Robinhood Markets, Inc. 普通股期权所产生的收入，该基金旨在实现基础股票每日表现的 2 倍，并获得基础杠杆 ETF 表现的敞口，但须遵守潜在投资收益的上限。可能会实施下行保护，这可能会影响净利润水平。该基金将至少80%的净资产投资于以标的杠杆ETF作为参考资产的衍生品合约。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Telix Pharmaceuticals Limited. engages in the development and commercialization of several clinical-stage oncology assets. It operates through the following segments: Commercial, Product Development, and Group and Unallocated. The Commercial segment includes sales of Illuccix and other products subsequent to obtaining regulatory approvals. The Product Development segment develops radiopharmaceutical products for commercialization. It focuses on cancer care, specifically in prostate, renal or kidney and glioblastoma or brain cancer. Its products include TLX250, TLX591, and TLX101. The company was founded by Andreas Kluge and Christian P. Behrenbruch in November 2015 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
info.description_zh: 泰利克斯製藥有限公司。從事多種臨床階段腫瘤資產的開發和商業化。它透過以下部門運作：商業部門、產品開發部門以及集團和未分配部門。商業部門包括 Illuccix 和獲得監管部門批准後的其他產品的銷售。產品開發部門開發用於商業化的放射性藥物產品。它專注於癌症治療，特別是前列腺癌、腎癌或腎癌以及膠質母細胞瘤或腦癌。其產品包括TLX250、TLX591和TLX101。該公司由 Andreas Kluge 和 Christian P. Behrenbruch 於 2015 年 11 月創立，總部位於澳洲墨爾本。

info.description: ishares Paris-Aligned Climate MSCI World Ex USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of MSCI World ex USA Climate Paris Aligned Benchmark Extended Select Index. The index is composed of large- and mid-cap developed market equities, excluding the U.S., that are selected and weighted so that, in the aggregate, the portfolio is compatible with the objectives of the Paris Agreement by following a decarbonization trajectory, reducing exposure to climate-related transition and physical risks and increasing exposure to companies favorably positioned for the transition to a low-carbon economy. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of its index.
info.description_zh: isshares 巴黎調整氣候 MSCI 世界（美國除外）ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 世界（美國除外）氣候巴黎調整基準擴展精選指數的投資結果。該指數由大中型已開發市場股票（不包括美國）組成，其選擇和加權的目的是使該投資組合總體上符合《巴黎協定》的目標，遵循脫碳軌跡，減少與氣候相關的轉型和實體風險的敞口，並增加對向低碳經濟轉型處於有利地位的公司的敞口。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於其指數的成分證券。

info.description: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM All Cap World ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation with capital preservation as a secondary objective. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that is primarily a "fund of funds." The Advisor seeks to achieve it's investment objective by investing in ETFs that invest primarily in domestic and foreign equity securities of any capitalization, including in emerging markets. The fund invests in fixed income ETFs with a short or ultra-short duration, money market funds, cash and cash equivalents ("Defensive Investments"). It may invest in affiliated and unaffiliated ETFs.
info.description_zh: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM All Cap World ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值，並將資本保值作為次要目標。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要是「基金中的基金」。該顧問尋求透過投資 ETF 來實現其投資目標，這些 ETF 主要投資於任何資本的國內外股票證券，包括新興市場。本基金投資於短期或超短期固定收益ETF、貨幣市場基金、現金及現金等價物（「防禦性投資」）。它可以投資關聯和非關聯的 ETF。

info.description: JPMorgan ActiveBuilders Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities and equity-related instruments that are tied economically to emerging markets. The equity securities and equity-related instruments in which it may invest include, but are not limited to, common stock, participation notes or other structured notes, and other instruments that provide economic exposure to one or more equity securities. The fund may also use exchanged-traded futures for the efficient management of cash flows.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通 ActiveBuilders 新興市場股票 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金至少80%的資產投資於與新興市場經濟相關的股本證券和股票相關工具。其可能投資的股本證券及股本相關工具包括但不限於普通股、參與票據或其他結構性票據，以及提供一種或多種股本證券經濟風險的其他工具。該基金還可以使用交易所交易的期貨來有效管理現金流。

info.description: Intellia Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of curative therapeutics using the CRISPR/Cas9 system. Its CRISPR/Cas9 system transforms medicine by both producing therapeutics that permanently edit and/or correct disease-associated genes in the human body with a single treatment course and creates engineered cells that can treat oncological and immunological diseases. The company was founded by Andrew May, Luciano Marraffini, Rodolphe Barrangou, Nessan Bermingham, Rachel Haurwitz, Erik Sontheimer, Jennifer Doudna and Derrick Rossi in May 2014 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.

info.description: First Trust Large Cap Core AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Large Cap Core Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ US 500 Large Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Large Cap Core AlphaDEX Fund 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 Nasdaq AlphaDEX Large Cap Core Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克美國 500 大盤指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EAFE ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI EAFE Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of large- and mid-capitalization developed market equities, excluding the U.S. and Canada that have positive environmental, social and governance characteristics as identified by the index provider while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the parent index.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EAFE ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI EAFE 擴展 ESG 焦點指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。基礎指數由大中型已開發市場股票組成，不包括美國和加拿大，這些股票具有指數提供者確定的積極的環境、社會和治理特徵，同時表現出與母指數相似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: SEI DBi Multi-Strategy Alternative ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will take long and short positions in investments that provide broad exposure to the global equity, fixed income and currency markets. The fund will invest primarily in exchange-traded derivative instruments, including futures, options, and swaps, but to a lesser extent may invest in derivative instruments that are traded over-the-counter, such as forwards.
info.description_zh: SEI DBi 多策略另類 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將在提供全球股票、固定收益和貨幣市場廣泛敞口的投資中持有多頭和空頭部位。該基金將主要投資於交易所交易的衍生工具，包括期貨、選擇權和掉期，但也會在較小程度上投資於場外交易的衍生性工具，例如遠期合約。

info.description: JPMorgan Nasdaq Equity Premium Income ETF seeks current income while maintaining prospects for capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve this objective by (1) creating an actively managed portfolio of equity securities comprised significantly of those included in the fund's primary benchmark, the Nasdaq-100 Index (the Benchmark), and (2) through equity-linked notes (ELNs), selling call options with exposure to the Benchmark. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通納斯達克股票溢價收入 ETF 尋求當前收入，同時維持資本增值前景。該基金力求透過以下方式實現這一目標：(1) 創建一個積極管理的股本證券投資組合，其中主要包括基金主要基準納斯達克 100 指數（基準）中包含的證券，以及 (2) 透過股票掛鉤票據 (ELN) 出售與基準敞口相關的看漲期權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: PeakShares RMR Prime Equity ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation and income generation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that may engage in active and frequent trading. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, including any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities that include common stocks of companies and equity ETFs providing exposure to such companies, and have economic characteristics similar to such securities.
info.description_zh: PeakShares RMR Prime 股票 ETF 旨在提供資本增值和創收。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），可以進行活躍且頻繁的交易。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（包括任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於股本證券，其中包括公司的普通股和向此類公司提供敞口的股本ETF，並且具有與此類證券類似的經濟特徵。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long Abnb Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of ABNB. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of ABNB, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 杠杆股票 2 倍多头 ANB 每日 ETF 寻求每日杠杆投资结果（未计费用和开支）为 ABNB 价格每日百分比变化的两倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。该基金将至少 80% 的净资产（加上用于投资目的的借款）投资于具有经济特征的金融工具，这些金融工具组合起来可提供 200% 的 ABNB 价格每日杠杆敞口，这与基金的投资目标一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SGI Dynamic Tactical ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed ETF and invests in securities of affiliated and unaffiliated ETFs and open-end mutual funds. The fund may allocate among major equity asset classes and sectors, within the underlying funds, of the U.S., foreign and emerging markets equity of any capitalization.
info.description_zh: SGI 動態戰術 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。該基金是主動式管理 ETF，投資於附屬和非附屬 ETF 以及開放式共同基金的證券。該基金可以在基礎基金內的美國、外國和新興市場任何資本的股票的主要股票資產類別和部門之間進行配置。

info.description: Aquestive Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the identifying, developing, and commercializing differentiated products to address unmet medical needs and to solve patients' therapeutic problems. Its product pipeline include Libervant, AQST-108, AQST-305, Suboxone and Zuplenz. The company was founded in January 2004 and is headquartered in Warren, NJ.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Aquestive Therapeutics, Inc. 致力於識別、開發和商業化差異化產品，以滿足未滿足的醫療需求並解決患者的治療問題。其產品線包括 Libervant、AQST-108、AQST-305、Suboxone 和 Zuplenz。該公司成立於 2004 年 1 月，總部位於新澤西州沃倫。

info.description: McGrath RentCorp engages in the provision of business-to-business rental services. It operates through the following segments: Mobile Modular, Portable Storage, TRS-RenTelco, and Enviroplex. The Mobile Modular segment focuses on modular building and portable storage.
