The Portable Storage segment includes rental inventory consisting of steel containers used to provide a temporary storage solution that is delivered to the customer's location and addresses the need for secure, temporary storage with immediate access to the unit. The TRS-RenTelco segment includes operations for its electronic test equipment. The Enviroplex segment is involved in the classroom manufacturing business selling modular buildings used primarily as classrooms in California. The company was founded by Robert P. McGrath in 1979 and is headquartered in Livermore, CA.
info.description_zh: McGrath RentCorp 從事提供企業對企業租賃服務。它透過以下部門運作：行動模組化、便攜式儲存、TRS-RenTelco 和 Enviroplex。行動模組化部門專注於模組化建築和便攜式儲存。便攜式儲存部門包括由鋼製貨櫃組成的租賃庫存，用於提供臨時儲存解決方案，該解決方案可交付到客戶所在地，並滿足安全、臨時儲存和立即存取設備的需求。 TRS-RenTelco 部門包括其電子測試設備業務。 Enviroplex 部門從事教室製造業務，銷售主要用作加州教室的模組化建築。該公司由 Robert P. McGrath 於 1979 年創立，總部位於加州利弗莫爾。

info.description: Russell Inv Emerging Markets Equity Active ETF seeks to provide long term capital growth. The fund has a non-fundamental policy to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes in equity securities economically tied to emerging markets countries. The fund principally invests in equity securities, including common stock and preferred stock, of emerging markets companies, and in depositary receipts representing shares in such companies.
info.description_zh: Russell Inv Emerging Markets Equity Active ETF 致力於提供長期資本成長。該基金的非基本政策是，在正常情況下，將其淨資產價值的至少80%加上用於投資目的的借款投資於與新興市場國家經濟相關的股本證券。該基金主要投資於新興市場公司的股本證券，包括普通股和優先股，以及代表此類公司股份的存託憑證。

info.description: Astoria US Quality Kings ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in common stock principally traded in the U.S. The fund seeks to invest in companies that exhibit robust quality characteristics across sectors, with attractive valuations and dividend paying potential, as determined by the fund's sub-adviser.
info.description_zh: Astoria US Quality Kings ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在正常情況下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於主要在美國交易的普通股來實現其投資目標。該基金尋求投資於由基金副顧問確定的跨行業表現出穩健品質特徵、具有有吸引力的估值和股息支付潛力的公司。

info.description: Defiance Large Cap ex-Mag 7 ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the BITA US 500 ex-Magnificent 7 Index. The index aims to provide a comprehensive and balanced representation of the U.S. equity market by including the largest 500 publicly traded equity securities, while specifically excluding the seven largest technology companies commonly referred to as the "Magnificent 7". Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, will be invested in equity securities of large-cap companies.
info.description_zh: Defiance Large Cap ex-Mag 7 ETF 旨在追蹤 BITA US 500 ex-Magnificent 7 指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該指數旨在透過納入最大的 500 家公開交易股票證券，同時明確排除通常被稱為「七大巨頭」的七家最大科技公司，從而全面、平衡地代表美國股市。一般情況下，基金淨資產的至少80%，加上投資用途的借款，將投資於大型公司的股本證券。

info.description: Janus Henderson Global Artificial Intelligence ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund pursues its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of companies that portfolio management believes will contribute to or benefit from artificial intelligence technologies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Janus Henderson Global Artificial Intelligence ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資組合管理認為將有助於人工智慧技術或受益於人工智慧技術的公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. engages in the development, publishing, and marketing of interactive software games. Its products are designed for console systems, handheld gaming systems, and personal computers, including smart phones and tablets, and are delivered through physical retail, digital download, online platforms, and cloud streaming services. The company was founded by Ryan A. Brant in 1993 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. 從事互動軟體遊戲的開發、發行和行銷。其產品專為遊戲機系統、手持遊戲系統和個人電腦（包括智慧型手機和平板電腦）而設計，並透過實體零售、數位下載、線上平台和雲端串流服務提供。該公司由 Ryan A. Brant 於 1993 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: First Trust International Developed Cap Strength ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield of an index called The International Developed Capital Strength Index SM. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 90% of its net assets in the common stocks and REITs that comprise the index. The index seeks to provide exposure to well-capitalized companies in the developed markets outside of the U.S. with strong market positions that have the potential to provide their stockholders with a greater degree of stability and performance over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust International Developed Cap Strength ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為「國際開發資本強度指數 SM」的指數的價格和收益率相對應。該基金尋求透過在正常市場條件下將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的普通股和房地產投資信託基金來實現其投資目標。該指數旨在為美國以外已開發市場中資本充足、市場地位穩固的公司提供投資機會，這些公司有可能隨著時間的推移為其股東提供更大程度的穩定性和績效。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Wahed Dow Jones Islamic World ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to invests in equity securities of global companies (excluding U.S. domiciled companies) the characteristics of which meet the requirements of Shariah and are consistent with Islamic principles as interpreted by subject-matter experts (each, a "Shariah Compliant Company"). The adviser seeks to invest the fund's assets in securities similar to the components of, and to achieve returns similar to those of, the Dow Jones Islamic Market International Titans 100 Index (the "Index"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Wahed Dow Jones Islam World ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在投資於全球公司（不包括美國註冊公司）的股本證券，這些公司的特徵符合伊斯蘭教法的要求，並符合主題專家所解釋的伊斯蘭原則（每個公司都是「符合伊斯蘭教法的公司」）。該顧問尋求將基金資產投資於與道瓊伊斯蘭市場國際泰坦 100 指數（「指數」）成分類似的證券，並獲得與道瓊伊斯蘭市場國際泰坦 100 指數（「指數」）類似的回報。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Texas Instruments Incorporated engages in the design and manufacture of semiconductors. It operates through the following segments: Analog, Embedded Processing, and Other. The Analog segment semiconductors change real-world signals, such as sound, temperature, pressure or images, by conditioning them, amplifying them and often converting them to a stream of digital data that can be processed by other semiconductors, such as embedded processors. The Embedded Processing segment involves handling specific tasks and can be optimized for various combinations of performance, power, and cost, depending on the application. The Other segment includes DLP products, calculators, and custom application-specific integrated circuits products. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: 德州儀器公司從事半導體的設計和製造。它透過以下部分運作：模擬、嵌入式處理和其他。類比部分半導體透過調節、放大並通常將它們轉換為可由其他半導體（例如嵌入式處理器）處理的數位資料流來改變現實世界的訊號，例如聲音、溫度、壓力或影像。嵌入式處理部分涉及處理特定任務，並且可以根據應用程式針對效能、功耗和成本的各種組合進行最佳化。其他部分包括 DLP 產品、計算器和客製化專用積體電路產品。該公司成立於 1930 年，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: Digital Realty Trust, Inc. operates as a real estate investment trust, which engages in the provision of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions. It serves the following industries: artificial intelligence (AI), networks, cloud, digital media, mobile, financial services, healthcare, and gaming. The company was founded on March 9, 2004, and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Digital Realty Trust, Inc. 作為房地產投資信託公司經營，從事提供資料中心、託管和互連解決方案。它服務於以下行業：人工智慧（AI）、網路、雲端、數位媒體、行動、金融服務、醫療保健和遊戲。該公司成立於2004年3月9日，總部位於德州達拉斯。

info.description: Equinix, Inc. is a digital infrastructure company, which engages in the provision of a platform that interconnects the foundational infrastructure. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia-Pacific. It offers digital services, data center services, interconnection services, and support services. The company was founded by Jay Steven Adelson and Albert M. Avery, IV on June 22, 1998 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Equinix, Inc. 是一家數位基礎設施公司，致力於提供互連基礎設施的平台。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東、非洲和亞太地區。它提供數位服務、資料中心服務、互連服務和支援服務。該公司由 Jay Steven Adelson 和 Albert M. Avery, IV 於 1998 年 6 月 22 日創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。

info.description: Comfort Systems USA, Inc. engages in the provision of mechanical and electrical contracting services. It operates through the Mechanical and Electrical Services segments. The Mechanical Services segment includes heating, ventilation, air conditioning, plumbing, piping, and controls, as well as off-site construction, monitoring, and fire protection. The Electrical services segment focuses on installation and servicing electrical systems. The company was founded by Alfred J. Giardinelli, Jr. And William George III on December 12, 1996 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Comfort Systems USA, Inc. 從事提供機械和電氣承包服務。它透過機械和電氣服務部門運作。機械服務部門包括暖氣、通風、空調、管道、管道和控制，以及場外施工、監控和消防。電氣服務部門專注於電氣系統的安裝和維修。該公司由 Alfred J. Giardinelli, Jr. 和 William George III 於 1996 年 12 月 12 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Generac Holdings, Inc. engages in the business of designing and manufacturing energy technology solutions. It operates under the Domestic and International segments. The Domestic segment includes the legacy Generac business and the acquisitions that are based in the United States and Canada. The International segment focuses on Generac business' Latin American export operations. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Waukesha, WI.
info.description_zh: Generac Holdings, Inc. 從事設計和製造能源技術解決方案的業務。它在國內和國際部門下運作。國內業務包括傳統的 Generac 業務以及位於美國和加拿大的收購。國際部門專注於 Generac 業務的拉丁美洲出口業務。該公司成立於 1959 年，總部位於威斯康辛州沃科夏。

info.description: Keysight Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of electronic design and test solutions that are used in the design, development, manufacture, installation, deployment, validation, optimization, and secure operation of electronics systems to communications, networking, and electronics industries. It operates through the Communications Solutions Group (CSG) and Electronic Industrial Solutions Group (EISG) segments. The CSG segment serves customers spanning the global commercial communications and aerospace, defense, and government end markets. The EISG segment offers test and measurement solutions across electronic industrial end markets, focusing on applications in the automotive, and energy industry and measurement solutions for semiconductor design and manufacturing, consumer electronics, education, and general electronics manufacturing. The company was founded by William R. Hewlett and David Packard in 1937 and is headquartered in Santa Rosa, CA.
info.description_zh: 是德科技公司致力於提供電子設計和測試解決方案，這些解決方案用於通訊、網路和電子行業電子系統的設計、開發、製造、安裝、部署、驗證、最佳化和安全操作。它透過通訊解決方案集團（CSG）和電子工業解決方案集團（EISG）部門運作。 CSG 部門為全球商業通訊、航空航太、國防和政府終端市場的客戶提供服務。 EISG 部門提供跨電子工業終端市場的測試和測量解決方案，重點關注汽車和能源產業的應用以及半導體設計和製造、消費性電子、教育和通用電子製造的測量解決方案。該公司由 William R. Hewlett 和 David Packard 於 1937 年創立，總部位於加州聖羅莎。

info.description: Progressive Corp. is an insurance holding company, which engages in the provision of personal and commercial auto insurance, residential property insurance, and other specialty property-casualty insurance and related services. It operates through the following segments: Personal Lines, Commercial Lines, and Property. The Personal Lines segment includes agency and direct businesses. The Commercial Lines segment writes primary liability and physical damage insurance for automobiles and trucks owned and operated predominately by small business in the auto, for-hire transportation, contractor, for-hire specialty, tow, and for-hire livery markets. The Property segment covers residential property insurance for homeowners, other property owners, and renters. The company was founded on March 10, 1937, and is headquartered in Mayfield Village, OH.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: Progressive Corp.是一家保險控股公司，從事提供個人和商業汽車保險、住宅財產保險以及其他專業財產傷亡保險及相關服務。它透過以下部門運作：個人業務、商業業務和財產業務。個人線路部門包括代理和直接業務。商業保險部門為主要由汽車、出租運輸、承包商、專業出租、拖車和出租制服市場中的小型企業擁有和經營的汽車和卡車承保主要責任和人身損害保險。財產保險部門為房主、其他財產所有人和租戶提供住宅財產保險。該公司成立於 1937 年 3 月 10 日，總部位於俄亥俄州梅菲爾德村。

info.description: Synchrony Financial engages in the provision of consumer financial services. It focuses on digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoor, pet, and other industries. The company was founded on September 12, 2003 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: Synchrony Financial 從事提供消費金融服務。專注於數位、健康與保健、零售、電信、家居、汽車、戶外、寵物等產業。該公司成立於2003年9月12日，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: Vertiv Holdings Co. engages in the design, manufacture, and service of critical digital infrastructure technology for data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial environments. The firm also offers power management products, switchgear and busbar products, thermal management products, integrated rack systems, modular solutions, and management systems for monitoring and controlling digital infrastructure. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Asia Pacific, and Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). The Americas segment includes products and services sold for applications within the data center, communication networks and commercial and industrial markets in North America and Latin America. The Asia Pacific segment consists of products and services sold for applications within the data center, communication networks and commercial and industrial markets throughout Greater China, Asia, and India. The EMEA segment focuses on products and services sold for applications within the data center, communication networks, and commercial and industrial markets in Europe, Middle East, and Africa. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Westerville, OH.
info.description_zh: Vertiv Holdings Co. 從事資料中心、通訊網路以及商業和工業環境的關鍵數位基礎設施技術的設計、製造和服務。該公司還提供電源管理產品、開關設備和母線產品、熱管理產品、整合式機架系統、模組化解決方案以及用於監視和控制數位基礎設施的管理系統。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、亞太地區以及歐洲、中東和非洲 (EMEA)。美洲部門包括為北美和拉丁美洲的資料中心、通訊網路以及商業和工業市場內的應用程式銷售的產品和服務。亞太地區業務包括為大中華區、亞洲和印度的資料中心、通訊網路以及商業和工業市場內的應用程式銷售的產品和服務。 EMEA 部門專注於為歐洲、中東和非洲的資料中心、通訊網路以及商業和工業市場內的應用程式銷售的產品和服務。該公司成立於 1946 年，總部位於俄亥俄州韋斯特維爾。

info.description: iShares Asia 50 ETF seeks to track the investment results of the S&P Asia 50TM composed of 50 of the largest Asian equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Asia 50 ETF 旨在追蹤由 50 隻最大的亞洲股票組成的 S&P Asia 50TM 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance AI & Power Infrastructure ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the MarketVector US Listed AI and Power Infrastructure Index. The index is a thematic index tracking the performance of U.S. exchange-listed companies contributing to critical electrical grid, artificial intelligence ("AI") and data infrastructure through decentralized energy technologies, electrical utilities and related components and construction, data center operations, and AI-related computing hardware. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets will be invested in securities of AI & Power Infrastructure Companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance AI 和電力基礎設施 ETF 旨在追蹤 MarketVector 美國上市的 AI 和電力基礎設施指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該指數是主題指數，追蹤美國交易所上市公司透過去中心化能源技術、電力公用事業及相關組件和建設、資料中心營運以及人工智慧相關運算硬體為關鍵電網、人工智慧（「AI」）和資料基礎設施做出貢獻的業績。一般情況下，基金淨資產的至少80%將投資於人工智慧和電力基礎設施公司的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Ardelyx, Inc. is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of innovative medicines that meet significant unmet medical needs. Its products include IBSRELA and XPHOZAH. The company was founded by Dominique Charmot, Peter G. Schultz, and Jean M. Frechet in October 2007 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Ardelyx, Inc. 是一家商業階段的生物製藥公司，專注於創新藥物的開發和商業化，以滿足重大未滿足的醫療需求。其產品包括IBSRELA和XPHOZAH。該公司由 Dominique Charmot、Peter G. Schultz 和 Jean M. Frechet 於 2007 年 10 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Avalo Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in the treatment of immune dysregulation by developing therapies that target the LIGHT-signaling network. It also focuses on reducing LIGHT levels which can moderate immune dysregulation in many acute and chronic inflammatory disorders. The company was founded by Blake M. Paterson, Isaac Blech, Barbara S. Slusher, and Solomon H. Snyder on January 31, 2011 and is headquartered in Wayne, PA.
info.description_zh: Avalo Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，透過開發針對光訊號網路的療法來治療免疫失調。它還專注於降低光水平，從而緩解許多急性和慢性發炎性疾病中的免疫失調。該公司由 Blake M. Paterson、Isaac Blech、Barbara S. Slusher 和 Solomon H. Snyder 於 2011 年 1 月 31 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州韋恩。

info.description: ProShares Ultra Nasdaq Biotechnology seeks daily investment results that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective. The index is a modified capitalization weighted index that includes securities of Nasdaq listed companies that are classified as either biotechnology or pharmaceutical. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Ultra Nasdaq Biotechnology 尋求相當於納斯達克生物技術指數每日表現兩倍 (2x) 的每日投資結果。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與基金投資目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數是修改後的資本加權指數，包括納斯達克上市公司的證券，這些公司被分類為生物技術或製藥。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Webull Corp. engages in the provision of financial services. It offers trading, wealth management product distribution, market data and information, user community, and investor education. The company was founded by An Quan Wang in 2016 and is headquartered in St. Petersburg, FL.
info.description_zh: Webull Corp. 從事提供金融服務。 It offers trading, wealth management product distribution, market data and information, user community, and investor education.该公司由王安泉于2016年创立，总部位于佛罗里达州圣彼得堡。

info.description: Baldwin Insurance Group, Inc. engages in the provision of insurance services. It operates through the following segments: Insurance Advisory Solutions, Underwriting, Capacity & Technology Solutions, and Mainstreet Insurance Solutions. The Insurance Advisory Solutions segment provides private risk management, commercial risk management, and employee benefits solutions for mid-to-large size businesses and high net worth individuals and families. The Underwriting, Capacity & Technology Solutions segment represents a wholesale co-brokerage platform that delivers specialty insurers, professionals, individuals, and niche industry businesses expanded access to exclusive specialty markets, capabilities, and programs requiring complex underwriting and placement. The Mainstreet segment offers personal insurance, commercial insurance, and life and health solutions to individuals and businesses in their communities. The Medicare segment provides consultation for government assistance programs and solutions, including traditional Medicare and Medicare Advantage, to seniors and Medicare-eligible individuals through a network of agents. The company was founded by Elizabeth H. Krystyn, Laura R. Sherman, and Lowry L. Baldwin in 2011 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.description_zh: Baldwin Insurance Group, Inc. 從事提供保險服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：保險諮詢解決方案部門、承保部門、容量與技術解決方案部門以及 Mainstreet 保險解決方案部門。保險諮詢解決方案部門為大中型企業和高淨值個人和家庭提供私人風險管理、商業風險管理和員工福利解決方案。承保、容量和技術解決方案部門代表了一個批發聯合經紀平台，為專業保險公司、專業人士、個人和利基行業企業提供了進入獨家專業市場、能力和需要複雜承保和安置的專案的機會。 Mainstreet 部門為社區中的個人和企業提供個人保險、商業保險以及人壽和健康解決方案。醫療保險部門透過代理網絡向老年人和符合醫療保險資格的個人提供政府援助計劃和解決方案的諮詢，包括傳統醫療保險和醫療保險優勢。該公司由 Elizabeth H. Krystyn、Laura R. Sherman 和 Lowry L. Baldwin 於 2011 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: First Trust S-Network Future Vehicles & Technology ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the S-Network Electric & Future Vehicle Ecosystem Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. To be eligible for inclusion in the index, a company must be listed on a major recognized stock exchange and engaged in one of the following sectors: electric and autonomous vehicle manufacturing; enabling technologies or enabling materials. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust S-Network 未來車輛和技術 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 S-Network 電動和未來車輛生態系統指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。為了有資格納入該指數，公司必須在主要認可的證券交易所上市，並從事以下行業之一：電動和自動駕駛汽車製造；使能技術或使能材料。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cullinan Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the developing of oncology and immuno-oncology therapies. Its pipeline includes CLN-978, CLN-619, Zipalertinib CLN-081/TAS6417, CLN-049, and CLN-617. The company was founded by Patrick A. Baeuerle on September 15, 2016 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Cullinan Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，從事腫瘤學和免疫腫瘤學療法的開發。其管路包括CLN-978、CLN-619、Zipalertinib CLN-081/TAS6417、CLN-049和CLN-617。該公司由 Patrick A. Baeuerle 於 2016 年 9 月 15 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: CG Oncology, Inc. is a clinical biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of bladder-sparing therapeutic patients afflicted with bladder cancer. It offers cretostimogene, a product initially in clinical development for the treatment of patients with Non-Muscle Invasive Bladder Cancer (NMIBC). The company was founded by Alex Yeung and Paul A. DeRidder on September 24, 2010 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: CG Oncology, Inc.是一家臨床生物製藥公司，致力於膀胱癌患者膀胱保留治療的開發和商業化。它提供 cretostimogene，這是一種最初處於臨床開發階段的產品，用於治療非肌肉浸潤性膀胱癌 (NMIBC) 患者。該公司由 Alex Yeung 和 Paul A. DeRidder 於 2010 年 9 月 24 日創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Global X AI Semiconductor & Quantum ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Global X AI Semiconductor & Quantum Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in the securities of the underlying index), which may include common stocks, ADRs and GDRs. The underlying index, as presently constituted, is designed to track the performance of companies that are involved in the artificial intelligence ("AI") semiconductor and quantum computing ecosystems. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X AI 半導體和量子 ETF 尋求提供與 Global X AI 半導體和量子指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於相關指數的證券，其中可能包括普通股、ADR 和 GDR。目前構成的基礎指數旨在追蹤參與人工智慧（「AI」）半導體和量子運算生態系統的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cogent Biosciences, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development of precision therapies for genetically defined diseases. It focuses on CGT9486, a selective tyrosine kinase inhibitor that is designed to potently inhibit the KIT D816V mutation and other mutations in KIT exon 17. The company was founded by Charles Wilson and Dario Campana in March 2014 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Cogent Biosciences, Inc.是一家生技公司，致力於開發針對遺傳性疾病的精準療法。它專注於 CGT9486，這是一種選擇性酪胺酸激酶抑制劑，旨在有效抑制 KIT D816V 突變和 KIT 外顯子 17 中的其他突變。該公司由 Charles Wilson 和 Dario Campana 於 2014 年 3 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Cue Biopharma, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of immunotherapies to treat cancer and autoimmune diseases. Its products include CUE-400 series (autoimmune diseases), CUE-500 series (targeted cell depletion), and CUE-100 series (Oncology). The company was founded by Ronald D. Seidel III, Steven Almo, and Rodolfo Chaparro on December 31, 2014 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Cue Biopharma, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發治療癌症和自體免疫疾病的免疫療法。其產品包括CUE-400系列（自體免疫疾病）、CUE-500系列（靶向細胞去除）和CUE-100系列（腫瘤）。該公司由 Ronald D. Seidel III、Steven Almo 和 Rodolfo Chaparro 於 2014 年 12 月 31 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: SPDR Galaxy Digital Asset Ecosystem ETF seeks to provide long term capital appreciation. The Sub-Adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing, directly or indirectly, in (i) equity securities of foreign and domestic companies within the crypto asset and blockchain industries, (ii) exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that primarily hold bitcoin and/or ether futures contracts ("Crypto Asset Futures ETFs"), (iii) bitcoin and ether futures contracts ("crypto asset futures"), and (iv) exchange-traded products that hold bitcoin or ether as a reference asset ("Spot Crypto Asset ETPs"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR Galaxy 數位資產生態系統 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。副顧問尋求透過直接或間接投資於（i）加密資產和區塊鏈產業內的外國和國內公司的股本證券，（ii）主要持有比特幣和/或以太坊期貨合約（「加密資產期貨ETF」）的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），（iii）比特幣和以太坊期貨交易（iv幣貨幣參考資產（「現貨加密資產 ETP」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares MSCI Emerging Markets Asia ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI EM Asia Custom Capped Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to measure equity market performance in the emerging market countries of Asia. The underlying index includes large- and mid-capitalization companies and may change over time.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 新興市場亞洲 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場亞洲客製化上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。相關指數旨在衡量亞洲新興市場國家的股票市場表現。基礎指數包括大中型公司，並可能隨著時間的推移而變化。

info.description: 4DMT operates as a clinical-stage genetic medicines company focused on inventing and developing genetic medicines to treat large market diseases in ophthalmology, pulmonology and cardiology. It develops genetic medicines using its proprietary invention platform, Therapeutic Vector Evolution. It combines the power of the Nobel Prize-winning technology, directed evolution, with approximately one billion synthetic AAV capsid-derived sequences. Its product design, development and manufacturing engine create a valuable and diverse product pipeline. The company is currently advancing five clinical-stage and two preclinical product candidates, each tailored to address rare and large market diseases. 4DMT was founded by David H. Kirn, Melissa Kotterman, Theresa Janke, and David Schaffer on September 12, 2013 and is headquartered in Emeryville, CA.
info.description_zh: 4DMT 是一家臨床階段的基因藥物公司，專注於發明和開發基因藥物，以治療眼科、肺部和心臟病學等大型市場疾病。它利用其專有的發明平台「治療載體進化」開發基因藥物。它將獲得諾貝爾獎的技術、定向進化的力量與大約十億個合成的 AAV 衣殼衍生序列結合在一起。其產品設計、開發和製造引擎創造了有價值且多樣化的產品線。該公司目前正在推進五種臨床階段和兩種臨床前候選產品，每種產品都是針對罕見和大型市場疾病量身定制的。 4DMT 由 David H. Kirn、Melissa Kotterman、Theresa Janke 和 David Schaffer 於 2013 年 9 月 12 日創立，總部位於加州埃默里維爾。

info.description: Faeth Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company which focuses on the discovery, development, and delivery of next generation immunotherapies for the treatment of cancer and infectious diseases. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Rockville, MD.
info.description_zh: Faeth Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於發現、開發和提供用於治療癌症和傳染病的下一代免疫療法。該公司成立於 1999 年，總部位於馬裡蘭州羅克維爾。

info.description: Generate Biomedicines, Inc. is a clinical-stage generative biology company pioneering the AI revolution in biotechnology and drug design and development. The company was founded in 2018, and is headquartered in Somerville, MA.
info.description_zh: Generate Biomedicines, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生成生物學公司，引領生物技術和藥物設計與開發領域的人工智慧革命。該公司成立於 2018 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州薩默維爾。

info.description: Geron Corp. operates as a biotechnology company. It develops a telomerase inhibitor, Imetelstat, in hematologic myeloid malignancies. The firm develops therapeutic products for oncology. The company was founded by Michael D. West on November 28, 1990 and is headquartered in Foster City, CA.
info.description_zh: Geron Corp. 作為一家生技公司運作。它開發了一種用於治療血液骨髓惡性腫瘤的端粒酶抑制劑 Imetelstat。該公司開發腫瘤治療產品。該公司由 Michael D. West 於 1990 年 11 月 28 日創立，總部位於加州福斯特市。

info.description: Cybin, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company on a mission to create safe and effective psychedelic-based therapeutics to address the large unmet need for new and innovative treatment options for people who suffer from mental health conditions. It is currently developing CYB003, a proprietary deuterated psilocybin analog for the treatment of major depressive disorder and CYB004, a proprietary deuterated DMT molecule for generalized anxiety disorder and has a research pipeline of investigational psychedelic-based compounds. The company was founded by Paul Glavine, Eric So, and John Kanakis on October 13, 2016 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Cybin, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，其使命是創造安全有效的迷幻療法，以滿足精神健康問題患者對新型創新治療方案的巨大未滿足需求。該公司目前正在開發 CYB003（一種用於治療重度憂鬱症的專有氘代裸蓋菇素類似物）和 CYB004（一種用於治療廣泛性焦慮症的專有氘代 DMT 分子），並擁有一系列基於致幻劑的研究化合物的研究管線。該公司由 Paul Glavine、Eric So 和 John Kanakis 於 2016 年 10 月 13 日創立，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: TuHURA Biosciences, Inc. is a clinical-stage immuno-oncology company, which engages in the development of novel technologies to overcome resistance to cancer immunotherapy. Its lead product candidate, IFx2.0, is an innate immune agonist designed to overcome primary resistance to checkpoint inhibitors. The company was founded by Michael Lawman, Patricia Lawman and James A. Bianco on May 4, 2023 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.description_zh: TuHURA Biosciences, Inc.是一家臨床階段的免疫腫瘤學公司，致力於開發克服癌症免疫療法抗藥性的新技術。其主要候選產品 IFx2.0 是一種先天免疫激動劑，旨在克服對檢查點抑制劑的主要抗藥性。該公司由 Michael Lawman、Patricia Lawman 和 James A. Bianco 於 2023 年 5 月 4 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: Golden Eagle Dynamic Hypergrowth ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the common stock of "hypergrowth companies.
info.description_zh: Golden Eagle Dynamic Hypergrowth ETF 尋求資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過在正常市場條件下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於「高速成長公司」的普通股來實現其投資目標。

info.description: Hyperion DeFi, Inc. is a long-term strategic treasury of Hyperliquid's native token HYPE. The firm provides investors with streamlined access to the Hyperliquid ecosystem and is also developing its proprietary Optejet user-filled device, designed for use with a variety of topical ophthalmic liquids, including artificial tears and lens rewetting products. It operates through the following segments: Ophthalmic Technology and Digital Assets. The Ophthalmic Technology segment focuses on developing eye-care devices and delivery systems for ophthalmic liquids. The Digital Assets segment focuses on managing a strategic treasury of blockchain-based assets and exposure to the Hyperliquid ecosystem. The company was founded by Sean Ianchulev on March 12, 2014 and is headquartered in Laguna Hills, CA.
info.description_zh: Hyperion DeFi, Inc. 是 Hyperliquid 原生代幣 HYPE 的長期策略金庫。該公司為投資者提供了進入 Hyperliquid 生態系統的簡化途徑，並且還在開發其專有的 Optejet 用戶填充設備，該設備設計用於各種局部眼科液體，包括人工淚液和鏡片再潤濕產品。它透過以下部門運作：眼科技術部門和數位資產部門。眼科技術部門專注於開發眼科護理設備和眼科液體輸送系統。數位資產部門專注於管理基於區塊鏈的資產的策略金庫以及對 Hyperliquid 生態系統的投資。該公司由 Sean Ianchulev 於 2014 年 3 月 12 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州拉古納山。

info.description: iShares Biotechnology ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE Biotechnology Index composed of U.S.-listed equities in the biotechnology sector. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Biotechnology ETF 旨在追蹤由美國上市生技產業股票組成的 ICE 生技指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。它是非多元化的。

info.description: WisdomTree India Hedged Equity Fund ETF seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the WisdomTree India Hedged Equity Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in the constituent securities of its index. WisdomTree, the index provider and parent company of WisdomTree Asset Management, Inc. has created the index to provide exposure to companies incorporated, listed, and traded in India, while at the same time "hedging" or neutralizing exposure to fluctuations in the value of the Indian rupee relative to the U.S. dollar. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 印度對沖股票基金 ETF 旨在追蹤 WisdomTree 印度對沖股票指數（未計費用和開支）的價格和收益率表現。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於其指數的成分證券。 WisdomTree 是 WisdomTree Asset Management, Inc. 的指數提供者和母公司，而創建該指數的目的是為在印度註冊、上市和交易的公司提供風險敞口，同時「對沖」或抵消印度盧比相對於美元價值波動的風險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Core MSCI Total International Stock ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI ACWI ex USA IMI composed of large-, mid- and small-capitalization non-U.S. equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization index designed to measure the combined equity market performance of developed and emerging markets countries, excluding the United States.
info.description_zh: iShares Core MSCI Total International Stock ETF 旨在追蹤由大、中、小型非美國股票組成的 MSCI ACWI ex USA IMI 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整後的市值指數，旨在衡量已開發市場和新興市場國家（不包括美國）的綜合股市表現。

info.description: J.W. Mays, Inc. engages in the operation of commercial real estate properties. The company was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Brooklyn, NY.
info.description_zh: J.W. Mays, Inc. 從事商業房地產的營運。該公司成立於 1924 年，總部位於紐約布魯克林。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long MU Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Micron Technology Inc. (NASDAQ: MU). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long MU Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為美光科技公司（納斯達克股票代碼：MU）普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過進入標的股票的掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily MU Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of MU. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of MU and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to MU, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily MU Bull 2X Shares 尋求 MU 每日表現的 200% 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 MU 的證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權，這些組合起來為 MU 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nurix Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company. It engages in the business of discovering, developing, and commercializing innovative small molecules and antibody therapies based on the modulation of cellular protein levels as a novel treatment approach for cancer, inflammatory conditions, and other challenging diseases. The company was founded by John Kuriyan, Michael Rape, and Arthur Weiss in 2009 and is headquartered in Brisbane, CA.
info.description_zh: Nurix Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司。該公司致力於發現、開發和商業化基於細胞蛋白質水平調節的創新小分子和抗體療法，作為癌症、發炎和其他挑戰性疾病的新型治療方法。該公司由 John Kuriyan、Michael Rape 和 Arthur Weiss 於 2009 年創立，總部位於加州布里斯班。

info.description: Invesco DWA Developed Markets Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Developed Markets Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is comprised of equity securities of large capitalization companies classified as developed markets, excluding the United States.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA 已開發市場動量 ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright 已開發市場技術領先指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數由歸類為已開發市場（美國除外）的大型市值公司的股本證券組成。

info.description: Ribbon Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 17, 2024 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
info.description_zh: Ribbon Acquisition Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年7月17日，總部位於日本東京。

info.description: Sagtec Global Ltd. provides IT consulting, software and mobile app development and cloud computing services. It focuses on customizable software solutions encompassing several types of software such as a smart ordering system, Speed +, smart solutions application software for the food and beverage industry. The company was founded on October 31, 2023 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: Sagtec Global Ltd. 提供 IT 諮詢、軟體和行動應用程式開發以及雲端運算服務。它專注於可自訂的軟體解決方案，涵蓋多種類型的軟體，例如智慧訂購系統、Speed +、食品和飲料行業的智慧解決方案應用軟體。該公司成立於2023年10月31日，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. engages in the research and development of engineered cells as medicine. It focuses on identifying and developing potential product candidates, executing preclinical studies, and acquiring technology. The company was founded by Steven D. Harr, Noubar B. Afeyan, Robert Taylor Nelsen, and Hans Edgar Bishop on July 2018 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. 從事工程細胞藥物的研究和開發。它專注於識別和開發潛在的候選產品、執行臨床前研究以及獲取技術。該公司由 Steven D. Harr、Noubar B. Afeyan、Robert Taylor Nelsen 和 Hans Edgar Bishop 於 2018 年 7 月創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: SanJac Alpha Core Plus Bond ETF seeks current income and total returns consistent with limited volatility and the preservation of capital. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a portfolio of income-oriented instruments principally consisting of investment-grade U.S. corporate and government debt obligations (including securities issued or guaranteed by the U.S. government or its agencies or instrumentalities), mortgage-backed securities, mortgage real estate investment trusts, and preferred stocks. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SanJac Alpha Core Plus Bond ETF 尋求與有限波動性和資本保存一致的當前收入和總回報。該基金是一隻主動管理的ETF，旨在透過投資收入導向工具投資組合來實現其投資目標，這些工具主要包括投資級美國公司和政府債務債券（包括由美國政府或其機構或工具發行或擔保的證券）、抵押貸款支持證券、抵押房地產投資信託和優先股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SR Bancorp, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the ownership of the outstanding common stock of Somerset Regal Bank. The company was founded on July 20, 2022 and is headquartered in Bound Brook, NJ.
info.description_zh: SR Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，擁有 Somerset Regal Bank 已發行普通股。該公司成立於2022年7月20日，總部位於新澤西州邦德布魯克。

info.description: Tower Semiconductor Ltd. engages in providing semiconductor solutions. It also offers technology and manufacturing platforms for integrated circuits (ICs) in growing markets such as consumer, industrial, automotive, mobile, infrastructure, medical, and aerospace and defense. It focuses on creating positive and sustainable impact on the world through long term partnerships and its advanced and innovative analog technology offering, comprised of a broad range of customizable process platforms such as SiGe, BiCMOS, mixed-signal/CMOS, RF CMOS, CMOS image sensor, non-imaging sensors, integrated power management (BCD and 700V), and MEMS. Its designs enable a quick and accurate design cycle as well as process transfer services including development, transfer, and optimization, to IDMs and fabless companies. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Migdal Haemek, Israel.
info.description_zh: Tower Semiconductor Ltd. 致力於提供半導體解決方案。它還為消費、工業、汽車、移動、基礎設施、醫療、航空航太和國防等不斷增長的市場中的積體電路 (IC) 提供技術和製造平台。它專注於透過長期合作夥伴關係及其先進和創新的類比技術產品對世界產生積極和可持續的影響，該技術產品由廣泛的可自訂製程平台組成，例如 SiGe、BiCMOS、混合訊號/CMOS、RF CMOS、CMOS 影像感測器、非影像感測器、整合電源管理（BCD 和 700V）和 MEMS。其設計為 IDM 和無晶圓廠公司提供快速、準確的設計週期以及包括開發、轉移和優化在內的流程轉移服務。該公司成立於1993年，總部位於以色列Migdal Haemek。

info.description: Vera Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnical company which engages in the development and commercialization of transformative treatments for immunological diseases. The company was founded by Marshall Fordyce in May 2016 and is headquartered in Brisbane, CA.
info.description_zh: Vera Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於免疫疾病轉化療法的開發和商業化。該公司由 Marshall Fordyce 於 2016 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州布里斯班。

info.description: Viking Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of therapies for metabolic and endocrine disorders. The company was founded by Brian Lian and Michael A. Dinerman on September 24, 2012 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Viking Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於代謝和內分泌疾病療法的開發。該公司由 Brian Lian 和 Michael A. Dinerman 於 2012 年 9 月 24 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long VRT Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Vertiv Holdings Co. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long VRT Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果為 Vertiv Holdings Co. 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過輸入標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Eton Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the development, acquisition, and commercialization of prescription drug products. Its products include Biorphen, Alaway Preservative Free, zonisamide oral suspension, topiramate oral suspension, lamotrigine for oral suspension, cysteine injection, and ephedrine ready-to-use injection. The company was founded in April 2017 and is headquartered in Deer Park, IL.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Eton Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the development, acquisition, and commercialization of prescription drug products.其产品包括Biorphen、Alaway Free Preservative Free、唑尼沙胺口服混悬液、托吡酯口服混悬液、拉莫三嗪口服混悬液、半胱氨酸注射液、麻黄碱即用注射液。 The company was founded in April 2017 and is headquartered in Deer Park, IL.

info.description: Global X NASDAQ 100 Covered Call ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, generally to the price and yield performance of the CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite V2 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite Index is a benchmark index that measures the performance of a theoretical portfolio that holds a portfolio of the stocks included in the NASDAQ-100 Index, and "writes" (or sells) a succession of one-month at-the-money NASDAQ-100 Index covered call options. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 備兌買權 ETF 尋求提供與 CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite V2 指數（「基本指數」）的價格和收益率表現密切對應的投資結果（未計費和支出）。該基金將至少80%的總資產投資於相關指數的證券。 CBOE NASDAQ-100 BuyWrite 指數是衡量理論投資組合表現的基準指數，該理論投資組合持有 NASDAQ-100 指數中包含的股票投資組合，並「賣出」（或賣出）一系列 1 個月平價 NASDAQ-100 指數擔保看漲期權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Gores Holdings X, Inc. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 26, 2023 and is headquartered in Boulder, CO.
info.description_zh: Gores Holdings X, Inc. 作為一家空白支票公司運營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2023年6月26日，總部位於科羅拉多州博爾德。

info.description: Mango Growth ETF is an actively managed ETF. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing primarily in the common stock of companies that the fund manager believes have high growth characteristics. The fund manager considers a company to have high growth characteristics if it demonstrates consistently strong year-over-year growth across multiple fundamental and market-based metrics. These may include, but are not limited to, sustained increases in sales, earnings, and cash flows, as well as positive share price trends over a specified evaluation period. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 芒果成長ETF是主動式管理型ETF。該基金透過主要投資於基金經理人認為具有高成長特徵的公司的普通股來尋求長期資本增值。如果一家公司在多個基本面和基於市場的指標上表現出持續強勁的同比增長，基金經理就會認為該公司具有高成長特徵。這些可能包括但不限於銷售額、收益和現金流量的持續成長，以及在特定評估期間內積極的股價趨勢。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Astoria Dynamic Core US Fixed Income ETF seeks current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in other U.S. fixed income ETFs. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of borrowing for investment purposes) directly or indirectly in U.S. fixed income securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Astoria Dynamic Core 美國固定收益 ETF 尋求當前收益。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過主要投資於其他美國固定收益 ETF 來實現其投資目標。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上投資目的借款金額）直接或間接投資於美國固定收益證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Germany AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Germany Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Germany Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 德國 AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與名為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 德國指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克德國指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: WisdomTree Target Range Fund seeks to provide capital appreciation, with a secondary objective of hedging risk. In pursuing its investment objectives, the fund adviser seeks to follow the methodology of the TOPS Global Equity Target RangeTM Index. However, the fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). Under normal conditions, approximately 80-85% of the fund's assets are expected to be invested in the cash collateral component upon the annual roll date in January. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree Target Range 基金旨在提供資本增值，次要目標是對沖風險。在追求投資目標時，基金顧問力求遵循 TOPS 全球股票目標範圍™ 指數的方法。然而，該基金是主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」）。在正常情況下，大約 80-85% 的基金資產預計將在一月份的年度展期日投資於現金抵押品部分。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Digital Asset Debt Strategy ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation and, secondarily, income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). Under normal market conditions the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in debt securities of issuers that are directly involved in digital asset-related activities. The digital asset-related activities that such issuers may be involved in include (i) mining of digital assets; (ii) holding digital assets in their corporate treasury or government treasury; and (iii) working on platforms to facilitate payment with, or the transfer of, digital assets.
info.description_zh: 數位資產債務策略ETF尋求長期資本增值，其次是收入。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於直接參與數位資產相關活動的發行人的債務證券。此類發行人可能參與的數位資產相關活動包括（i）數位資產的挖礦； (ii) 在公司金庫或政府金庫中持有數位資產； (iii) 致力於開發促進數位資產支付或轉移的平台。

info.description: Public Service Enterprise Group, Inc. is an energy company, which engages in the business of regulated electric and gas utility, and nuclear generation. Its products and services include energy, capacity, ancillary services, and emissions allowances and congestion credits. The firm operates through the Public Service Electric and Gas Company (PSE&G) and PSEG Power segments. The PSE&G segment focuses on the transmission of electricity and distribution of electricity and natural gas. The PSEG Power segment wholesales energy, fuel supply, and energy transacting functions. The company was founded in 1903 and is headquartered in Newark, NJ.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: Public Service Enterprise Group, Inc. 是一家能源公司，從事受監管的電力和天然氣公用事業以及核能發電業務。其產品和服務包括能源、容量、輔助服務以及排放配額和擁塞信用。該公司透過公共服務電力和天然氣公司 (PSE&G) 和 PSEG 電力部門運營。 PSE&G 部門專注於電力傳輸以及電力和天然氣的分配。 PSEG 電力部門批發能源、燃料供應和能源交易功能。該公司成立於 1903 年，總部位於新澤西州紐瓦克。

info.description: Global X Nasdaq 100 Covered Call & Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Cboe Nasdaq 100 Half BuyWrite V2 Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of a theoretical portfolio that holds a portfolio of the stocks included in the NASDAQ 100 Index (the "reference index"), and "writes" (or sells) a succession of one-month at-the-money covered call options on the reference index. It generally will use a replication strategy. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X Nasdaq 100 Covered Call & Growth ETF 力求提供與 Cboe Nasdaq 100 Half BuyWrite V2 指數（「基本指數」）的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。基礎指數衡量理論投資組合的表現，該理論投資組合持有納斯達克 100 指數（「參考指數」）中包含的股票投資組合，並「賣出」（或出售）參考指數的一系列一個月期平值備兌買權。它通常會使用複製策略。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2032 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2032, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2032 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2032年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人認購選擇權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: AB Moderate Buffer ETF seeks a moderate level of capital appreciation while providing the potential for some downside protection against market declines. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal conditions, substantially all of its assets in a combination of exchange-traded options contracts on an underlying ETF. The underlying ETF (initially expected to be the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust) is an ETF that seeks to track the investment results of the S&P 500 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AB 適度緩衝 ETF 尋求適度的資本增值，同時提供一些針對市場下跌的下行保護的潛力。該基金尋求透過在正常情況下將其大部分資產投資於標的 ETF 的交易所交易選擇權合約組合來實現其投資目標。標的 ETF（最初預計為 SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust）是一款旨在追蹤 S&P 500 指數投資結果的 ETF。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust SMID Capital Strength ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the SMID Capital Strength Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select dividend-paying securities issued by mid capitalization U.S. companies.
info.description_zh: First Trust SMID 資本強度 ETF 尋求與稱為 SMID 資本強度指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在選擇中等市值美國公司發行的派息證券。

info.description: Jpmorgan International Value ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in equity securities and equity-related instruments of foreign companies, including foreign subsidiaries of U.S. companies. The fund may invest in issuers located in both developed foreign and emerging market countries. Developed foreign countries include Australia, Canada, Israel, Japan, New Zealand, Singapore, the United Kingdom, most of the countries of Western Europe and Hong Kong; emerging market countries include most of the other countries in the world.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通國際價值ETF尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金主要投資於外國公司的股本證券和股本相關工具，包括美國公司的外國子公司。該基金可投資於國外已開發國家及新興市場國家的發行人。國外已開發國家包括澳洲、加拿大、以色列、日本、紐西蘭、新加坡、英國、西歐大部分國家和香港；新興市場國家包括世界上大多數其他國家。

info.description: SGI Enhanced Global Income ETF seeks income. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") and seeks to achieve its objective by (1) actively investing in global companies that offer dividend income and that trade on U.S. stock exchanges and (2) investing in options strategies that seek to generate current income. The fund uses an actively traded put and call options strategy that choose deep out-of-the-money strike prices generally expiring within 1-7 days to generate income.
info.description_zh: SGI 增強型全球收益 ETF 尋求收益。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過（1）積極投資於提供股息收入並在美國證券交易所交易的全球公司以及（2）投資於尋求產生當前收入的選擇策略來實現其目標。該基金採用交易活躍的看跌期權和看漲期權策略，選擇通常在 1-7 天內到期的深度價外執行價格來產生收入。

info.description: ProQR Therapeutics NV is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery and development of RNA therapies for the treatment of severe genetic rare diseases with a focus on inherited retinal diseases. The company was founded by Daniel Anton de Boer, Gerard J. Platenburg, Henri A. Termeer, and Domenico Valerio on February 21, 2012, and is headquartered in Leiden, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: ProQR Therapeutics NV 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發 RNA 療法，用於治療嚴重的遺傳性罕見疾病，重點是遺傳性視網膜疾病。該公司由 Daniel Anton de Boer、Gerard J. Platenburg、Henri A. Termeer 和 Domenico Valerio 於 2012 年 2 月 21 日創立，總部位於荷蘭萊頓。

info.description: DTE Energy Co. operates as a diversified energy company, which engages in the development and management of energy-related businesses and services. It operates through the following segments: Electric, Gas, DTE Vantage, Energy Trading, and Corporate and Other. The Electric segment consists of generation, purchase, distribution, and sale of electricity to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in southeastern Michigan. The Gas segment is involved in the purchase, storage, transportation, distribution, and sale of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers throughout Michigan, and the sale of storage and transportation capacity. The DTE Vantage segment focuses on projects that deliver energy and utility-type products and services to industrial, commercial, and institutional customers, produce reduced emissions fuel, and sell electricity and pipeline-quality gas from renewable energy projects. The Energy Trading segment covers energy marketing and trading operations. The Corporate and Other segment includes various holding company activities, holds certain non-utility debt, and holds certain investments, as well as funds supporting regional development and economic growth. The company was founded in January 1995 and is headquartered in Detroit, MI.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: DTE Energy Co.是一家多元化能源公司，從事能源相關業務和服務的開發和管理。該公司透過以下部門運作：電力部門、天然氣部門、DTE Vantage 部門、能源貿易部門以及企業及其他部門。電力部門包括向密西根州東南部的住宅、商業和工業客戶發電、購買、分配和銷售電力。天然氣部門涉及向密西根州各地的住宅、商業和工業客戶購買、儲存、運輸、分銷和銷售天然氣，以及銷售儲存和運輸能力。 DTE Vantage 部門專注於向工業、商業和機構客戶提供能源和公用事業型產品和服務、生產減少排放的燃料以及銷售來自再生能源專案的電力和管道品質天然氣的專案。能源貿易部門涵蓋能源行銷和貿易業務。公司及其他部門包括各種控股公司活動，持有某些非公用事業債務，並持有某些投資以及支持區域發展和經濟成長的基金。該公司成立於 1995 年 1 月，總部位於密西根州底特律。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2031 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2031 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2031. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2031 and December 15, 2031, inclusive. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2031 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤由 2031 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2031 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index 的投資結果。該基金通常尋求透過投資滿足基礎指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由公開發行的美國國債組成，計劃於 2031 年 1 月 1 日至 2031 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。

info.description: Pacer Metarus Nasdaq 100 Dividend Multiplier 600 ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Metaurus Nasdaq Dividend Multiplier Total Return Index - Series 600. The index, as designed, has two components: (i) a Nasdaq-100 component and (ii) a dividend component consisting of long positions in annual futures contracts that provide exposure to ordinary dividends paid on the common stocks of companies included in the Nasdaq-100 Index. The Advisor attempts to invest all, or substantially all, of its assets in the component securities that make up the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Metarus Nasdaq 100 Dividend Multiplier 600 ETF 旨在追蹤 Metaurus Nasdaq Dividend Multiplier Total Return Index - Series 600 的總回報表現（未扣除費用和開支）。按照設計，該指數有兩個組成部分：(i) Nasdaq-100 成分和 (ii) 股息成分，由年度期貨合約的多頭頭寸組成，這些合約提供對包括以下公司的普通股支付的普通股股息的敞口被納入納斯達克 100 指數。顧問試圖將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pacer Cash COWZ 100-Nasdaq 100 Rotator ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Cash COWZ 100-Nasdaq 100 Rotator Index. The index uses an objective, rules-based methodology to provide exposure to large-capitalization companies. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in equity securities that are the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Cash COWZ 100-Nasdaq 100 Rotator ETF 旨在追蹤 Cash COWZ 100-Nasdaq 100 Rotator Index 的總回報表現（扣除費用和開支）。該指數採用客觀、基於規則的方法來提供對大市值公司的投資。在正常情況下，至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）將投資於作為指數組成證券的股本證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X NASDAQ 100 Tail Risk ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Protective Put 90 Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Protective Put 90 Index ("underlying index"). The underlying index measures the performance of a risk management strategy that holds the underlying stocks of the NASDAQ 100 Index and applies a protective put strategy (i.e. long (purchased) put options) on the NASDAQ 100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 尾部風險 ETF 尋求提供與 Nasdaq-100 季度保護性看跌期權 90 指數（「基礎指數」）的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於 Nasdaq-100 季度保護性看跌期權 90 指數（「基礎指數」）的證券。標的指數衡量持有納斯達克 100 指數標的股票並對納斯達克 100 指數應用保護性看跌策略（即多頭（購買）看跌期權）的風險管理策略的績效。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long BULL Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of BULL. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of BULL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 BULL 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 BULL 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 BULL 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WisdomTree Emerging Markets Quality Dividend Growth Fund seeks income and capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in emerging market dividend-paying common stocks with growth characteristics. The adviser, using a disciplined model-based process focused on a long-term approach to investing, seeks to identify dividend-paying companies with strong corporate profitability and sustainable growth characteristics. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree新興市場優質股息成長基金尋求收入和資本增值。該基金尋求透過主要投資於具有成長特徵的新興市場派息普通股來實現其投資目標。該顧問採用基於模型的嚴格流程，專注於長期投資方法，力求識別具有強勁企業盈利能力和可持續增長特徵的派息公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Parametric Equity Plus ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). The investment objective of the fund is to seek to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities.
info.description_zh: 參數股票加ETF旨在提供長期資本增值。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。該基金的投資目標是尋求提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於股本證券。

info.description: Democratic Large Cap Core ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Democratic Large Cap Core Index. The index is a subset of the S&P 500 Index designed to provide exposure to large capitalization companies that make political contributions to Democratic Party candidates and political action committees above a certain threshold. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of companies included in the index.
info.description_zh: 民主大盤核心 ETF 旨在追蹤民主大盤核心指數（未計費用和支出）的總回報表現。該指數是標準普爾 500 指數的子集，旨在為向民主黨候選人和政治行動委員會提供超過一定門檻的政治捐款的大型資本公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於指數所包含公司的證券。

info.description: SharonAI Holdings, Inc. operates as a holding company that develops and delivers GPU cloud computing and AI solutions. The company was founded on December 30, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: SharonAI Holdings, Inc. 作為一家控股公司經營，開發和提供 GPU 雲端運算和人工智慧解決方案。該公司成立於2024年12月30日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Direxion NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted Index Shares seeks investment results before fees and expenses that track the NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted Index. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its assets in the securities that comprise the index or investments with economic characteristics similar to the securities included in the index. The index is the equal weighted version of the NASDAQ-100 Index which includes approximately 100 of the largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on the NASDAQ Stock Market based on market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion NASDAQ-100 等權重指數股票尋求追蹤 NASDAQ-100 等權重指數的未計費用和開支的投資結果。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的資產投資於指數所包含的證券或與指數所包含的證券具有相似經濟特徵的投資。該指數是 NASDAQ-100 指數的等權重版本，其中包括按市值計算在納斯達克股票市場上市的約 100 家最大的國內和國際非金融公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Raymond James Financial, Inc. is an investment holding company, which engages in the provision of financial and investment services. Its services include investment management, merger and acquisition and advisory, the underwriting, distribution, trading and brokerage of equity and debt securities, sale of mutual funds, corporate and retail banking, and trust services. It operates through the following segments: Private Client Group, Capital Markets, Asset Management, Bank, and Other. The Private Client Group segment provides financial planning, investment advisory, and securities transaction services to clients through financial advisors. The Capital Markets segment focuses on investment banking, institutional sales, securities trading, equity research and the syndication, and management of investments in low-income housing funds and funds of a similar nature. The Asset Management segment is involved in asset management, portfolio management, and related administrative services to retail and institutional clients. The Bank segment refers to the results of banking operations. The Other segment includes private equity investments, which predominantly consist of investments in third-party funds. The company was founded by Robert A. James in 1962 and is headquartered in St. Petersburg, FL.
info.description_zh: Raymond James Financial, Inc.是一家投資控股公司，從事提供金融和投資服務。其服務包括投資管理、併購和諮詢、股票和債務證券的承銷、分銷、交易和經紀、共同基金銷售、企業和零售銀行業務以及信託服務。它透過以下部門運作：私人客戶部門、資本市場、資產管理、銀行和其他部門。私人客戶集團部門透過財務顧問向客戶提供財務規劃、投資諮詢和證券交易服務。資本市場部門專注於投資銀行、機構銷售、證券交易、股票研究和銀團以及低收入住房基金和類似性質基金的投資管理。資產管理部門為零售和機構客戶提供資產管理、投資組合管理以及相關管理服務。銀行部門是指銀行業務的結果。其他部門包括私募股權投資，主要包括對第三方基金的投資。該公司由 Robert A. James 於 1962 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州聖彼得堡。

info.description: ProShares Ultra QQQ TOP 30 seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) of the daily performance of the Nasdaq-100 Top 30 Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the daily target. The index is designed to measure the performance of the top 30 companies from the Nasdaq-100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Ultra QQQ TOP 30 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支），相當於 Nasdaq-100 Top 30 指數每日表現的兩倍 (2x)。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與每日目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數旨在衡量納斯達克 100 指數中排名前 30 名的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares MSCI Turkey ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Turkey IMI 25/50 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of the large-, mid- and small-capitalization segments of equity market in Turkey. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 土耳其 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 土耳其 IMI 25/50 指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數旨在衡量土耳其股票市場大、中、小型股的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Enhanced U.S. Equity ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes (measured at the time of purchase) ("Net Assets") in equity securities issued by small-, mid- and large-cap U.S. companies.
info.description_zh: 高盛增強型美國股票 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款（在購買時計量）（「淨資產」）投資於美國小型、中型和大型公司發行的股本證券。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright DALI 1 ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Nasdaq Dorsey Wright DALI 1 TM Index. Under normal conditions, the fund will invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index has been designed based upon the principle that the asset class exhibiting the highest levels of "relative strength," based on current prices, will be the asset class with the best performance over the near term.
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright DALI 1 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與納斯達克 Dorsey Wright DALI 1 TM 指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。在正常情況下，基金將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數的設計原則是，根據當前價格，表現出最高水準「相對強度」的資產類別將是近期表現最好的資產類別。

info.description: Pool Corp. engages in the wholesale distribution of swimming pool supplies, equipment, and related leisure products. It also offers non-discretionary pool maintenance products such as chemicals and replacement parts, discretionary products like packaged pool kits, whole goods, irrigation, and landscape products, including a complete line of commercial and residential irrigation products and parts, power equipment for the professional landscape market, specialty products such as outdoor lighting, grills, and outdoor kitchen components, and golf irrigation and water management products. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Covington, LA.
info.description_zh: Pool Corp. 從事游泳池用品、設備和相關休閒產品的批發分銷。它還提供非全權泳池維護產品，如化學品和替換零件，全權產品，如包裝泳池套件、整體商品、灌溉和景觀產品，包括全系列商業和住宅灌溉產品和零件，專業景觀市場的電力設備，戶外照明、烤架和戶外廚房組件等特色產品，以及高爾夫灌溉和水管理產品。該公司成立於 1993 年，總部位於路易斯安那州卡溫頓。

info.description: Bridges Capital Tactical ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed, diversified exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a blend of passively managed U.S. equity index ETFs, large-capitalization equity securities and cash or cash equivalents. It is expected that the fund will generally hold 5 to 20 investments selected from a universe that includes large-capitalization U.S. equity securities and passively managed index ETFs tracking U.S. small-, mid- and large-capitalization equity indexes (the "Indexes").
info.description_zh: Bridges Capital Tactical ETF 旨在提供資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的多元化交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資於被動管理的美國股指ETF、大盤股本證券和現金或現金等價物的組合來實現其投資目標。預計該基金通常將持有 5 至 20 項投資，這些投資選自大盤股美國股本證券和追蹤美國小型股、中盤股和大盤股指數（「指數」）的被動管理指數 ETF。

info.description: Pinnacle West Capital Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of energy and related products. It offers regulated retail and wholesale electricity businesses and related activities, such as generation, transmission, and distribution through its subsidiary, Arizona Public Service Co. The company was founded on February 20, 1985, and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: Pinnacle West Capital Corp. 是一家控股公司，從事提供能源及相關產品業務。它透過其子公司亞利桑那公共服務公司提供受監管的零售和批發電力業務及相關活動，例如發電、輸電和配電。該公司成立於 1985 年 2 月 20 日，總部位於亞利桑那州鳳凰城。

info.description: EquipmentShare.com, Inc. is a digitally-native equipment rental platform servicing the largest jobsites nationwide. It operates through the following segments: Equipment Rental and Services Operations, and Equipment Sales. The Equipment Rental and Services Operations segment engages in recurring activities at full-service branch locations, including equipment rentals and related services, as well as the sale of parts, supplies, and maintenance services. The Equipment Sales segment engages in the sale of new and used equipment through branch locations and dealership sites, including sales to participants in the OWN Program. The company was founded by Jabbok Schlacks and William J. Schlacks IV in 2014 and is headquartered in Columbia, MO.
info.description_zh: EquipmentShare.com, Inc. 是一個數位原生設備租賃平台，為全國最大的工作場所提供服務。它透過以下部門運作：設備租賃和服務營運以及設備銷售。設備租賃和服務營運部門在全方位服務分公司從事經常性活動，包括設備租賃和相關服務，以及零件、用品和維護服務的銷售。設備銷售部門透過分公司和經銷商站點從事新設備和二手設備的銷售，包括向 OWN 計畫參與者的銷售。該公司由 Jabbok Schlacks 和 William J. Schlacks IV 於 2014 年創立，總部位於密蘇裡州哥倫比亞。

info.description: Militia Long/Short Equity ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in both long and short positions in equity securities or ETFs that Militia Investments, LLC, the sub-adviser to the fund (the "Sub-Adviser"), believes offer the potential for capital appreciation. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Militia 多頭/空頭股票 ETF 尋求資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資股票證券或 ETF 的多頭和空頭部位來實現其投資目標，該基金的副顧問（「副顧問」）Militia Investments, LLC 認為這些證券或 ETF 具有資本增值的潛力。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Exelon Corp. is a utility services holding company, which engages in energy distribution and transmission businesses. It operates through the following segments: Commonwealth Edison Company (ComEd), PECO Energy Company (PECO), Baltimore Gas and Electric Company (BGE), Potomac Electric Power Company (Pepco), Delmarva Power and Light Company (DPL), and Atlantic City Electric Company (ACE). The company was founded on February 4, 1999 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的電力
info.description_zh: Exelon Corp.是一家公用事業服務控股公司，從事能源分配和傳輸業務。該公司透過以下部門營運：聯邦愛迪生公司 (ComEd)、PECO 能源公司 (PECO)、巴爾的摩天然氣和電力公司 (BGE)、波托馬克電力公司 (Pepco)、德爾馬瓦電力和照明公司 (DPL) 以及大西洋城電力公司 (ACE)。該公司成立於1999年2月4日，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: CRH Plc manufactures and distributes building materials and products for the construction industry. It operates business through the following segments: Americas Materials Solutions, Americas Building Solutions, Europe Materials Solutions, and Europe Building Solutions. The Americas Materials Solutions segment provides solutions for the construction and maintenance of public infrastructure and commercial and residential buildings in North America. The Americas Building Solutions segment manufactures, supplies and delivers solutions for the built environment in communities across North America. The Europe Materials Solutions segment provides solutions for the construction of public infrastructure and commercial and residential buildings to customers in construction markets in Europe. The Europe Building Solutions segment combines materials, products and services to produce a wide range of architectural and infrastructural solutions for use in the building and renovation of critical utility infrastructure, commercial and residential buildings, and outdoor living spaces. CRH was founded on June 20, 1949 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: CRH Plc 為建築業生產和銷售建築材料和產品。該公司透過以下部門開展業務：美洲材料解決方案部門、美洲建築解決方案部門、歐洲材料解決方案部門和歐洲建築解決方案部門。美洲材料解決方案部門為北美公共基礎設施以及商業和住宅建築的建設和維護提供解決方案。美洲建築解決方案部門為北美社區的建築環境製造、供應和提供解決方案。歐洲材料解決方案部門為歐洲建築市場的客戶提供公共基礎設施以及商業和住宅建築建設的解決方案。歐洲建築解決方案部門將材料、產品和服務結合起來，生產廣泛的建築和基礎設施解決方案，用於關鍵公用設施基礎設施、商業和住宅建築以及戶外生活空間的建設和改造。 CRH成立於1949年6月20日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: VanEck Gaming ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS Global Gaming Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. To be initially eligible for the index, companies must generate at least 50% of their revenues from gaming. Gaming includes casinos and casino hotels, sports betting (including internet gambling and racetracks) and lottery services as well as gaming services, gaming technology and gaming equipment. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Gaming ETF 尋求盡可能接近複製未計費用和支出之前的 MVIS 全球博彩指數的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。為了最初符合該指數的資格，公司必須至少 50% 的收入來自遊戲。博彩包括賭場和賭場酒店、體育博彩（包括網路博彩和賽馬場）和彩票服務以及博彩服務、博彩技術和博彩設備。它是非多元化的。

info.description: VictoryShares International Free Cash Flow ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Victory International Free Cash Flow Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity securities of non-U.S. developed markets within the parent index that have high free cash flow yields, which is a financial valuation metric that compares the free cash flow a company is expected to earn against its market value adjusted for a company's debt and cash.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares International Free Cash Flow ETF 力求提供與 Victory International 自由現金流指數表現緊密對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常情況下，基金尋求透過將至少80%的資產投資於指數證券來實現其投資目標。該指數旨在提供母指數內具有高自由現金流收益率的非美國已開發市場的股票證券的敞口，這是一種財務估值指標，將公司預期賺取的自由現金流與其根據公司債務和現金調整後的市值進行比較。

info.description: Ebang International Holdings, Inc. is a blockchain technology company, which engages in the research and development of ASIC chip technology used in blockchain applications in China. It also manufactures bitcoin mining machines. The company was founded by Dong Hu in January 2010 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 億邦國際控股有限公司是一家區塊鏈技術公司，在中國從事區塊鏈應用ASIC晶片技術的研發。它还生产比特币采矿机。該公司由胡東於2010年1月創立，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: Liberty One Spectrum ETF seeks capital appreciation and to provide current income. The fund will be invested primarily in the equity securities of large-capitalization companies that have a strong track record of paying a rising dividend to shareholders and that the Adviser considers to be established and mature, market leaders, with a strong, stable financial foundation and that have the potential for reduced volatility and high liquidity.
info.description_zh: Liberty One Spectrum ETF 尋求資本增值並提供當前收入。該基金將主要投資於大型公司的股本證券，這些公司在向股東支付不斷增加的股息方面擁有良好的記錄，並且顧問認為這些公司是成熟且成熟的市場領導者，具有強大、穩定的財務基礎，並且具有減少波動性和高流動性的潛力。

info.description: Hartford US Quality Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the total return performance of Hartford US Quality Growth Index that tracks the performance of exchange traded U.S. large cap equity securities and is designed to consist of U.S. equities with favorable growth characteristics while maintaining what is considered to be enhanced exposure to quality while also providing reasonable exposure to value and momentum. The fund generally invests at least 80% of its assets in securities of the Index and in depositary receipts representing securities of the index.
info.description_zh: Hartford US Quality Growth ETF 力求提供與 Hartford US Quality Growth Index 的總回報表現相對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支），該指數跟踪交易所交易的美國大盤股證券的表現，旨在由具有良好增長特徵的美國股票組成，同時保持被認為增強的質量敞口，同時提供合理的價值和動量。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於指數證券和代表指數證券的存託憑證。

info.description: The Charles Schwab Corp. is a savings and loan holding company, which engages in the provision of wealth management, securities brokerage, banking, asset management, custody, and financial advisory services. It operates through the Investor Services and Advisor Services segments. The Investor Services segment includes retail brokerage, investment advisory, and banking and trust services to individual investors, retirement plan and business services, as well as other corporate brokerage services, to businesses and employees. The Advisor Services segment provides custodial, trading, banking and trust, and support services to independent registered investment advisors, independent retirement advisors, and recordkeepers. The company was founded by Charles Robert Schwab in 1986 and is headquartered in Westlake, TX.
info.description_zh: 嘉信理財公司是一家儲蓄和貸款控股公司，從事提供財富管理、證券經紀、銀行、資產管理、託管和財務諮詢服務。它透過投資者服務和顧問服務部門運作。投資者服務部門包括為個人投資者提供零售經紀、投資諮詢、銀行和信託服務、退休計畫和商業服務，以及為企業和員工提供的其他企業經紀服務。顧問服務部門為獨立註冊投資顧問、獨立退休顧問和記錄保管員提供託管、交易、銀行和信託以及支援服務。該公司由 Charles Robert Schwab 於 1986 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州西湖。

info.description: First Trust Eurozone AlphaDEX ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield of an index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Eurozone Index.
