The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Eurozone Index that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional passive-style indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Eurozone AlphaDEX ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與納斯達克 AlphaDEX 歐元區指數的價格和收益率相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克歐元區指數中選擇相對於傳統被動型指數可能產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Sound Financial Bancorp, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of traditional banking and other financial services. It involves attracting retail and commercial deposits from the general public and local governments and investing those funds, along with borrowed funds, in loans secured by first and second mortgages on one- to four-family residences, commercial and multifamily real estate, construction and land, consumer, and commercial business loans. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Sound Financial Bancorp, Inc. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事提供傳統銀行和其他金融服務。它涉及吸引公眾和地方政府的零售和商業存款，並將這些資金與借入的資金一起投資於一到四戶住宅、商業和多戶房地產、建築和土地、消費者和商業企業貸款的第一和第二抵押貸款。該公司成立於 2008 年，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: Remitly Global, Inc. engages in the provision of digital financial services for immigrants and their families. The company was founded by Matthew B. Oppenheimer and Joshua Hug on October 3, 2018 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Remitly Global, Inc. 致力於為移民及其家人提供數位金融服務。該公司由 Matthew B. Oppenheimer 和 Joshua Hug 於 2018 年 10 月 3 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: Alpha Cognition, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops treatments for underserved neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's Dementia and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis. It has additional pre-clinical development programs: ZUNVEYL in combination with memantine for the treatment of moderate-to-severe Alzheimer's disease, ALPHA-1062 sublingual formulation, ALPHA-1062 intranasal ("ALPHA-1062IN") formulation for the treatment of cognitive impairment with mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI, otherwise known as concussion) and ALPHA-0602, ALPHA-0702 & ALPHA-0802. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Grapevine, TX.
info.description_zh: Alpha Cognition, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發針對治療不足的神經退化性疾病（如阿茲海默症和肌萎縮側索硬化症）的治療方法。該公司還有其他臨床前開發項目：ZUNVEYL聯合美金剛治療中重度阿爾茨海默病、ALPHA-1062舌下含服製劑、ALPHA-1062鼻內製劑（“ALPHA-1062IN”）用於治療輕度創傷性腦損傷（mTBI，又稱腦震盪）認知障礙以及ALPHA-0602、ALPHA-0702 ＆阿爾法-0802。該公司成立於 2000 年，總部位於德克薩斯州格雷普韋恩。

info.description: Airbnb, Inc. engages in the management and operation of an online marketplace. Its marketplace model connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces. The company was founded by Brian Chesky, Nathan Blecharczyk and Joseph Gebbia in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Airbnb, Inc. 從事線上市場的管理和營運。其市場模式將主人和客人在線上或透過行動裝置連接起來預訂空間。該公司由 Brian Chesky、Nathan Blecharczyk 和 Joseph Gebbia 於 2007 年創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Winchester Bancorp, Inc. operates as an investment holding company of Winchester Savings Bank which engages in providing banking services. Its personal banking products and services include deposits, such as Nexus and Nexus Plus, checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, and individual retirement accounts, loans, including mortgage, home equity, and consumer loans, and services, such as convenience services, Internet and mobile banking, insurance products, and other services. The company was founded on March 3, 1871 and is headquartered in Winchester, MA.
info.description_zh: Winchester Bancorp, Inc. 是 Winchester Savings Bank 的投資控股公司，提供銀行服務。其個人銀行產品和服務包括存款（例如 Nexus 和 Nexus Plus）、支票、儲蓄、貨幣市場、存款證和個人退休帳戶、貸款（包括抵押貸款、房屋淨值和消費貸款）以及服務（例如便利服務、網路和行動銀行、保險產品和其他服務）。該公司成立於 1871 年 3 月 3 日，總部位於馬薩諸塞州溫徹斯特。

info.description: RTX Corp. is an aerospace and defense company, which engages in the provision of aerospace and defense systems and services for commercial, military, and government customers. It operates through the following segments: Collins Aerospace Systems (Collins), Pratt and Whitney, Raytheon Intelligence and Space (RIS), and Raytheon Missiles and Defense (RMD). The Collins segment manufactures and sells aero structures, avionics, interiors, mechanical systems, mission systems, and power controls. The Pratt and Whitney segment includes the design and manufacture of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems for commercial, military, and business aircraft. The RIS segment is involved in the development of sensors, training, and cyber and software solutions. The RMD segment offers end-to-end solutions to detect, track, and engage threats. The company was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Arlington, VA.
info.description_zh: RTX Corp. 是一家航空航太和國防公司，致力於為商業、軍事和政府客戶提供航空航太和國防系統及服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：柯林斯航空航天系統公司（Collins）、普惠公司、雷神情報與航太公司（RIS）以及雷神飛彈與防禦公司（RMD）。柯林斯部門製造和銷售航空結構、航空電子設備、內裝、機械系統、任務系統和動力控制。普惠部門包括設計和製造商用、軍用和公務飛機的飛機引擎和輔助動力系統。 RIS 部門涉及感測器、培訓以及網路和軟體解決方案的開發。 RMD 部門提供端到端解決方案來偵測、追蹤和應對威脅。該公司成立於 1922 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿靈頓。

info.description: Hallador Energy Co. engages in business through its subsidiary, Sunrise Coal, LLC, which produces coal in the Illinois Basin for the electric power generation industry. It also owns summit terminal, a transport facility on the Ohio River. The company was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Terre Haute, IN.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 獨立電力生產商
info.description_zh: Hallador Energy Co. 透過其子公司 Sunrise Coal, LLC 從事業務，該公司在伊利諾伊州盆地生產用於發電行業的煤炭。它還擁有山頂碼頭，這是俄亥俄河上的一個交通設施。該公司成立於 1951 年，總部位於印第安納州特雷霍特。

info.description: Canton Strategic Holdings, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a portfolio of therapeutic candidates for inflammation and immunology. It also develops TH104, which is known to suppress chronic, debilitating pruritus or uncontrollable itching in PBC, a rare and orphan liver disease with no known cure. The company was founded on March 28, 2017 and is headquartered in Bridgewater, NJ.
info.description_zh: Canton Strategy Holdings, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，開發發炎和免疫學候選治療藥物組合。它還開發了 TH104，已知它可以抑制 PBC 中的慢性、衰弱性瘙癢或無法控制的瘙癢，PBC 是一種罕見的孤兒肝病，目前尚無已知的治癒方法。該公司成立於2017年3月28日，總部位於新澤西州布里奇沃特。

info.description: ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a bio-pharmaceutical company, which engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of branded and generic prescription pharmaceuticals. It operates through the Generics, Established Brands, and Other, and Rare Disease segments. The Generics, Established Brands, and Other segment consists of contract manufactured products, development services, royalties, and other. The Rare Disease segment involves the operations related to Cortrophin Gel. The company was founded on August 29, 1996 and is headquartered in Baudette, MN.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，從事品牌和仿製藥處方藥的開發、製造和行銷。它透過仿製藥、知名品牌、其他和罕見疾病部門運作。仿製藥、知名品牌和其他部門包括合約製造產品、開發服務、特許權使用費等。罕見疾病部門涉及與 Cortropin 凝膠相關的業務。該公司成立於 1996 年 8 月 29 日，總部位於明尼蘇達州 Baudette。

info.description: Cricut, Inc., distributes scrap book, craft and home decor items. The firm's products include its flagship line of cutting machines, such as the Cricut Maker family, the Cricut Explore family, and Cricut Joy, accompanied by other tools like Cricut EasyPress, the Infusible Ink system, and a diverse collection of materials. It operates through the following segments: Connected Machines, Subscriptions, and Accessories & Materials. The company was founded by Robert Workman in June 1969 and is headquartered in South Jordan, UT.
info.description_zh: Cricut, Inc. 經銷剪貼簿、工藝品和家居裝飾品。該公司的產品包括其旗艦切割機系列，如 Cricut Maker 系列、Cricut Explore 系列和 Cricut Joy，以及 Cricut EasyPress、Infusible Ink 系統和各種材料等其他工具。它透過以下部門運作：互聯機器、訂閱以及配件和材料。該公司由 Robert Workman 於 1969 年 6 月創立，總部位於猶他州南喬丹。

info.description: WEBs Consumer Discretionary XLY Defined Volatility ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLY Index (the "Index"). The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the consumer discretionary sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs 非必需消費品 XLY 定義波動率 ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax 定義波動率 XLY 指數（「指數」）表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場非必需消費品產業公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Dollar General Corp. engages in the operation of merchandise stores. Its offerings include food, snacks, health and beauty aids, cleaning supplies, basic apparel, housewares, and seasonal items. It sells brands including Clorox, Energizer, Procter & Gamble, Hanes, Coca-Cola, Mars, Unilever, Nestle, Kimberly-Clark, Kellogg's, General Mills, and PepsiCo. The company was founded by J. L. Turner and Hurley Calister Turner Sr. in 1939 and is headquartered in Goodlettsville, TN.
info.description_zh: Dollar General Corp. 從事商品店的經營。其產品包括食品、零食、健康和美容用品、清潔用品、基本服裝、家居用品和季節性商品。該公司銷售的品牌包括高樂氏 (Clorox)、勁量 (Energizer)、寶潔 (Procter & Gamble)、恆適 (Hanes)、可口可樂 (Coca-Cola)、瑪氏 (Mars)、聯合利華 (Unilever)、雀巢 (Nestle)、金佰利 (Kimberly-Clark)、Geneberly-Kers Mills、Geneberly-Kark Millss、Geneberly-Kers Millss、Geneberly-Kryce Mills） (PepsiCo)。該公司由 J. L. Turner 和 Hurley Calister Turner Sr. 於 1939 年創立，總部位於田納西州古德利茨維爾。

info.description: SSR Mining, Inc. is a metals mining company with assets located in four jurisdictions: the USA, Turkiye, Canada, and Argentina, which engages in the operation, acquisition, exploration and development of precious metal resource properties. The firm produces gold ore as well as copper, silver, lead and zinc concentrates. It operates through the following business segments: Copler, Marigold, Crippler Creek and Victor, Seabee and Puna. The company was founded on December 11, 1946 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: SSR Mining, Inc.是一家金屬礦業公司，資產分佈於美國、土耳其、加拿大和阿根廷四個司法管轄區，從事貴金屬資源資產的營運、收購、勘探和開發。該公司生產金礦石以及銅、銀、鉛和鋅精礦。該公司透過以下業務部門營運：Copler、Marigold、Crippler Creek 和 Victor、Seabee 和 Puna。該公司成立於 1946 年 12 月 11 日，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: Booking Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of online travel and related solutions. The firm offers services through the following brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK, and OpenTable. It provides accommodation reservations including hotels, hostels, apartments, vacation rentals, and other properties. The company was founded by Jay Scott Walker on July 18, 1997, and is headquartered in Norwalk, CT.
info.description_zh: Booking Holdings, Inc. 從事提供線上旅遊及相關解決方案。該公司透過以下品牌提供服務：Booking.com、Priceline、Agoda、KAYAK 和 OpenTable。它提供住宿預訂，包括酒店、旅館、公寓、度假出租屋和其他房產。該公司由 Jay Scott Walker 於 1997 年 7 月 18 日創立，總部位於康乃狄克州諾沃克。

info.description: Lowe's Companies, Inc. engages in the retail sale of home improvement products. The firm offers products for maintenance, repair, remodeling, home decorating, and property maintenance. It also provides home improvement products in the following categories: appliances, seasonal & outdoor living, lumber, lawn & garden, kitchens & bath, hardware, building materials, millwork, paint, rough plumbing, tools, electrical, flooring, and decor. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Mooresville, NC.
info.description_zh: Lowe's Companies, Inc. 從事家居裝修產品的零售業務。該公司提供用於維護、修理、改造、家居裝飾和物業維護的產品。它還提供以下類別的家居裝修產品：電器、季節性和戶外生活、木材、草坪和花園、廚房和浴室、五金、建築材料、木製品、油漆、粗糙管道、工具、電氣、地板和裝飾。該公司成立於 1946 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州穆爾斯維爾。

info.description: Yum! Brands, Inc. is a service restaurant company, which engages in the development, operation, franchise, and licenses of a system of restaurants. It operates through the following segments: KFC Division, Pizza Hut Division, Taco Bell Division, and Habit Burger Grill Division. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Louisville, KY.
info.description_zh: 嗯！ Brands, Inc. 是一家服務餐廳公司，從事餐廳系統的開發、營運、特許經營和許可業務。它透過以下部門運作：肯德基部門、必勝客部門、塔可鐘部門和Habit Burger Grill部門。該公司成立於 1997 年，總部位於肯塔基州路易斯維爾。

info.description: Aviat Networks, Inc. engages in the design, manufacturing, and sale of wireless networking and access networking solutions and services. Its products include microwave indoor units, private LTE/5G, and split-mount radio. The firm also offers services such as network planning and design, site surveys and construction, systems integration, installation, maintenance, network monitoring, training, and customer services. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Aviat Networks, Inc. 從事無線網路和接取網路解決方案及服務的設計、製造和銷售。其產品包括微波室內機、專用 LTE/5G 和分離式收音機。該公司還提供網路規劃和設計、現場勘察和施工、系統整合、安裝、維護、網路監控、培訓和客戶服務等服務。該公司成立於 1984 年，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Aya Gold & Silver, Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration and development of mineral properties. Its portfolio include Zgounder, Imiter bis, Boumadine, Amizmiz, and Azegour properties. Zgounder, Boumadine, Tirzzit, Tijirit, Imiter bis, Amizmiz, Azegour and Reserves & Resources. The company was founded by Rejean Gosselin on December 19, 2007 and is headquartered in Montreal, Canada.
info.description_zh: Aya Gold & Silver, Inc. 從事礦產收購、勘探和開發。其投資組合包括 Zgounder、Imiter bis、Boumadine、Amizmiz 和 Azegour 房地產。 Zgounder、Boumadine、Tirzzit、Tijirit、Imiter bis、Amizmiz、Azegour 以及儲備和資源。該公司由Rejean Gosselin於2007年12月19日創立，總部位於加拿大蒙特婁。

info.description: Moody's Corp. engages in the provision of credit ratings, research, tools and analysis to the global capital markets. It operates through the Moody's Investors Service (MIS) and Moody's Analytics (MA) segments. The MIS segment is a credit rating agency, which publishes credit ratings on debt obligations and the entities, including various corporate and governmental obligations, structured finance securities, and commercial paper programs. The MA segment develops products and services, which support financial analysis and risk management activities of institutional participants in global financial markets. The company was founded by John Moody in 1909 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: 穆迪公司致力於為全球資本市場提供信用評等、研究、工具和分析。它透過穆迪投資者服務公司（MIS）和穆迪分析公司（MA）部門運作。 MIS部門是一家信用評級機構，發布債務和實體的信用評級，包括各種公司和政府債務、結構性融資證券和商業票據計劃。 MA 部門開發產品和服務，支援全球金融市場機構參與者的財務分析和風險管理活動。該公司由 John Moody 於 1909 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Anixa Biosciences, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development of therapies and vaccines focused on oncology. It operates through the following segments: Cancer Vaccines, CAR-T Therapeutics, and Other. The Cancer Vaccines segment includes the early stages development of immunization for breast and ovarian cancer. The CAR-T Therapeutics segment is involved in the development of immuno-therapy drugs against cancer. The Other segment refers to its legacy operations, including patent licensing. The company was founded on November 5, 1982 and is headquartered San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Anixa Biosciences, Inc.是一家生物技術公司，致力於開發專注於腫瘤學的療法和疫苗。它透過以下部門運作：癌症疫苗、CAR-T 治療和其他。癌症疫苗部分包括乳癌和卵巢癌免疫的早期開發。 CAR-T Therapeutics 部門參與癌症免疫治療藥物的開發。其他部門指的是其遺留業務，包括專利許可。該公司成立於 1982 年 11 月 5 日，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Bone Biologics Corp. operates as a medical device company. It engages in the research and development of bone regeneration in spinal fusion. The firm's core product is NELL-1, which is an osteostimulative recombinant protein that provides target specific control over bone regeneration. Its platform technology has application in delivering improved outcomes in the surgical specialties of spinal, orthopedic, general orthopedic, plastic reconstruction, neurosurgery, interventional radiology, and sports medicine. The company was founded by Eric Kang Ting, Chia Soo and Benjamin Wu in 2004 and is headquartered in Burlington, MA.
info.description_zh: Bone Biologics Corp. 是一家醫療器材公司。致力於脊椎融合中骨再生的研究與發展。該公司的核心產品是 NELL-1，它是一種骨刺激重組蛋白，可為骨再生提供目標特異性控制。其平台技術可用於改善脊椎、骨科、一般骨科、整形重建、神經外科、介入放射學和運動醫學等外科專業的治療效果。該公司由 Eric Kang Ting、Chia Soo 和 Benjamin Wu 於 2004 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州伯靈頓。

info.description: HCA Healthcare, Inc. is a health care services company, which engages in operating hospitals, freestanding surgery centers and emergency care facilities, urgent care facilities, walk-in clinics, diagnostic and imaging centers, radiation and oncology therapy centers, comprehensive rehabilitation and physical therapy centers, physician practices, home health, hospice, outpatient physical therapy home and community-based services providers, and various other facilities. The firm operates general and acute care hospitals that offer medical and surgical services, including inpatient care, intensive care, cardiac care, diagnostic, and emergency services, and outpatient services, such as outpatient surgery, laboratory, radiology, respiratory therapy, cardiology, and physical therapy. The company was founded by Dr. Thomas F. Frist, Jr in 1968 and is headquartered in Nashville, TN.
info.description_zh: HCA Healthcare, Inc. 是一家醫療保健服務公司，從事營運醫院、獨立手術中心和緊急護理設施、緊急護理設施、步入式診所、診斷和成像中心、放射和腫瘤治療中心、綜合復健和物理治療中心、醫生診所、家庭保健、臨終關懷、門診物理治療家庭和社區服務提供者以及各種其他設施。該公司經營普通和急診醫院，提供醫療和外科服務，包括住院護理、重症監護、心臟護理、診斷和緊急服務，以及門診服務，如門診手術、實驗室、放射科、呼吸治療、心臟病學和物理治療。該公司由 Thomas F. Frist, Jr 博士於 1968 年創立，總部位於田納西州納許維爾。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long RTX Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of RTX. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of RTX, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 RTX 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 RTX 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的 RTX 價格每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Churchill Downs, Inc. is a provider of pari-mutuel horse racing, online account wagering on horse racing and casino gaming. It operates through the following segments: Live and Historical Racing, Wagering Services and Solutions, and Gaming. The Live and Historical Racing segment includes live and historical pari-mutuel racing related revenue and expenses at Churchill Downs Racetrack and historical racing properties in Kentucky, Virginia, and New Hampshire. The Wagering Services and Solutions focuses on the revenue and expenses from pari-mutuel wagers through TwinSpires, retail and online sports betting business, United Tote Company, and Exacta Systems, LLC. The Gaming segment is involved in the casino properties and associated racetracks which support the casino license. The company was founded in 1875 and is headquartered in Louisville, KY.
info.description_zh: Churchill Downs, Inc. 是一家彩池賽馬、賽馬線上帳戶投注和賭場遊戲提供商。它透過以下部門運作：現場和歷史賽馬、投注服務和解決方案以及遊戲。現場和歷史賽馬部門包括丘吉爾唐斯賽馬場的現場和歷史彩池賽馬相關收入和支出，以及肯塔基州、維吉尼亞州和新罕布夏州的歷史賽馬場館。投注服務和解決方案專注於透過 TwinSpires、零售和線上體育博彩業務、United Tote Company 和 Exacta Systems, LLC 進行派利分成投注的收入和支出。遊戲部門涉及賭場資產和支援賭場許可證的相關賽馬場。該公司成立於 1875 年，總部位於肯塔基州路易斯維爾。

info.description: iShares MSCI Global Gold Miners ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI ACWI Select Gold Miners Investable Market Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index has been developed by MSCI Inc. (the "index provider" or "MSCI") to target a minimum of 30 companies in developed and emerging markets that are involved in the business of gold mining. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 全球黃金礦業 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI ACWI 選擇黃金礦業可投資市場指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數由 MSCI Inc.（「指數提供者」或「MSCI」）開發，目標是已開發市場和新興市場中至少 30 家從事金礦開採業務的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Arm Holdings Plc engages in the licensing, marketing, research, and development of microprocessors, systems IP, graphics processing units, physical IP and associated systems IP, software, and tools. It operates through the following geographical segments: United Kingdom, United States, and Other Countries. The company was founded on November 12, 1990 and is headquartered in Cambridge, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Arm Holdings Plc 從事微處理器、系統 IP、圖形處理單元、實體 IP 和相關係統 IP、軟體和工具的授權、行銷、研究和開發。它透過以下地理區域運作：英國、美國和其他國家。該公司成立於1990年11月12日，總部位於英國劍橋。

info.description: Sprott Junior Copper Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Junior Copper Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, exploration, development, and production of copper. The index generally consists of from 25 to 45 constituents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott 初級銅礦 ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支之前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott 初級銅礦指數的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自銅礦開採、勘探、開發和生產的公司的表現。該指數通常由 25 至 45 隻成分股組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: LENSAR, Inc. engages in the development of femtosecond laser technology for refractive cataract surgery. Its product offers automation and customization options for astigmatism treatment planning and other steps of the refractive cataract surgery procedure. The company was founded by Scott Addyman, Randy W. Frey, and Ronald R. Krueger in 2004 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: LENSAR, Inc. engages in the development of femtosecond laser technology for refractive cataract surgery.其產品為散光治療計劃和屈光性白內障手術的其他步驟提供自動化和定制選項。 The company was founded by Scott Addyman, Randy W. Frey, and Ronald R. Krueger in 2004 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.

info.description: SuperCom Ltd. engages in the provision of traditional and digital identity solutions. It offers identification, tracking, and security products to government, private and public organization. It operates through the following divisions: e-Gov, Internet of Things (IoT), and Cyber Security. The e-Gov division provides solutions for traditional and biometrics enrollment, personalization, issuance and border control services. The IoT division products and services reliably identify, track, and monitor people or objects in real time, enabling the customers to detect unauthorized movement of people, vehicles, and monitored objects. The Cyber Security division is involved in the comprehensive solutions to protect the organization's sensitive data residing on servers, laptops, and detachable devices. The company was founded by Jack Hasan and Eli Rozen on July 4, 1988 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
info.description_zh: SuperCom Ltd. 從事提供傳統和數位身分解決方案。它為政府、私人和公共組織提供識別、追蹤和安全產品。它透過以下部門運作：電子化政府、物聯網 (IoT) 和網路安全。電子化政府部門為傳統和生物識別註冊、個人化、發行和邊境管制服務提供解決方案。物聯網部門的產品和服務能夠可靠地即時識別、追蹤和監控人員或物體，使客戶能夠偵測人員、車輛和受監控物體的未經授權的移動。網路安全部門參與全面的解決方案，以保護組織駐留在伺服器、筆記型電腦和可拆卸設備上的敏感資料。該公司由 Jack Hasan 和 Eli Rozen 於 1988 年 7 月 4 日創立，總部位於以色列特拉維夫。

info.description: Forward Industries, Inc. is a Solana focused digital asset treasury company, with the strategy to buy, hold, stake, trade, invest in, and grow SOL and SOL related digital assets, protocols and businesses. The firm mission is to expand and strengthen the Solana ecosystem by acquiring and staking SOL and engaging with, providing tools to and investing in the Solana network, Solana developers and Solana related projects in order to increase shareholder value. It operates through the following segments: Design and Digital Assets. The Design segment consists of two operating segments that provide a full spectrum of hardware and software product design and engineering services to customers predominantly located in the U.S. The Digital Assets segment captures SOL-based yield generated by participating in the Solana network's staking protocol, which currently comprises rewards received from native staking. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Forward Industries, Inc. 是一家專注於 Solana 的數位資產財務公司，其策略是購買、持有、入股、交易、投資和發展 SOL 以及 SOL 相關的數位資產、協議和業務。該公司的使命是透過收購和質押 SOL 以及與 Solana 網路、Solana 開發人員和 Solana 相關項目互動、提供工具和投資來擴大和加強 Solana 生態系統，以增加股東價值。它透過以下部門運作：設計和數位資產。設計部門由兩個營運部門組成，為主要位於美國的客戶提供全方位的硬體和軟體產品設計和工程服務。數位資產部門捕獲透過參與 Solana 網路的質押協議產生的基於 SOL 的收益，目前包括從本地質押獲得的獎勵。該公司成立於 1961 年，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Jowell Global Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of cosmetics, health and nutritional supplements, and household products through its e-commerce platform. It offers lotions, oral care, shampoo, soap, fragrance, vitamins, edible fungus, functional capsules, shoes, smartphones, cooking pot, and tampons. The company was founded on August 16, 2019 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Jowell Global Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of cosmetics, health and nutritional supplements, and household products through its e-commerce platform. It offers lotions, oral care, through its e-commerce platform. It , foters lotions, oral care, through its e-commerce platform, s, f5, functional, functional, f片, functional. shoes, smartphones, cooking pot, and tampons.公司成立于2019年8月16日，总部位于中国上海。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long ARM Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of ARM. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of ARM, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 ARM 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 ARM 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。它將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 ARM 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Garden Stage Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of placing and underwriting services. It also offers securities dealing and brokerage and asset management services. The company was founded on August 11, 2022 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Garden Stage Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事提供配售及包銷服務。它還提供證券交易、經紀和資產管理服務。該公司成立於2022年8月11日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Elevra Lithium Ltd. engages in the exploration, development, and mining of lithium raw materials. Its portfolio includes projects in Quebec, Canada, United States, Ghana and Western Australia. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Brisbane, Australia.
info.description_zh: Elevra Lithium Ltd.從事鋰原料的勘探、開發和開採。其投資組合包括魁北克、加拿大、美國、加納和西澳大利亞的項目。該公司成立於2000年，總部位於澳洲布里斯班。

info.description: NOVONIX Ltd. engages in the revolutionizing the global lithium-ion battery industry with innovative, sustainable technologies, high-performance materials, and more efficient production methods. The firm manufactures industry battery cell testing equipment, is growing its high-performance synthetic graphite material manufacturing operations, and has developed a patented all-dry, zero-waste cathode synthesis process. The firm operates through the following segments: Battery Materials, Battery Technology, and Graphite Exploration. NOVONIX was founded by Gregory Alexander John Baynton in April 2012 and is headquartered in Brisbane, Australia.
info.description_zh: NOVONIX Ltd. 致力於透過創新、永續技術、高性能材料和更有效率的生產方法徹底改變全球鋰離子電池產業。該公司製造工業電池測試設備，正在發展其高性能合成石墨材料製造業務，並開發了專利的全乾式、零廢物陰極合成流程。該公司透過以下部門運作：電池材料、電池技術和石墨勘探。 NOVONIX 由 Gregory Alexander John Baynton 於 2012 年 4 月創立，總部位於澳洲布里斯班。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Short SMCI ETF seeks daily inverse investment results, before fees and expenses, of -2 times (-200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Super Micro Computer, Inc. (Nasdaq: SMCI) and the fund does not seek to achieve its stated investment objective for a period other than a single trading day. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to achieve 2 times the inverse (-200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Short SMCI ETF 尋求每日反向投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 Super Micro Computer, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：SMCI）每日股價變化百分比的 -2 倍（-200%），並且該基金不尋求在單一交易日以外的期間實現其既定投資目標。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過採用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券價格每日百分比變化的 2 倍倒數（-200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: RTB Digital, Inc. operates as a financial technology company which is engaged in the deployment of Web3 media platform for media brands and clients. The company on April 10, 2007 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: RTB Digital, Inc. 是一家金融科技公司，致力於為媒體品牌和客戶部署 Web3 媒體平台。該公司於2007年4月10日成立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Fathom Holdings, Inc. is a national, technology driven, end to end real estate services company, which engages in the provision of residential, brokerage, mortgage, title, insurance, and SaaS offerings for brokers and agents. It operates through the following segments: Real Estate Brokerage, Mortgage, Technology, and Corporate and Other Services. The company was founded by Joshua Harley in January 2010 and is headquartered in Cary, NC.
info.description_zh: Fathom Holdings, Inc. 是一家全國性、技術驅動的端到端房地產服務公司，致力於為經紀人和代理商提供住宅、經紀、抵押貸款、產權、保險和 SaaS 產品。該公司透過以下部門運作：房地產經紀部門、抵押貸款部門、技術部門以及企業和其他服務部門。該公司由 Joshua Harley 於 2010 年 1 月創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州卡里。

info.description: Eshallgo, Inc. operates as a holding company, which through its subsidiaries and controlled entities engages in the sale and lease of office equipment and related maintenance services. The company was founded by Zhi Dan Mao and Qi Wei Miao in 2015 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Eshallgo, Inc. 作為控股公司運營，透過其子公司和受控實體從事辦公設備的銷售和租賃以及相關維護服務。該公司由毛志丹和苗齊偉於2015年創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: WhiteFiber, Inc. provides AI and HPC infrastructure & cloud and data center solutions. It operates through the following segments: Cloud Services and Colocation Services. The Cloud Services segment offers computing services to support generative AI workstreams. The Colocation Services segment provides customers with physical space, power and cooling within the data center facility. The company was founded on August 15, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: WhiteFiber, Inc. 提供人工智慧和 HPC 基礎架構以及雲端和資料中心解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：雲端服務和託管服務。雲端服務部門提供運算服務來支援生成式人工智慧工作流程。託管服務部門為客戶提供資料中心設施內的實體空間、電力和冷卻。該公司成立於2024年8月15日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long HIMS ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Hims & Hers Health Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long HIMS ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前達到 Hims & Hers Health Inc. 股價每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金 (“ETF”)，試圖透過使用衍生性商品，即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約，實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的結果。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Myseum.AI, Inc. operates as a communication software company. Its product, DatChat Messenger & Private Social Network, is a mobile application that gives users the ability to communicate with privacy and protection. The company's DatChat application allows users to exercise control over their messages, even after they are sent. Through the application, users can delete messages that they have sent on their own device and the recipient's device as well. Its DatChat application also enables users to hide secret and encrypted messages behind a cover, which messages can only be unlocked by the recipient and which are automatically destroyed after a fixed number of views or fixed amount of time and also includes a screen shot protection system, which makes it virtually impossible for the recipient to screenshot a message or picture before it gets destroyed. Its application also integrates with iMessage, making private messages potentially available to hundreds of millions of users. The company was founded by Darin M. Myman and Peter Shelus on December 4, 2014 and is headquartered in New Brunswick, NJ.
info.description_zh: Myseum.AI, Inc. 是一家通訊軟體公司。其產品 DatChat Messenger & Private Social Network 是一款行動應用程序，使用戶能夠在隱私和保護的情況下進行通訊。該公司的 DatChat 應用程式允許用戶對其訊息進行控制，甚至在訊息發送後也是如此。透過該應用程序，用戶可以刪除他們在自己的裝置和收件人的裝置上發送的訊息。其 DatChat 應用程式還使用戶能夠將秘密和加密的訊息隱藏在封面後面，這些訊息只能由收件人解鎖，並且在固定的查看次數或固定的時間後自動銷毀，並且還包括螢幕截圖保護系統，這使得收件人幾乎不可能在訊息或圖片被銷毀之前對其進行螢幕截圖。其應用程式還與 iMessage 集成，使數億用戶可以使用私人訊息。該公司由 Darin M. Myman 和 Peter Shelus 於 2014 年 12 月 4 日創立，總部位於新澤西州新不倫瑞克。

info.description: BioAge Labs, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of therapeutic products for metabolic diseases, such as obesity, by targeting the biology of human beings. It offers Azelaprag, a potential oral therapeutic for obesity, followed by several earlier-stage metabolic programs. The company was founded by Kristen Fortney and Eric Morgen on April 1, 2015 and is headquartered in Emeryville, CA.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: BioAge Labs, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於針對人類生物學開發針對肥胖等代謝疾病的治療產品。它提供了 Azelaprag，一種潛在的肥胖口服療法，隨後推出了幾個早期代謝項目。該公司由 Kristen Fortney 和 Eric Morgen 於 2015 年 4 月 1 日創立，總部位於加州埃默里維爾。

info.description: Fluent, Inc. engages in the provision of digital marketing services. It operates through the following segments: Fluent, Call Solutions, and AdParlor. The Fluent segment includes delivering data and performance-based marketing executions. The company was founded by Ryan Schulke and Matthew Conlin in 2001 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Fluent, Inc. 從事提供數位行銷服務。它透過以下部門運作：Fluent、Call Solutions 和 AdParlor。 Fluent 部分包括提供數據和基於績效的行銷執行。該公司由 Ryan Schulke 和 Matthew Conlin 於 2001 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Alterity Therapeutics Ltd. is a clinical stage biotechnology company. It engages in the business of research and development of therapeutic drugs designed to treat the underlying cause of degeneration of the brain focusing on Alzheimer's, Huntington, Parkinson's, and other neurological disorders. The company was founded by Geoffrey Paul Kempler on November 11, 1997 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
info.description_zh: Alterity Therapeutics Ltd. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司。該公司從事治療藥物的研發業務，旨在治療大腦退化的根本原因，並專注於阿茲海默症、亨廷頓氏症、帕金森氏症和其他神經系統疾病。該公司由Geoffrey Paul Kempler於1997年11月11日創立，總部位於澳洲墨爾本。

info.description: Oriental Rise Holdings Ltd. engages in the cultivation, processing, and sale of tea leaves and tea products. It operates through the Primarily-Processes Teas and Refined Teas segments. The company was founded by Chun Sun Wong, Wai Kwong Fong and Deming Zhou on January 25, 2019 and is headquartered in Ningde, China.
info.description_zh: 東方崛起控股有限公司從事茶葉及茶產品的種植、加工及銷售。它透過初加工茶和精製茶部門運作。該公司由Chun Sun Wong、Wai Kwong Fong和Deming Zhou於2019年1月25日創立，總部位於中國寧德。

info.description: TriMas Corp. engages in the manufacture of industrial products for customers in the consumer products, aerospace, industrial, petrochemical, refinery, and oil and gas end markets. It operates through the following segments: Packaging and Specialty Products. The Packaging segment develops and manufactures dispensing products, polymeric and steel caps and closures, polymeric jar products, and fully integrated dispensers for fill-ready bag-in-box applications, beauty and personal care, home care, food and beverage, and pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products. The Specialty Products segment focuses on designing, manufacturing, and distribution of highly-engineered steel cylinders for use within industrial and aerospace markets. The company was founded by Brian P. Campbell in 1986 and is headquartered in Bloomfield Hills, MI.
info.description_zh: TriMas Corp. 為消費品、航太、工業、石化、煉油廠以及石油和天然氣終端市場的客戶製造工業產品。它透過以下部門運作：包裝和特殊產品部門。包裝部門開發和製造分配產品、聚合物和鋼蓋和封閉件、聚合物罐產品以及用於填充盒中袋應用、美容和個人護理、家庭護理、食品和飲料以及製藥和營養產品的完全集成分配器。特種產品部門專注於設計、製造和分銷用於工業和航空航太市場的高度工程鋼瓶。該公司由 Brian P. Campbell 於 1986 年創立，總部位於密西根州布魯姆菲爾德山。

info.description: Asia Pacific Wire & Cable Corp. Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the business of owning operating companies in the power cable, telecommunication cable, enameled wire, and electronic cable industry. It operates through the following segments: North Asia, Thailand, and Rest of the World. The company was founded on September 19, 1996 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: 亞太電線電纜有限公司是一家控股公司，從事電力電纜、通訊電纜、漆包線、電子電纜行業的自營經營公司業務。它透過以下部門運作：北亞、泰國和世界其他地區。公司成立於1996年9月19日，總部位於台灣台北。

info.description: Dover Corp. operates as a manufacturer and solutions provider delivering innovative equipment and components, consumable supplies, aftermarket parts, software and digital solutions, and support services. It operates through the following segments: Engineered Products, Clean Energy and Fueling, Imaging and Identification, Pumps and Process Solutions, and Climate and Sustainability Technologies. The Engineered Products segment provides various equipment, components, software, solutions and services to the vehicle aftermarket, aerospace and defense, industrial winch and hoist, precision soldering and fluid dispensing end-markets. The Clean Energy and Fueling segment focuses on the components, equipment, software, solutions and services enabling safe and reliable storage, transport and dispensing of traditional and clean fuels, cryogenic gases, and other hazardous substances along the supply chain, and safe and efficient operation of convenience retail, retail fueling and vehicle wash establishments, as well as facilities where cryogenic gases are produced, stored or consumed. The Imaging and Identification segment supplies precision marking and coding, product traceability, brand protection and digital textile printing equipment, as well as related consumables, software and services to the global packaged and consumer goods, pharmaceutical, industrial manufacturing, textile and other end-markets. The Pumps and Process Solutions segment consists of specialty pumps and flow meters, highly engineered precision components for rotating and reciprocating machines, fluid connecting solutions and plastics and polymer processing equipment, serving single-use biopharmaceutical production, diversified industrial manufacturing, chemical production, plastics and polymer processing, midstream and downstream oil and gas and other end markets. The Climate and Sustainability Technologies segment refers to innovative and energy-efficient equipment, components and parts for the commercial refrigeration, equipment and systems, heating and cooling, and beverage can-making equipment markets. The company was founded by George L. Ohrstrom in 1947 and is headquartered in Downers Grove, IL.
info.description_zh: Dover Corp. 是一家製造商和解決方案提供商，提供創新設備和組件、消耗品、售後零件、軟體和數位解決方案以及支援服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：工程產品部門、清潔能源和燃料部門、成像和識別部門、泵浦和製程解決方案部門以及氣候和永續發展技術部門。工程產品部門為汽車售後市場、航空航太和國防、工業絞車和起重機、精密焊接和流體點膠終端市場提供各種設備、組件、軟體、解決方案和服務。清潔能源和燃料部門專注於組件、設備、軟體、解決方案和服務，以實現供應鏈上傳統和清潔燃料、低溫氣體和其他危險物質的安全可靠的儲存、運輸和分配，以及便利零售、零售加油和洗車設施以及低溫氣體生產、儲存或消費設施的安全和高效運作。影像和識別部門為全球包裝和消費品、製藥、工業製造、紡織和其他終端市場提供精密標記和編碼、產品可追溯性、品牌保護和數位紡織印刷設備以及相關耗材、軟體和服務。泵浦和製程解決方案部門包括特種泵浦和流量計、用於旋轉和往復式機器的高度工程化的精密零件、流體連接解決方案以及塑膠和聚合物加工設備，服務於一次性生物製藥生產、多元化工業製造、化學品生產、塑膠和聚合物加工、中游和下游石油和天然氣以及其他終端市場。氣候和永續發展技術部門是指用於商業冷凍、設備和系統、加熱和冷卻以及飲料罐製造設備市場的創新和節能設備、零件。該公司由 George L. Ohrstrom 於 1947 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州唐納斯格羅夫。

info.description: Invesco DWA Emerging Markets Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Emerging Markets Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is comprised of equity securities of large capitalization companies based in countries classified as emerging markets.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Emerging Markets Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Emerging Markets Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數由新興市場國家的大型資本公司的股本證券組成。

info.description: Avantis Emerging Markets Ex-China Equity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of companies related to emerging market countries, excluding those domiciled in China. The fund's managers consider an emerging market country to be any country other than a developed country.
