info.description: iShares MSCI Europe Financials ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Europe Financials Index composed of developed market European equities in the financials sector. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to measure the combined equity market performance of the financials sector of developed market countries in Europe.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 歐洲金融 ETF 旨在追蹤由已開發市場歐洲金融部門股票組成的 MSCI 歐洲金融指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量歐洲已開發市場國家金融部門的綜合股票市場表現。

info.description: VictoryShares International Free Cash Flow Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Victory International Growth Free Cash Flow Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity securities of non-U.S. developed markets of growth companies.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares International Free Cash Flow Growth ETF 力求提供在扣除費用和開支之前與 Victory International Growth 自由現金流指數的表現密切相關的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金尋求透過將至少80%的資產投資於指數證券來實現其投資目標。該指數旨在提供對非美國已開發市場成長型公司股票證券的投資。

info.description: Engine No. 1 Transform Supply Chain ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that invests in U.S.-listed equity, ADR securities, and non-U.S. developed and emerging market-listed securities, which over time may vary as market and investment opportunities change. The fund may also enter into currency-related spot transactions when it transacts in equities denominated in foreign currencies or invest in certain derivative instruments, such as currency futures or forwards that will help the adviser manage risk associated with foreign currency exposure, if any, or futures contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 一號引擎變革供應鏈ETF尋求資本的長期成長。該基金是主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），投資於美國上市股票、ADR 證券以及非美國已開發和新興市場上市證券，隨著時間的推移，這些證券可能會隨著市場和投資機會的變化而變化。當基金進行以外幣計價的股票交易或投資某些衍生性商品（例如貨幣期貨或遠期合約）時，也可能會進行與貨幣相關的現貨交易，這將有助於顧問管理與外幣風險（如有）或期貨合約相關的風險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ProShares Nasdaq-100 Dorsey Wright Momentum ETF seeks investment results, before fees and expenses, that track the performance of the Nasdaq-100 Dorsey Wright Momentum Index (the "index"). The index, which is constructed and maintained by Dorsey, Wright & Associates, LLC (Dorsey Wright), consists of 21 securities from the Nasdaq-100 Index with the highest price momentum. The fund will invest principally in the Equities and Depositary Receipts which principally include ADRs. It will concentrate or focus its investments in a particular industry or group of industries, country or region to approximately the same extent the index is so concentrated or focused. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Nasdaq-100 Dorsey Wright Momentum ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前追蹤 Nasdaq-100 Dorsey Wright Momentum Index（「指數」）表現的投資結果。該指數由 Dorsey, Wright & Associates, LLC (Dorsey Wright) 建構和維護，由 Nasdaq-100 指數中價格動量最高的 21 種證券組成。該基金將主要投資於股票和存託憑證，其中主要包括美國存託憑證。它將把投資集中或集中在特定產業或產業組、國家或地區，其程度與指數的集中程度大致相同。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. V is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 27, 2024 and is headquartered in Memphis, TN.
info.description_zh: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. V 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年11月27日，總部位於田納西州孟菲斯。

info.description: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Choice ESG Screened 5% Issuer Capped Index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of large- and mid-capitalization emerging market companies with favorable ESG ratings while applying extensive screens, including removing fossil fuel exposure. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EM ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場選擇 ESG 篩選 5% 發行人上限指數的投資結果。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 評級的大中型新興市場公司的股票表現，同時應用廣泛的篩選，包括消除化石燃料風險。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於指數成分證券以及與指數成分證券具有基本相同經濟特徵的投資。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco DWA SmallCap Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright SmallCap Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of approximately 200 securities from an eligible universe of approximately 2,000 securities ranked 1,001 to 3,000 by market capitalization within the NASDAQ US Benchmark Index.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA SmallCap Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright SmallCap Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由約 200 只證券組成，這些證券來自納斯達克美國基準指數市值排名 1,001 至 3,000 名的約 2,000 只合格證券。

info.description: Catalyst Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company. It provides savings and loan banking services through its subsidiary, Catalyst Bank. The company was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Opelousas, LA.
info.description_zh: Catalyst Bancorp, Inc. 以銀行控股公司營運。它透過其子公司 Catalyst Bank 提供儲蓄和貸款銀行服務。該公司成立於 1922 年，總部位於路易斯安那州奧佩盧薩斯。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSM ETF is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. Ltd. (TSM) ADR. By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the performance of the underlying leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSM ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤台積電 (TSM) ADR 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌期權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 績效的曝險，但須遵守潛在投資收益的上限。

info.description: Willis Lease Finance Corp. engages in the provision of aviation services and operating leases of commercial aircraft, aircraft engines, and other aircraft-related equipment to air carriers, manufacturers, and overhaul/repair facilities. It operates through the Leasing and Related Operations, and Spare Parts Sales. The Leasing and Related Operations segment acquires and leases commercial aircraft and aircraft engines, and the selective purchase and resale of commercial aircraft engines and other aircraft equipment and other related businesses. The Spare Parts Sales segment includes the purchase and resale of after-market engine parts, whole engines, engine modules, and portable aircraft components. The company was founded by Charles F. Willis, IV in 1985 and is headquartered in Coconut Creek, FL.
info.description_zh: Willis Lease Finance Corp. 從事向航空公司、製造商和大修/維修設施提供航空服務以及商用飛機、飛機發動機和其他飛機相關設備的營業租賃。它透過租賃和相關業務以及備件銷售進行營運。租賃及相關業務部門收購和租賃商用飛機和飛機發動機，以及選擇性購買和轉售商用飛機發動機和其他飛機設備及其他相關業務。備件銷售部門包括售後發動機零件、整個發動機、發動機模組和便攜式飛機部件的購買和轉售。該公司由 Charles F. Willis, IV 於 1985 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州椰子溪。

info.description: BlackRock Long-Term U.S. Equity ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital growth. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of U.S. issuers and derivatives with similar economic characteristics. It may invest up to 20% of its assets in equity securities of foreign issuers, including ADRs and GDRs. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德長期美國股票 ETF 致力於實現長期資本成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於美國發行人的股本證券和具有類似經濟特徵的衍生性商品。它可以將最多 20% 的資產投資於外國發行人的股本證券，包括 ADR 和 GDR。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: CVD Equipment Corp. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of chemical vapor deposition, gas control, and other state-of-the-art equipment and process solutions. It operates through the following segments: Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) Equipment, Stainless Design Concepts (SDC), and MesoScribe. The CVD Equipment segment includes manufacturing of chemical vapor deposition, physical vapor transport, and thermal process equipment. The SDC segment focuses on manufacturing of ultra-high purity gas and chemical delivery control systems. The MesoScribe segment provides electronic printing services and products. The company was founded by Leonard A. Rosenbaum on October 13, 1982 and is headquartered in Central Islip, NY.
info.description_zh: CVD Equipment Corp. 從事化學氣相沉積、氣體控制以及其他最先進的設備和製程解決方案的設計、開發和製造。該公司透過以下部門運作：化學氣相沉積 (CVD) 設備部門、不銹鋼設計概念 (SDC) 部門和 MesoScribe 部門。 CVD 設備部門包括化學氣相沉積、物理氣相傳輸和熱處理設備的製造。 SDC 部門專注於超高純度氣體和化學品輸送控制系統的製造。 MesoScribe 部門提供電子列印服務和產品。該公司由 Leonard A. Rosenbaum 於 1982 年 10 月 13 日創立，總部位於紐約州中部艾斯利普。

info.description: M3-Brigade Acquisition V Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on March 12, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: M3-Brigade Acquisition V Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年3月12日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Allbirds, Inc. is a global lifestyle brand that innovates with naturally derived materials to make footwear and apparel products in a better way, while treading lighter on the planet. It offers Men's Shoes, Women's Shoes, Men's Apparel, Women's Apparel, Socks, and Gift Cards. The company was founded by Timothy Brown and Joseph Zev Zwillinger on May 6, 2015 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Allbirds, Inc. 是一個全球生活風格品牌，利用天然材料進行創新，以更好的方式製造鞋類和服裝產品，同時在地球上邁出更輕的腳步。它提供男鞋、女鞋、男裝、女裝、襪子和禮品卡。該公司由 Timothy Brown 和 Joseph Zev Zwillinger 於 2015 年 5 月 6 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Global X NASDAQ 100 Risk Managed Income ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq-100 Monthly Net Credit Collar 95-100 Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the Nasdaq-100 Monthly Net Credit Collar 95-100 Index ("underlying index"). The underlying index measures the performance of a risk managed income strategy that holds the underlying stocks of the NASDAQ 100 Index and applies an options collar strategy (i.e., a mix of short (sold) call options and long (purchased) put options) on the NASDAQ 100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 風險管理收益 ETF 力求提供與 Nasdaq-100 月淨信用領 95-100 指數的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於 Nasdaq-100 Monthly Net Credit Collar 95-100 Index（「基礎指數」）的證券。標的指數衡量風險管理收益策略的表現，該策略持有納斯達克 100 指數的標的股票，並對納斯達克 100 指數應用期權領策略（即空頭（賣出）看漲期權和多頭（買入）看跌期權的組合）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: BranchOut Food, Inc. engages in the development, marketing, sale, and distribution of plant-based, dehydrated fruit, and vegetable snacks and powders. Its products include pineapple chips, chewy banana bites, crunchy strawberry halves, bell pepper crisps, and carrot sticks. The company was founded by Eric Healy and David Israel on February 21, 2017 and is headquartered in Bend, OR.
info.description_zh: BranchOut Food, Inc. 從事植物性脫水水果和蔬菜零食及粉末的開發、行銷、銷售和分銷。其產品包括鳳梨片、耐嚼香蕉片、脆脆草莓片、甜椒片和胡蘿蔔條。該公司由 Eric Healy 和 David Israel 於 2017 年 2 月 21 日創立，總部位於俄勒岡州本德。

info.description: Pantages Capital Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on May 31, 2024 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Pantages Capital Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2024年5月31日，總部位於德拉瓦州威爾明頓。

info.description: Churchill Capital Corp. XI is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded by Michael Stuart Klein on June 4, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Churchill Capital Corp. XI 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司由 Michael Stuart Klein 於 2025 年 6 月 4 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Innovation Leaders ETF (TNXT) is an actively managed fund targeting long-term capital growth by investing in a diversified portfolio of companies identified as global leaders in disruptive innovation. The strategy integrates a top-down evaluation of secular growth trends with a fundamental bottom-up analysis to select 150 to 250 high-quality companies distinguished by advanced technologies, superior business models, and significant research and development expenditures.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price Innovation Leaders ETF (TNXT) 是一檔積極管理的基金，透過投資於被認定為全球顛覆性創新領導者的公司的多元化投資組合，實現長期資本成長。該策略將長期成長趨勢自上而下的評估與自下而上的基本分析相結合，選出150至250家以先進技術、卓越商業模式和大量研發支出為特色的優質公司。

info.description: Astoria US Quality Growth Kings ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities (including depositary receipts) of issuers outside the U.S. that the fund's sub-adviser, Astoria Portfolio Advisors, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser") believes has the potential for growth.
info.description_zh: Astoria US Quality Growth Kings ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在正常情況下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於美國境外發行人的股本證券（包括存託憑證）來實現其投資目標，該基金的副顧問 Astoria Portfolio, LLC（「顧問」具有成長潛力）。

info.description: Burney U.S. Factor Rotation ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks long term growth of capital. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in U.S. listed common stock. The fund will invest its assets in common stocks of large, mid, and small-capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Burney U.S. Factor Rotation ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks long term growth of capital.在正常藉錢The fund will invest its assets in common stocks of large, mid, and small-capitalization companies.

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2026 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2026, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2026 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2026年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Aeries Technology Inc. engages in the provision of professional and technology consulting services, to portfolio companies of private equity firms and middle market companies, specializing in the design, set-up, and management of Global Capability Centers for clients. It operates through the North America and Asia Pacific and Other geographical segments. The company was founded by Venu Raman Kumar and Sudhir Appukuttan Panikassery in 2012 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Aeries Technology Inc. 致力於為私募股權公司和中間市場公司的投資組合公司提供專業和技術諮詢服務，專門為客戶設計、建立和管理全球能力中心。它透過北美、亞太地區和其他地區部門開展業務。該公司由 Venu Raman Kumar 和 Sudhir Appukuttan Panikassery 於 2012 年創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: abrdn Emerging Markets Dividend Active ETF seeks total return consisting of income and long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of emerging market companies that pay dividend income. The fund will invest primarily in common stocks but may also invest in other types of equity securities, including, but not limited to, preferred stock and depositary receipts.
info.description_zh: abrdn 新興市場股息主動 ETF 尋求由收入和長期資本增值組成的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產價值以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於支付股息收入的新興市場公司的股本證券。該基金將主要投資於普通股，但也可能投資於其他類型的股本證券，包括但不限於優先股和存託憑證。

info.description: StoneBridge Acquisition II Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 19, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: StoneBridge Acquisition II Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年6月19日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Aveanna Healthcare Holdings, Inc. engages in providing home care services to patients. It operates through the following business segments: Private Duty Services (PDS), Home Health & Hospice (HHH), and Medical Solutions (MS). The PDS segment includes private duty nursing services. The HHH segment provides home health, hospice, and program services to predominately elderly populations. The MS segment offers supplies to patients requiring enteral nutrition services or respiratory care. The company was founded on November 30, 2016 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Aveanna Healthcare Holdings, Inc. 致力於為患者提供家庭護理服務。該公司透過以下業務部門運作：私人值班服務 (PDS)、家庭健康和臨終關懷 (HHH) 以及醫療解決方案 (MS)。 PDS 部門包括私人護理服務。 HHH 部門主要為老年人提供家庭健康、臨終關懷和計畫服務。 MS 部門為需要腸內營養服務或呼吸照護的患者提供用品。該公司成立於2016年11月30日，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Biofrontera, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the commercialization of pharmaceutical products. It specializes in the treatment of dermatological conditions, caused primarily by exposure to sunlight that results in sun damage to the skin. The company focuses on the treatment of actinic keratosis and markets a topical antibiotic for treatment of impetigo. Its products include Ameluz and Xepi, its two prescription drugs, and BF-RhodoLED, a lamp used with Ameluz, for the lesion-directed and field-directed treatment of actinic keratosis of mild-to-moderate severity on the face and scalp. The company was founded on March 3, 2015 and is headquartered in Woburn, MA.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Biofrontera, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，從事醫藥產品的商業化。它專門治療皮膚病，這些疾病主要是由於暴露在陽光下導致皮膚受到陽光損傷而引起的。該公司專注於光化性角化症的治療，並銷售用於治療膿皰瘡的外用抗生素。其產品包括兩種處方藥 Ameluz 和 Xepi，以及與 Ameluz 配合使用的 BF-RhodoLED 燈，用於針對面部和頭皮輕至中度嚴重的光化性角化病進行病灶定向和現場定向治療。該公司成立於2015年3月3日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州沃本。

info.description: Blue Bird Corp. engages in the design and manufacture of school buses. It operates through the Bus and Parts segments. The Bus segment includes the manufacturing and assembly of school buses to be sold to a variety of customers across the United States, Canada, and in international markets. The Parts segment focuses on the purchases of parts from third parties to be sold to dealers within the company's network and certain large fleet customers. The company was founded by Albert Laurence Luce in 1927 and is headquartered in Macon, GA.
info.description_zh: 藍鳥公司從事校車的設計和製造。它透過巴士和零件部門運作。巴士部門包括校車的製造和組裝，銷往美國、加拿大和國際市場的各種客戶。零件部門專注於從第三方購買零件，然後出售給公司網路內的經銷商和某些大型車隊客戶。該公司由 Albert Laurence Luce 於 1927 年創立，總部位於喬治亞州梅肯。

info.description: CDT Equity, Inc. engages in facilitating the development and commercialization of clinical assets. The company was founded by David Joszef Tapolczay and Freda C. Lewis-Hall in October 2021 is headquartered in Naples, FL.
info.description_zh: CDT Equity, Inc. 致力於促進臨床資產的開發和商業化。該公司由 David Joszef Tapolczay 和 Freda C. Lewis-Hall 於 2021 年 10 月創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州那不勒斯。

info.description: Design Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a biotechnology company that develops therapies for serious degenerative disorders. It is created to design, develop and commercialize a novel class of small molecule therapeutic candidates (GeneTACs) designed to directly address the underlying basis of genetic disease. The company was founded by Pratik Shah and Aseem Z. Ansari on December 18, 2017 and is headquartered in Carlsbad, CA.
info.description_zh: Design Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家生技公司，開發嚴重退化性疾病的療法。它的創建是為了設計、開發和商業化一類新型小分子候選治療藥物 (GeneTAC)，旨在直接解決遺傳疾病的根本問題。該公司由 Pratik Shah 和 Asem Z. Ansari 於 2017 年 12 月 18 日創立，總部位於加州卡爾斯巴德。

info.description: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright Short ETF seeks capital appreciation through short selling securities. Dorsey, Wright & Associates, LLC (the "Sub-Advisor") seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by obtaining short exposure to investment returns of the broad U.S. large-capitalization equity market by engaging in short sales of U.S.-traded equity securities and exchange-traded funds ("ETFs"). Under normal circumstances, it invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in investments that create or result in short exposure to U.S. equity securities.
info.description_zh: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright Short ETF 透過賣空證券尋求資本增值。 Dorsey, Wright & Associates, LLC（「副顧問」）尋求透過賣空美國交易的股票證券和交易所交易基金（「ETF」）來獲得廣泛的美國大盤股市場的投資回報，從而實現基金的投資目標。在正常情況下，其將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於產生或導緻美國股本證券空頭敞口的投資。

info.description: Entera Bio Ltd. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of orally delivered large molecule therapeutics. It s pipeline include PTH(1-34), GLP-1 and GLP-2. The company was founded on September 30, 2009 and is headquartered in Jerusalem, Israel.
info.description_zh: Entera Bio Ltd.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，從事口服大分子治療藥物的開發和商業化。其管線包括PTH(1-34)、GLP-1和GLP-2。該公司成立於2009年9月30日，總部位於以色列耶路撒冷。

info.description: Energy Services of America Corp. is a contractor and service company. It operates through the following segments: Underground Infrastructure Construction, Industrial Construction, and Building Construction. The Underground Infrastructure Construction segment primarily includes water and wastewater pipelines, natural gas distribution pipelines, natural gas transmission pipelines, natural gas stations and ancillary facilities, corrosion protection services, and horizontal drilling services. The Industrial Constructions segment involves electrical, mechanical, HVAC/R, controls, and fire protection services in automotive, chemical, power, and manufacturing facilities. The Building Construction segment refers to schools, local and state buildings, and small bridge projects. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Huntington, WV.
info.description_zh: 美國能源服務公司是一家承包商和服務公司。它透過以下部門運作：地下基礎設施建設、工業建築和建築施工。地下基礎設施建設部門主要包括供水和污水管道、天然氣分配管道、天然氣輸送管道、天然氣站及附屬設施、腐蝕防護服務以及水平鑽井服務。工業建築部門涉及汽車、化學、電力和製造設施中的電氣、機械、HVAC/R、控制和消防服務。建築施工部分指學校、地方和州建築以及小型橋樑工程。該公司成立於 2006 年，總部位於西維吉尼亞州亨廷頓。

info.description: Harvard Ave Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 15, 2024 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
info.description_zh: 哈佛大道收購公司是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、資本股票交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年8月15日，總部位於韓國首爾。

info.description: Vaneck Robotics ETF seeks to track as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the BlueStar Robotics Index (the "index"). The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in Robotics Companies. The index is comprised of equity securities, which may include depositary receipts of global exchange-listed companies in the robotics industry. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Vaneck Robotics ETF 力求在費用和支出之前盡可能密切地追蹤 BlueStar Robotics Index（「指數」）的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於機器人公司。該指數由股本證券組成，其中可能包括機器人產業全球交易所上市公司的存託憑證。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invest Green Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded by Matthew Kiernan and Andrew McLean on April 7, 2025 and is headquartered in Camas, WA.
info.description_zh: Invest Green Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司營運。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業或實體合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Matthew Kiernan 和 Andrew McLean 於 2025 年 4 月 7 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州卡馬斯。

info.description: InterCure Ltd. engages in the provision of business of medical cannabis and biomedicine. It operates through the Investments in Biomed Portfolio Companies in the Biomed Sector and Investments in the Medical Cannabis Sector segments. The company was founded by Benjamin Gavish and Erez Gavish on November 20, 1994 and is headquartered in Herzliya, Israel.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: InterCure Ltd.從事提供醫用大麻和生物醫學業務。它透過對生物醫學領域的生物醫學投資組合公司的投資和對醫用大麻領域的投資進行運作。該公司由Benjamin Gavish和Erez Gavish於1994年11月20日創立，總部位於以色列荷茲利亞。

info.description: Lifeway Foods, Inc. engages in the manufacture of probiotic and nutritious foods. The firm's products include kefir, organic kefir, probiotic smoothie with collagen, muscle mates, probugs, and cheese. It distributes its products primarily through its direct sales force, brokers, and distributors. The company was founded by Michael Smolyansky and Ludmila Smolyansky in February 1986 and is headquartered in Morton Grove, IL.
info.description_zh: Lifeway Foods, Inc. 從事益生菌和營養食品的製造。該公司的產品包括克菲爾、有機克菲爾、含膠原蛋白的益生菌冰沙、肌肉伴侶、益生菌和起司。它主要透過其直銷隊伍、經紀人和分銷商分銷其產品。該公司由 Michael Smolyansky 和 ​​Ludmila Smolyansky 於 1986 年 2 月創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州莫頓格羅夫。

info.description: Motley Fool Momentum Factor ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the total return performance of the Motley Fool Momentum Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's total assets will be invested in the component securities of the index. The Adviser expects that, over time, if it has sufficient assets, the correlation between the fund's performance and that of the index, before fees and expenses, will be 95% or better. The fund will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it generally will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Motley Fool Momentum Factor ETF 尋求與 Motley Fool Momentum Index 的總回報表現大致相符的投資結果。一般情況下，基金總資產至少80%會投資於指數成分證券。顧問預計，隨著時間的推移，如果擁有足夠的資產，在扣除費用和開支之前，基金績效與指數績效之間的相關性將達到 95% 或更高。該基金通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它通常會投資於該指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Mirum Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company. The firm focuses on the development and commercialization of a late-stage pipeline of novel therapies for debilitating liver diseases. Its products include Maralixibat and Volixibat. The company was founded by Niall O'Donnel, Michael Grey and Christopher Peetz in May 2018 and is headquartered in Foster City, CA.
info.description_zh: Mirum Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司。該公司專注於治療衰弱性肝病的後期新療法的開發和商業化。其產品包括Maralixibat和Volixibat。該公司由 Niall O'Donnel、Michael Gray 和 Christopher Peetz 於 2018 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州福斯特城。

info.description: Neurogene, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of product portfolio of genetic medicines for rare neurological diseases. The company was founded in May 2007 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Neurogene, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，從事罕見神經疾病基因藥物產品組合的開發。該公司成立於2007年5月，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: OneConstruction Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the procurement and installation of structural steel for construction projects. It is involved in performing site preparatory and preliminary works, developing detailed work schedules and work allocation plans, implementing construction site works, and conducting site safety supervision and quality control. The company was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: OneConstruction Group Ltd. 是一家控股公司，從事建築項目結構鋼的採購和安裝業務。它參與進行現場準備和前期工作，制定詳細的工作時間表和工作分配計劃，實施施工現場工作，並進行現場安全監督和品質控制。該公司成立於2021年，總部位於香港。

info.description: SC II Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 30, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: SC II Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月30日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Savara, Inc. is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of novel therapies for the treatment of serious or life-threatening rare respiratory diseases. Its program includes molgramostim, which is an inhaled formulation of recombinant human GM-CSF and being developed for the treatment of autoimmune pulmonary alveolar proteinosis. The company was founded in December 1995 and is headquartered in Langhorne, PA.
info.description_zh: Savara, Inc. 是一家臨床階段製藥公司，致力於治療嚴重或危及生命的罕見呼吸道疾病的新療法的開發和商業化。其項目包括molgramostim，這是一種重組人類GM-CSF的吸入製劑，正在開發用於治療自體免疫性肺泡蛋白沉積症。該公司成立於 1995 年 12 月，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州蘭霍恩。

info.description: Taylor Devices, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and marketing of shock absorption, rate control, and energy storage devices. Its products include metal bellows dampers, fluid viscous dampers, landing and arresting gear, pumpkin mounts, isolation systems, custom applications, crane buffers, shock absorbers, liquid die springs, lock up devices, machined springs, and actuators. The company was founded by Paul H. Taylor on July 22, 1955 and is headquartered in North Tonawanda, NY.
info.description_zh: Taylor Devices, Inc. 從事減震、速率控制和儲能設備的設計、開發、製造和行銷。其產品包括金屬波紋管阻尼器、流體黏性阻尼器、著陸和煞車裝置、南瓜支架、隔離系統、客製化應用、起重機緩衝器、避震器、液體模具彈簧、鎖定裝置、機械加工彈簧和執行器。該公司由 Paul H. Taylor 於 1955 年 7 月 22 日創立，總部位於紐約州北托納旺達。

info.description: TriSalus Life Sciences, Inc. is an oncology company, which engages in the business of integrating standard-of-care treatments and investigational immunotherapeutic with disruptive pressure enabled drug delivery infusion systems to transform the treatment paradigm for patients battling liver and pancreatic tumors. The company was founded on September 11, 2020 and is headquartered in Westminster, CO.
info.description_zh: TriSalus Life Sciences, Inc. 是一家腫瘤學公司，從事將標準護理治療和研究性免疫治療與破壞性壓力藥物輸送輸注系統相結合的業務，以改變與肝臟和胰腺腫瘤作鬥爭的患者的治療模式。該公司成立於2020年9月11日，總部位於科羅拉多州威斯敏斯特。

info.description: Wintergreen Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on April 29, 2024 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Wintergreen Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司經營，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。公司成立於2024年4月29日，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Xencor, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of engineered monoclonal antibody therapeutics to treat severe and life-threatening diseases. Its proprietary technology platform, XmAb, is used to create next-generation antibody product candidates designed to treat autoimmune and allergic diseases, cancer, and other conditions. The company was founded by Bassil I. Dahiyat and Stephen L. Mayo in August 1997 and is headquartered in Pasadena, CA.
info.description_zh: Xencor, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發工程單株抗體療法來治療嚴重和危及生命的疾病。其專有技術平台 XmAb 用於創建下一代候選抗體產品，旨在治療自體免疫疾病和過敏性疾病、癌症和其他疾病。該公司由 Bassil I. Dahiyat 和 Stephen L. Mayo 於 1997 年 8 月創立，總部位於加州帕薩迪納。

info.description: Global X U.S. Electrification ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Global X U.S. Electrification Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes (if any), in the securities of the underlying index, which may include common stocks and American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index is, as presently constituted, designed to track the performance of U.S. listed companies domiciled in developed markets and involved in electrification. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 美國電氣化 ETF 尋求提供與 Global X 美國電氣化指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款（如有）投資於基礎指數的證券，其中可能包括基於基礎指數中的證券的普通股和美國存託憑證（「ADR」）。按照目前的組成，該指數旨在追蹤位於已開發市場並涉及電氣化的美國上市公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Soren Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 2, 2025 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Soren Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月2日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2026 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD High Yield Corporate Bond 2026 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated high yield corporate bonds (commonly known as "junk bonds") with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2026 (collectively, "2026 Bonds").
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2026 高收益公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares 美元高收益公司債 2026 指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量以美元計價的高收益公司債（通常稱為「垃圾債券」）投資組合的表現，這些債券在 2026 年到期，或在某些情況下為「有效到期日」（統稱為「2026 年債券」）。

info.description: PGIM Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETF - October seeks to provide investors with returns that match the price return of the Invesco QQQ TrustSM. The fund will invest substantially all of its assets in customized equity or index option contracts known as FLexible EXchange Options ("FLEX Options") on the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 (the "Underlying ETF"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: PGIM Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETF - 10 月旨在為投資者提供與 Invesco QQQ TrustSM 價格回報相匹配的回報。該基金將其大部分資產投資於 Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1（「基礎 ETF」）的客製化股票或指數選擇權合約，稱為靈活交換選擇權（「FLEX 選擇權」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GP-Act III Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company, which was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 23, 2020 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: GP-Act III Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運營，其創建目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2020年11月23日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Nationwide Nasdaq-100 Risk-Managed Income ETF seeks current income with downside protection. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective principally by investing in a portfolio of the stocks included in the Nasdaq-100 Index and an options collar (i.e., a mix of written (sold) call options and long (bought) put options) on the Nasdaq-100. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, will be invested in securities, or derivative instruments linked to securities, of companies that are included in the fund's reference index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 全國 Nasdaq-100 風險管理收益 ETF 尋求具有下行保護的當前收益。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過投資於納斯達克 100 指數中包含的股票組合和納斯達克 100 指數的選擇權項圈（即書面（賣出）買權和多頭（買入）看跌選擇權的組合）來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產，加上用於投資目的的借款，將投資於基金參考指數中包含的公司的證券或與證券掛鉤的衍生性商品。它是非多元化的。

info.description: F/m Emerald Special Situations ETF seeks long-term growth through capital appreciation. Under normal conditions, the fund typically invests in equity securities of U.S. and foreign companies, including common stocks, preferred stocks, and securities convertible into common or preferred stocks. It can invest in companies from a wide range of industries and of various sizes. The fund will invest primarily in mid and small-size companies.
info.description_zh: F/m Emerald Special Situations ETF 透過資本增值尋求長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金通常投資於美國和外國公司的股本證券，包括普通股、優先股以及可轉換為普通股或優先股的證券。它可以投資各個行業和各種規模的公司。該基金將主要投資於中小型企業。

info.description: Warren Street Global Equity ETF seeks to achieve long term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in equity securities selected by Warren Street Wealth Advisors, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser") that provide exposure to companies of all sizes located around the world. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in equity securities. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Warren Street 全球股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資 Warren Street Wealth Advisors, LLC（「副顧問」）選擇的股票證券來實現其投資目標，這些股票向世界各地各種規模的公司提供投資。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）將投資於股本證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares MSCI World Small-Cap ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI World Small Cap Index. The index is composed of small-capitalization developed market equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 世界小型股 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 世界小型股指數的投資結果。該指數由小盤發達市場股票組成。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。

info.description: Horizon NASDAQ-100 Defined Risk ETF seeks capital appreciation and capital preservation. Horizon Investments, LLC ("Horizon" or the "Adviser") seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing primarily in Flexible Exchange Options ("FLEX Options") that provide exposure to the Nasdaq-100 Index and implementing an options-based strategy that seeks to generate income, manage volatility and reduce downside risk.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n NASDAQ-100 定義風險 ETF 尋求資本增值和資本保值。 Horizo​​n Investments, LLC（「Horizo​​n」或「顧問」）尋求透過主要投資於提供納斯達克 100 指數曝險的靈活交易選擇權（「FLEX 選擇權」）並實施旨在產生收入、管理波動性和降低下行風險的基於選擇權的策略來實現基金的投資目標。

info.description: HCM III Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on April 15, 2025 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: HCM III Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年4月15日，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: VictoryShares WestEnd Global Equity ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund, under normal circumstances, has a policy to invest at least 80% of its assets in the shares of exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that invest in equity securities. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 40% of its net assets in ETFs that invest primarily in securities of issuers outside of the United States.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares WestEnd 全球股票 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金的政策是將至少80%的資產投資於投資於股本證券的交易所交易基金（「ETF」）的份額。在正常情況下，該基金將至少40%的淨資產投資於主要投資於美國境外發行人的證券的ETF。

info.description: TCW Compounders ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to invest in the companies that the Adviser believes will benefit from transformation as a result of technological innovations, market dynamics, and/or changes in client preferences. It aims to actively capture returns from companies that show long-term growth, quality, and durability characteristics as a result of such economic transformation or play a central role of enabling other companies to do the same. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: TCW Compounders ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在投資顧問認為將因技術創新、市場動態和/或客戶偏好變化而從轉型中受益的公司。它的目標是積極獲取那些因經濟轉型而表現出長期成長、品質和持久特徵的公司的回報，或是在使其他公司也能做到這一點方面發揮核心作用的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Solid Biosciences, Inc. is a life science company, which engages in the development of treatments for patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy. It also focuses on developing treatments for neuromuscular and cardiac diseases. The company was founded by Ilan Ganot, Andrey J. Zarur, Matthew Bennett Arnold, Annie Ganot, and Gilad David Hayeem in March 2013 and is headquartered in Charlestown, MA.
info.description_zh: Solid Biosciences, Inc.是一家生命科學公司，致力於開發杜氏肌肉營養不良症患者的治療方法。它還專注於開發神經肌肉和心臟病的治療方法。該公司由 Ilan Ganot、Andrey J. Zarur、Matthew Bennett Arnold、Annie Ganot 和 Gilad David Hayeem 於 2013 年 3 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州查爾斯敦。

info.description: NEOS Boosted Nasdaq-100 High Income ETF seeks to boost performance by generating high monthly income in a tax-efficient manner with the potential for enhanced equity appreciation in rising markets. The fund utilizes a multi-part strategy including a core 100% exposure to a portfolio of stocks that make up the Nasdaq-100 Index and an additional synthetic options strategy designed to create approximately 150% notional portfolio exposure to the index, while generating income through a data-driven call option overlay.
info.description_zh: NEOS Boosted Nasdaq-100 High Income ETF 尋求透過以節稅的方式產生高額月收入來提高業績，並有可能在新興市場中提高股票升值。該基金採用多部分策略，包括對構成納斯達克 100 指數的股票投資組合進行 100% 核心敞口，以及旨在創建對該指數約 150% 名義投資組合敞口的附加綜合期權策略，同時透過數據驅動的看漲期權疊加產生收入。

info.description: The Fund seeks to provide investors with returns that match the price return of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 ("QQQ") up to a predetermined upside cap while providing a downside buffer against 12% (before fees and expenses) of QQQ losses over the one-year Target Outcome Period. The Fund's investment objective is to provide investors with returns that match the price return of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 up to a predetermined upside cap while providing a downside buffer against the first 12% (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 losses over the Target Outcome Period. In seeking to achieve this investment objective, the Fund's upside cap over the period January 1, 2025 through March 31, 2025 is 3.75% (before fees and expenses).
info.description_zh: 該基金旨在為投資者提供與 Invesco QQQ 信託系列 1（「QQQ」）的價格回報相匹配的回報，最高可達預定的上漲上限，同時提供針對一年目標結果期間 12%（扣除費用和開支）的 QQQ 損失的下行緩衝。該基金的投資目標是為投資者提供與 Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 的價格回報相匹配的回報，最高可達預定的上漲上限，同時為 Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1 在目標結果期內的前 12%（未計費用和開支）損失提供下行緩衝。為了實現這一投資目標，該基金在2025年1月1日至2025年3月31日期間的上漲上限為3.75%（未計費和開支）。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2035 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2035. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2035.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2035 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2035 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2035 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Abony Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 13, 2025 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Abony Acquisition Corp. I 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年11月13日，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2029 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2029 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2029. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2029 and December 15, 2029, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2029 定期國債 ETF 旨在追蹤由 2029 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2029 年期美國國債指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於基金追蹤基礎指數的美國國債。標的指數由計劃於 2029 年 1 月 1 日至 2029 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。

info.description: Longview Advantage ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in equity securities of a diverse group of U.S. companies across market sectors, market capitalizations, and industry groups. Equity securities in which the fund may invest include common stock and derivative instruments that give exposure to equities, such as futures contracts, including futures contracts of U.S. indices.
info.description_zh: Longview Advantage ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金主要投資於不同市場領域、市值和行業群體的美國公司的股本證券。該基金可投資的股本證券包括普通股和提供股票部位的衍生性工具，例如期貨合約，包括美國指數的期貨合約。

info.description: iShares 3-7 Year Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE U.S. Treasury 3-7 Year Bond Index (the "underlying index"). The index measures the performance of public obligations of the U.S. Treasury that have a remaining maturity of greater than or equal to three years and less than seven years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares 3-7 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 美國 3-7 年期公債指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該指數衡量美國財政部剩餘期限大於或等於三年且小於七年的公共債務的履行。該基金將至少80%的資產投資於該指數的成分證券，並且該基金將至少90%的資產投資於BFA認為將有助於該基金追蹤該指數的美國國債。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2030 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2030 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2030. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the ICE 2030 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index (the "underlying index"). It may also invest in short-term paper, cash and cash equivalents, including shares of money market funds advised by BFA or its affiliates. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2030 and December 15, 2030, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2030 定期國債 ETF 旨在追蹤由 2030 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2030 到期美國國債指數的投資結果。該基金通常尋求透過投資滿足 ICE 2030 到期美國國債指數（「基礎指數」）標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。它還可以投資短期票據、現金和現金等價物，包括 BFA 或其附屬機構建議的貨幣市場基金股票。標的指數由計劃於 2030 年 1 月 1 日至 2030 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。

info.description: Ned Davis Research 360 Dynamic Allocation ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that primarily invests in passively managed ETFs, including affiliated ETFs that use the sub-adviser's models or indices. The underlying ETFs principally invest in equity securities,bonds (both long- and short-term),commodities and money markets.
info.description_zh: Ned Davis Research 360 動態配置 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要投資於被動管理的 ETF，包括使用副顧問模型或指數的附屬 ETF。基礎ETF主要投資於股本證券、債券（長期和短期）、大宗商品和貨幣市場。

info.description: Fortress Value Acquisition Corp. V is a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 24, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Fortress Value Acquisition Corp. V 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年11月24日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Global X S&P 500 Christian Values ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the S&P 500 Christian Values Screened Index (the "underlying index"). Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes (if any), in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index, as presently constituted, is designed to track the performance of U.S. equity securities included in the S&P 500 Index that maintain alignment with a broad understanding of the moral and biblical teachings of Christians. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X S&P 500 Christian Values ETF 尋求整體上與 S&P 500 Christian Values Screened Index（「基礎指數」）的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）相對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款（如有）投資於相關指數的證券。目前構成的基礎指數旨在追蹤標準普爾 500 指數中包含的美國股票證券的表現，該指數與對基督徒道德和聖經教義的廣泛理解保持一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Operates as a digital infrastructure and computing company
info.description_zh: 作為一家數位基礎設施和計算公司運營

info.description: Simplify U.S. Equity PLUS GBTC ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of U.S. companies and the Grayscale Bitcoin Trust. The fund invests in equity securities of U.S. companies through exchange-traded futures contracts, equity securities of U.S. companies and ETFs that primarily invest in the equity securities of U.S. companies. The fund invests up to 15% of its total assets in the Grayscale Bitcoin Trust.
info.description_zh: Simplify U.S. Equity PLUS GBTC ETF 尋求長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於美國公司的股本證券和灰階比特幣信託基金。該基金透過交易所交易的期貨合約、美國公司股本證券以及主要投資於美國公司股本證券的ETF投資於美國公司股本證券。該基金將其總資產的 15% 投資於灰階比特幣信託基金。

info.description: WisdomTree U.S. Adaptive Moving Average Fund utilizes a systematic trend-following overlay to dynamically allocate between U.S. large-cap equities and U.S. Treasury bills based on prevailing market momentum. The strategy is designed to provide full equity participation during uptrends while proactively reducing net exposure and shifting to cash equivalents during periods of high volatility or downward price trends to mitigate significant drawdowns.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree美國自適應移動平均基金利用系統性趨勢追蹤疊加，根據當前市場勢頭在美國大盤股和美國國債之間進行動態配置。該策略旨在在上漲趨勢期間提供全面的股權參與，同時在高波動或價格下跌趨勢期間主動減少淨敞口並轉向現金等價物，以減輕大幅回撤。

info.description: Cabana Target Leading Sector Moderate ETF seeks to provide long-term growth. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily by allocating its assets among ETFs that invest in securities of companies in the various sectors of the U.S. market: communication services, consumer discretionary, consumer staples, energy, financials, health care, industrials, information technology, materials, real estate, and utilities. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Cabana Target 領先產業溫和 ETF 尋求提供長期成長。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過將其資產分配給投資於美國市場各行業公司證券的 ETF 來實現其投資目標：通訊服務、非必需消費品、必需消費品、能源、金融、醫療保健、工業、資訊科技、材料、房地產和公用事業。它是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 Index. The index measures the performance of approximately 70 securities of domestic and international non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq based on market capitalization, as determined by Nasdaq, Inc. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 ETF 旨在追蹤 Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 指數的投資結果。該指數根據納斯達克公司確定的市值衡量在納斯達克上市的約 70 種國內和國際非金融公司證券的表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其基礎指數的組成證券。

info.description: Capital City Bank Group, Inc. operates as a bank holding company. Its principal services are Banking Services, Trust and Asset Management Services, and Brokerage Services. The firm provides traditional deposit and credit services, mortgage banking, asset management, trust, merchant services, bank cards, data processing and securities brokerage services. The company was founded on December 13, 1982 and is headquartered in Tallahassee, FL.
info.description_zh: Capital City Bank Group, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營。其主要服務包括銀行服務、信託和資產管理服務以及經紀服務。該公司提供傳統的存款和信貸服務、抵押銀行業務、資產管理、信託、商業服務、銀行卡、資料處理和證券經紀服務。該公司成立於1982年12月13日，總部位於佛羅裡達州塔拉哈西。

info.description: Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. engages in collection, storage, lending, and sending money through its commerce engine. The firm provides merchant services, payables, banking, and treasury solutions. It operates through the following segments: Small and Medium-sized Businesses (SMB) Payments, Business-to-Business (B2B) Payments, and Enterprise Payments. The SMB Payments segment includes provision of full-service acquiring and payment-enabled solutions for business-to-consumer transactions. The B2B Payments segment relates to accounts for payable automation solutions to corporations, software partners, and financial institutions. The Enterprise Payments segment refers to provision of embedded finance and banking as a service (BaaS) solution to customers to modernize legacy platforms and accelerate software partners' strategies to monetize payments. The company was founded by John V. Priore, Thomas Charles Priore, and Sean Kiewiet in August 2005 and is headquartered in Alpharetta, GA.
info.description_zh: Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. 透過其商業引擎從事收款、儲存、借貸和匯款業務。該公司提供商業服務、應付帳款、銀行和財務解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：中小企業（SMB）支付、企業對企業（B2B）支付和企業支付。中小企業支付部門包括為企業對消費者交易提供全方位服務的收單和支付解決方案。 B2B 支付部門涉及企業、軟體合作夥伴和金融機構的應付帳款自動化解決方案。企業支付部門是指向客戶提供嵌入式金融和銀行即服務（BaaS）解決方案，以實現傳統平台的現代化並加速軟體合作夥伴的支付貨幣化策略。該公司由 John V. Priore、Thomas Charles Priore 和 Sean Kiewiet 於 2005 年 8 月創立，總部位於喬治亞州阿爾法利塔。

info.description: iShares ESG MSCI USA Min Vol Factor ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Minimum Volatility Extended ESG Reduced Carbon Target Index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of large- and mid-capitalization U.S. equity securities that reflect the performance of a minimum volatility strategy and, relative to the MSCI USA Index, have higher favorable ESG characteristics and lower carbon exposure. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and may invest up to 10% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG MSCI USA Min Vol Factor ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI USA 最低波動率擴展 ESG 減少碳目標指數的投資結果。該指數旨在衡量大中型美國股票證券的表現，這些股票證券反映了最小波動策略的表現，並且相對於 MSCI 美國指數，具有更高的有利 ESG 特徵和更低的碳暴露。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並可能將最多 10% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。它是非多元化的。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility SPY ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility US Large Cap 500 Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the performance of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF, with investment exposure to the underlying ETF adjusted for a targeted annual volatility rate of 20%. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility SPY ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility US Large Cap 500 Index 的表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤 SPDR S&P 500 ETF 的表現，並根據 20% 的目標年度波動率調整基礎 ETF 的投資曝險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Deswell Industries, Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of injection-molded plastic parts and components, electrical products and subassemblies and metallic molds and accessories. It operates through the Plastic Injection Molding and Electronic Products Assembling segments. The Plastic Injection Molding segment includes plastic components for electric entertainment products; cases for flashlights, telephones, projectors, and alarm clocks; toner cartridges, and cases for photocopiers and printers; parts for audio equipment; medical testing equipment; and automobile components. The Electronic Products Assembling segment produces equipment used in sports stadiums, concert halls, recording studios, and radio and television stations. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Macao, China.
info.description_zh: Deswell Industries, Inc. 從事注塑塑膠零件、電氣產品和組件以及金屬模具和配件的製造和銷售。它透過塑膠注塑和電子產品組裝部門運作。塑膠射出成型部門包括用於電子娛樂產品的塑膠零件；手電筒、電話、投影機和鬧鐘的盒子；影印機和印表機的墨粉盒、外殼；音響設備零件；醫療檢測設備；和汽車零件。電子產品組裝部門生產體育場館、音樂廳、錄音室以及廣播電台和電視台使用的設備。該公司成立於1987年，總部位於中國澳門。

info.description: FT Vest Growth Strength & Target Income ETF seeks to provide investors with current income with a secondary objective of providing capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund will pursue its investment objectives by investing primarily in U.S. exchange-traded equity securities intended to track index and by utilizing an "option strategy" consisting of writing (selling) U.S. exchange-traded call options on the S&P 500 Index, or exchange-traded funds that track the S&P 500 Index (the "Underlying ETFs"). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: FT Vest Growth Strength & Target Income ETF 旨在為投資者提供當前收入，次要目標是提供資本增值。在正常市場條件下，該基金將透過主要投資於旨在追蹤指數的美國交易所交易股票證券以及利用「選擇權策略」來實現其投資目標，該策略包括賣出（出售）標準普爾 500 指數的美國交易所交易看漲期權或追踪標準普爾 500 指數的交易所交易基金（「基礎 ETF」）。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Touchstone Large Company Growth ETF utilizes a high-conviction, bottom-up investment approach to identify large-capitalization companies possessing durable competitive advantages and the potential for reliable long-term earnings growth. The strategy integrates a distinct valuation discipline into its selection process, aiming to participate in capital appreciation while maintaining price sensitivity within the growth equity universe by typically maintaining a concentrated portfolio of 25 to 35 equity securities.
info.description_zh: Touchstone大型公司成長ETF採用高信念、自下而上的投資方法來識別擁有持久競爭優勢和可靠的長期獲利成長潛力的大型資本公司。該策略將獨特的估值規則融入其選擇過程中，旨在參與資本增值，同時透過通常維持由 25 至 35 種股票證券組成的集中投資組合來維持成長股票領域內的價格敏感度。

info.description: SAB Biotherapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage, biopharmaceutical company, which engages in advancing a new class of immunotherapies leveraging fully-human polyclonal antibodies. The firm produces human polyclonal immunotherapies and its versatile DiversitAb platform is applicable for unmet needs in human diseases. The company was founded by Eddie J. Sullivan and Christine E. Hamilton in July 2014 and is headquartered in Miami Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: SAB Biotherapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於推進利用全人多株抗體的新型免疫療法。該公司生產人類多克隆免疫療法，其多功能 DiversitAb 平台適用於人類疾病中未滿足的需求。該公司由 Eddie J. Sullivan 和 Christine E. Hamilton 於 2014 年 7 月創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密海灘。

info.description: The Eastern Co. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of engineered solutions. The firm primarily provides engineered solutions support in the commercial transportation and logistics markets. The company was founded by Eben Tuttle in October 1858 and is headquartered in Shelton, CT.
info.description_zh: The Eastern Co. 從事工程解決方案的設計、製造和銷售。該公司主要為商業運輸和物流市場提供工程解決方案支援。該公司由 Eben Tuttle 於 1858 年 10 月創立，總部位於康乃狄克州謝爾頓。

info.description: Kala Bio, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company. It focuses on the development and commercialization of therapeutics using proprietary nanoparticle-based mucus penetrating particles with an initial focus on the treatment of eye diseases. The company was founded by Justin Hanes, Robert S. Langer and Colin R. Gardner in 2009 and is headquartered in Arlington, MA.
info.description_zh: Kala Bio, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司。它專注於使用專有的基於奈米顆粒的黏液穿透顆粒進行治療的開發和商業化，最初的重點是眼部疾病的治療。該公司由 Justin Hanes、Robert S. Langer 和 Colin R. Gardner 於 2009 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州阿靈頓。

info.description: Kentucky First Federal Bancorp is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking products and services through its subsidiaries. The company was founded on March 2, 2005, and is headquartered in Hazard, KY.
info.description_zh: 肯塔基州第一聯邦銀行是一家銀行控股公司，透過其子公司提供銀行產品和服務。該公司成立於2005年3月2日，總部位於肯塔基州哈札德。

info.description: First Trust Capital Strength ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Capital Strength TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index seeks to provide exposure to well-capitalized companies with strong market positions that have the potential to provide their stockholders with a greater degree of stability and performance over time.
info.description_zh: First Trust Capital Strength ETF 尋求與稱為 Capital Strength TM 指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在為資本充足、市場地位穩固的公司提供投資機會，這些公司有可能隨著時間的推移為其股東提供更大程度的穩定性和績效。

info.description: Hillman Solutions Corp. engages in the distribution of hardware and home improvement products. It operates through the following segments: Hardware and Protective Solutions, Robotics and Digital Solutions, and Canada. The Hardware and Protective Solutions segment includes fasteners, builders, wall hanging, threaded rod and metal shapes, letters, numbers, and signs, and personal protective equipment products. The Robotics and Digital Solutions segment consists of software-enabled key duplication and engraving solutions. The Canada segment focuses on distribution of fasteners and related hardware items, threaded rod, keys, key duplicating systems, accessories, identification items, tags and letters, numbers, and signs. The company was founded by Max W. Hillman Sr. in 1964 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Hillman Solutions Corp. 從事五金和家居裝修產品的分銷。該公司透過以下部門運作：硬體和防護解決方案部門、機器人和數位解決方案部門以及加拿大部門。五金和防護解決方案部門包括緊固件、建築工具、壁掛、螺紋桿和金屬型材、字母、數字和標誌以及個人防護設備產品。機器人和數位解決方案部門由軟體驅動的鑰匙複製和雕刻解決方案組成。加拿大分部專注於分銷緊固件及相關五金製品、螺紋桿、鑰匙、鑰匙複製系統、配件、識別物品、標籤和字母、數字和標誌。該公司由 Max W. Hillman Sr. 於 1964 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: First Trust Asia Pacific Ex-Japan AlphaDEX Fund seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Asia Pacific Ex-Japan Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Asia Pacific Ex-Japan Index that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 亞太地區（日本除外）AlphaDEX 基金尋求與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 亞太地區（日本除外）指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克亞太（日本除外）指數中選擇相對於傳統指數可能產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Expedia Group, Inc. is an online travel company, which engages in the provision of travel products and services to leisure and corporate travelers. It operates through the following segments: B2C, B2B, and Trivago. The B2C segment offers a full range of travel and advertising services to worldwide customers through a variety of consumer brands. The B2B segment refers to a wide range of travel and non-travel companies including airlines, offline travel agents, online retailers, corporate travel management, and financial institutions. The Trivago segment generates advertising revenue primarily from sending referrals to online travel companies and travel service providers from hotel metasearch websites. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Expedia Group, Inc. 是一家線上旅遊公司，致力於為休閒和商務旅客提供旅遊產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：B2C、B2B 和 Trivago。 B2C 部門透過各種消費品牌向全球客戶提供全方位的旅遊和廣告服務。 B2B細分市場涉及廣泛的旅遊和非旅遊公司，包括航空公司、線下旅行社、線上零售商、商旅管理和金融機構。 Trivago 部門的廣告收入主要來自於從飯店元搜尋網站向線上旅遊公司和旅遊服務提供者發送推薦。該公司成立於 1994 年，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: Ruanyun Edai Technology, Inc. provides artificial intelligence to educational institutions. It offers new teaching, learning, and assessment methods in the artificial intelligence. The firm involves in reforming traditional Chinese education and learning model by facilitating schools, teachers and students. The company was founded by Yan Fu and Cong Zhao on March 11, 2021 and is headquartered in Nanchang, China.
info.description_zh: 軟雲易貸科技有限公司為教育機構提供人工智慧。它提供了人工智慧領域新的教學、學習和評估方法。該公司致力於透過為學校、教師和學生提供便利來改革中國傳統的教育和學習模式。該公司由付岩和趙聰於2021年3月11日創立，總部位於中國南昌。

info.description: mF International Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the development and provision of financial trading solutions through its subsidiary. It offers real-time mission critical forex, bullion and commodities trading platform solutions, financial value-added services, mobile applications, and financial information for brokers and institutional clients via internet or platform as software as a service. The company was founded by Tai Wai Lam and Chi Weng Tam on June 15, 2022, and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: mF International Ltd. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司從事開發和提供金融交易解決方案。它透過互聯網或平台即軟體即服務為經紀商和機構客戶提供即時任務關鍵型外匯、金銀和大宗商品交易平台解決方案、金融增值服務、行動應用程式和金融資訊。該公司由Tai Wai Lam和Chi Weng Tam於2022年6月15日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Cipher Digital, Inc. operates as a Bitcoin mining ecosystem in the United States. The firm is developing a cryptocurrency business. The company was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Cipher Digital, Inc. 在美國以比特幣挖礦生態系統運作。該公司正在開發加密貨幣業務。該公司成立於 2021 年，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Aterian, Inc. is a technology enabled consumer products company. The company's brands include hOme, Vremi, Xtava and RIF6. Its product categories include home and kitchen appliances, kitchenware, environmental appliances, beauty related products and consumer electronics. The company was founded by Yaniv Sarig Zion in 2014 and is headquartered in Summit, NJ.
info.description_zh: Aterian, Inc. 是一家技術支援的消費品公司。該公司的品牌包括 hOme、Vremi、Xtava 和 RIF6。其產品類別包括家居及廚房電器、廚具、環保電器、美容相關產品及消費性電子產品。該公司由 Yaniv Sarig Zion 於 2014 年創立，總部位於新澤西州薩米特。

info.description: Vera Bradley, Inc. engages in the business of designing women's handbags, luggage, travel items, fashion, home accessories, and unique gifts. It operates through the following segments: Vera Bradley (VB) Direct and Vera Bradley Indirect. The VB Direct segment is involved in sale of VB products through full-line and factory outlet stores, websites, online outlet sites, and the VB annual outlet sale. The VB Indirect segment includes distribution of branded products to specialty retailers, select department stores, national accounts, third-party e-commerce sites, third-party inventory liquidators, and licensing agreements. The company was founded by Barbara Bradley Baekgaard and Patricia R. Miller in 1982 and is headquartered in Roanoke, IN.
info.description_zh: Vera Bradley, Inc. 從事女士手袋、行李箱、旅行用品、時尚、家居飾品和獨特禮品的設計業務。它透過以下部門運作：Vera Bradley (VB) Direct 部門和 Vera Bradley Indirect 部門。 VB Direct 部門透過全線直銷店、工廠直銷店、網站、線上直銷網站以及 VB 年度直銷銷售 VB 產品。 VB Indirect 部門包括向專業零售商、精選百貨公司、國民帳戶、第三方電子商務網站、第三方庫存清算商和授權協議分銷品牌產品。該公司由 Barbara Bradley Baekgaard 和 Patricia R. Miller 於 1982 年創立，總部位於印第安納州羅阿諾克。

info.description: ERShares Entrepreneur ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in equity securities of mid and large capitalization companies traded on the NASDAQ, the New York Stock Exchange or other major U.S. exchanges. Equity securities include common stocks, preferred stocks, convertible preferred stocks, American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) (sponsored only) and Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs) (sponsored only). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ERShares Entrepreneur ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金主要投資於在納斯達克、紐約證券交易所或美國其他主要交易所交易的大中型公司的股票證券。股本證券包括普通股、優先股、可轉換優先股、美國存託憑證（ADR）（僅限保薦）及全球存託憑證（GDR）（僅限保薦）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Energy Recovery, Inc. engages in the design and manufacture of industrial fluid flow solutions. It operates through the following segments: Water, Emerging Technologies, and Corporate. The Water segment deals with the development, sales, and support of the PX, Turbochargers and pumps used in seawater desalination and industrial wastewater activities. The Emerging Technologies segment is composed of the development of the PX G1300 used in industrial and commercial refrigeration applications. The company was founded in April 1992 and is headquartered in San Leandro, CA.
info.description_zh: Energy Recovery, Inc. 從事工業流體流動解決方案的設計和製造。它透過以下部門運作：水務部門、新興技術部門和企業部門。水務部門負責海水淡化和工業廢水活動中使用的 PX、渦輪增壓器和泵浦的開發、銷售和支援。新興技術部分由用於工業和商業冷凍應用的 PX G1300 的開發組成。該公司成立於 1992 年 4 月，總部位於加州聖萊安德羅。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long UPS Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of UPS. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of UPS, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 UPS 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 UPS 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 UPS 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Artiva Biotherapeutics, Inc. operates as a biotechnology company for the treatment of hematologic cancers. It offers NK cell therapies for cancer. The company was founded by Thomas J. Farrell in 2019 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Artiva Biotherapeutics, Inc. 是一家治療血液癌症的生技公司。它提供癌症 NK 細胞療法。該公司由 Thomas J. Farrell 於 2019 年創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: McDonald's Corp. engages in the operation and franchising of restaurants. The firm operates through the following segments: U.S., International Operated Markets, and International Developmental Licensed Markets and Corporate. The U.S. segment focuses its operations on the United States. The International Operated Markets segment consists of operations and the franchising of restaurants in Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Russia, Spain, and the U.K. The International Developmental Licensed Markets and Corporate segment consists of developmental licensee and affiliate markets in the McDonald's system. Its products include Big Mac, Quarter Pounder with Cheese, Filet-O-Fish, several chicken sandwiches, Chicken McNuggets, wraps, McDonald's Fries, salads, oatmeal, shakes, McFlurry desserts, sundaes, soft serve cones, pies, soft drinks, coffee, and McCafe beverages. The company was founded by Raymond Albert Kroc on April 15, 1955 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: 麥當勞公司從事餐廳的經營和特許經營。該公司透過以下部門營運：美國、國際營運市場以及國際開發許可市場和企業。美國部門的業務重點集中在美國。國際經營市場部門包括澳洲、加拿大、法國、德國、義大利、荷蘭、俄羅斯、西班牙和英國的餐廳經營和特許經營。國際發展許可市場和企業部門包括麥當勞系統中的發展被授權人和附屬市場。其產品包括巨無霸、起司四分之一磅、魚片、多種雞肉三明治、麥雞、捲餅、麥當勞薯條、沙拉、燕麥片、奶昔、麥旋甜點、聖代、甜筒冰淇淋、派、軟性飲料、咖啡和麥咖啡飲料。該公司由 Raymond Albert Kroc 於 1955 年 4 月 15 日創立，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long GLXY Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of GLXY. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of GLXY, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 GLXY 每日 ETF 尋求 GLXY 普通股價格每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 GLXY 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long CIFR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of CIFR. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of CIFR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 CIFR 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 CIFR 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 CIFR 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: IceCure Medical Ltd. engages in the development and marketing of therapy for the treatment of tumors. Its product, ProSense Cryoablation System, provides invasive treatment option to destroy tumors by freezing them. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Caesarea, Israel.
info.description_zh: IceCure Medical Ltd. 從事腫瘤治療藥物的開發和行銷。其產品 ProSense 冷凍消融系統提供侵入性治療選擇，透過冷凍來破壞腫瘤。該公司成立於2006年，總部位於以色列凱撒利亞。

info.description: Sabre Corp. is a software and technology company, which engages in the provision of technological solutions to the global travel and tourism industry. It operates through the Travel Solutions and Hospitality Solutions segments. The Travel Solutions segment provides global travel for suppliers and buyers through a business-to-business travel marketplace. The Hospitality Solutions segment provides software and solutions, through SaaS and hosted delivery models, to hoteliers around the world. It provides data-driven business intelligence, mobile, distribution, and software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions. The company was founded in December 2006 and is headquartered in Southlake, TX.
info.description_zh: Sabre Corp.是一家軟體和科技公司，致力於為全球旅遊和旅遊業提供技術解決方案。它透過旅行解決方案和酒店解決方案部門運作。旅行解決方案部門透過企業對企業旅行市場為供應商和買家提供全球旅行服務。酒店解決方案部門透過 SaaS 和託管交付模式向世界各地的酒店經營者提供軟體和解決方案。它提供數據驅動的商業智慧、行動、分發和軟體即服務 (SaaS) 解決方案。該公司成立於2006年12月，總部位於德克薩斯州南湖。

info.description: CervoMed, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company. It engages in the business of advancing CNS focused therapeutics to benefit patients with a range of degenerative diseases of the brain. The company is currently developing neflamapimod, an investigational orally administered small molecule brain penetrant that inhibits p38MAP kinase alpha. CervoMed, Inc. was founded in1995 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: CervoMed, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司。該公司致力於推進以中樞神經系統為重點的治療方法，以使患有一系列大腦退化性疾病的患者受益。該公司目前正在開發 neflamapimod，一種研究性口服小分子腦滲透劑，可抑制 p38MAP 激酶 α。 CervoMed, Inc. 成立於 1995 年，總部位於麻薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Westport Fuel Systems, Inc. engages in the business of engineering, manufacturing, and supplying alternative fuel systems and components for transportation applications. It operates through the following segments: Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM), Independent Aftermarket (IAM), and Corporate. The OEM segment includes designing, manufacturing, and selling alternative fuel systems, components, and electronics including the HPDI 2.0 fuel systems product and engineering services. The IAM segment focuses on alternative fuel systems and components that consumers can purchase and have installed onto vehicles to use liquid petroleum or compressed natural gas fuels in addition to gasoline. The Corporate segment is involved in public company activities, corporate oversight, financing, capital allocation, and general administrative duties such as securing intellectual property. The company was founded on March 20, 1995 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: Westport Fuel Systems, Inc. 從事運輸應用的工程、製造和供應替代燃料系統和組件的業務。它透過以下部門運作：原始設備製造商（OEM）、獨立售後市場（IAM）和企業。 OEM 部門包括設計、製造和銷售替代燃料系統、組件和電子產品，包括 HPDI 2.0 燃料系統產品和工程服務。 IAM 部門專注於替代燃料系統和組件，消費者可以購買這些系統和組件並將其安裝到車輛上，以使用汽油以外的液態石油或壓縮天然氣燃料。公司部門涉及上市公司活動、公司監督、融資、資本配置以及保護智慧財產權等一般管理職責。該公司成立於1995年3月20日，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: OFS Capital Corp. is a business development company, which invests in middle market companies located in the United States. It provides financing for recapitalizations and refinancing, MBOs, LBOs, acquisition financing, shareholder liquidity events, growth capital investments, and ESOPs with an investment of million. The company was founded on March 20, 2001 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: OFS Capital Corp. 是一家業務開發公司，投資位於美國的中間市場公司。它為資本重組和再融資、管理層收購、槓桿收購、收購融資、股東流動性事件、成長資本投資和員工持股計劃提供融資，投資額達數百萬美元。該公司成立於2001年3月20日，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: NeoVolta, Inc. engages in the designing, manufacturing, and developing of residential energy storage systems (ESS). Its products include: NV14, NV24, NVPlus, NV7600, and NV16. The company was founded by Brent Willson on March 5, 2018 and is headquartered in Poway, CA.

info.description: Golden Heaven Group Holdings Ltd. engages in the construction, development, management, and operation of urban amusement parks, water parks, amusement projects, and amusement facilities in China. Its services include sales of in-park recreation, rental income, and Park service fees. The company was founded on January 8, 2020 and is headquartered in Nanping, China.
info.description_zh: 金天堂集團控股有限公司在中國從事城市遊樂園、水上樂園、遊樂項目、遊樂設施的建設、開發、管理和營運。其服務包括園區內娛樂銷售、租金收入和公園服務費。公司成立於2020年1月8日，總部位於中國南平。

info.description: Iveda Solutions, Inc. enables cloud video surveillance via its Sentir data and video management platform, utilizing proprietary video streaming and big data storage technology. The firm provides services for telecommunications companies, datacenter operators, ISPs, and cable companies. It operates through the US and Taiwan segments. The company was founded by David Ly in 2003 and is headquartered in Mesa, AZ.
info.description_zh: Iveda Solutions, Inc. 利用專有的視訊串流和大數據儲存技術，透過其 Sentir 資料和視訊管理平台實現雲端視訊監控。該公司為電信公司、資料中心營運商、ISP 和有線電視公司提供服務。它透過美國和台灣部門運作。該公司由 David Ly 於 2003 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州梅薩。

info.description: VS MEDIA Holdings Ltd. engages in the management of a global network of digital creators who create and publish content to social media platforms. It operates through the following segments: Marketing Services, Social Commerce, and Other. The Marketing Services segment is involved in providing affiliate marketing, product placement, and brand sponsorship deals for creators to promote brand's messages; and creating and publishing content on social media platforms. The Social Commerce segment resells brand's products to creators. The company was founded by Nga Fan Wong in 2013 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: VS MEDIA Holdings Ltd. 從事全球數位創作者網路的管理，這些創作者在社群媒體平台上創建和發佈內容。它透過以下部門運作：行銷服務、社交商務和其他。行銷服務部門為創作者提供聯盟行銷、產品置入和品牌贊助交易，以宣傳品牌訊息；在社群媒體平台上創建和發佈內容。社群商務部門將品牌產品轉售給創作者。該公司由黃雅帆於2013年創立，總部位於香港。
