info.description: PRF Technologies Ltd. is a pharmaceutical company, which focuses on reformulation of established therapeutics. It offers PRF-110, an oil-based, viscous, clear solution that is deposited directly into the surgical wound bed prior to closure to provide localized and extended post-operative analgesia. The company was founded by Lihu Avitov and Dan Teleman in 2007 and is headquartered in Herzliya, Israel.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: PRF Technologies Ltd. 是一家製藥公司，專注於現有療法的重新配製。它提供 PRF-110，一種油基粘性透明溶液，在閉合前直接沉積到手術創面床上，以提供局部和長期的術後鎮痛。該公司由 Lihu Avitov 和 Dan Teleman 於 2007 年創立，總部位於以色列荷茲利亞。

info.description: Target Hospitality Corp. engages in the provision of rental accommodation with catering and hospitality services. It operates through the following business segments: HFS South, Government, and All Other. The HFS South segment consists primarily of rental and vertically integrated hospitality services revenue from customers in the natural resources and development industry located primarily in Texas and New Mexico. The Government segment is involved in rental and vertically integrated hospitality services revenue from customers with Government contracts in Texas. The All Other segment focuses on rental and vertically integrated hospitality services revenue from customers primarily in the natural resources and development industry located outside of the HFS South segment. The company was founded by Brian Scott Lash in 1978 and is headquartered in The Woodlands, TX.
info.description_zh: Target Hospitality Corp. 從事提供住宿租賃以及餐飲和旅館服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：HFS South、政府和所有其他部門。 HFS South 部門主要包括來自主要位於德克薩斯州和新墨西哥州的自然資源和開發行業客戶的租賃和垂直整合酒店服務收入。政府部門涉及來自德克薩斯州政府合約客戶的租賃和垂直整合酒店服務收入。所有其他部門專注於來自 HFS South 部門之外的自然資源和開發行業客戶的租賃和垂直整合酒店服務收入。該公司由 Brian Scott Lash 於 1978 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州伍德蘭茲。

info.description: Matthews China Discovery Active ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by utilizing an investment strategy enhanced by the use of artificial intelligence. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of U.S.-listed large capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Matthews China Discovery Active ETF 尋求資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過利用人工智慧增強的投資策略來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於美國上市大型資本公司的證券。

info.description: Invesco DWA Healthcare Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Healthcare Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the healthcare sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Healthcare Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Healthcare Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數由至少 30 家醫療保健行業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: iShares Semiconductor ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE Semiconductor Index composed of U.S. equities in the semiconductor sector. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Semiconductor ETF 旨在追蹤由美國半導體產業股票組成的 ICE 半導體指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Macquarie Focused Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks to long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of emerging markets issuers. The fund invests primarily in a broad range of equity securities of companies located in emerging market countries and may invest in companies of any size. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 麥格理專注於新興市場股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於新興市場發行人的股本證券。該基金主要投資於新興市場國家公司的各種股本證券，並可投資於任何規模的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Outdoor Holding Co. engages in the design and manufacture of products for law enforcement, military, sport shooting, and self-defense. It operates through the following segments: Ammunition, Martketplace, and Corporate and Other. The Ammunition segment consists of the manufacturing business. The Marketplace segment includes GunBroker.com. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Outdoor Holding Co. 從事執法、軍事、運動射擊和自衛產品的設計和製造。它透過以下部門運作：彈藥部門、市場部門、企業及其他部門。彈藥部門由製造業務組成。市場部分包括 GunBroker.com。該公司成立於 1990 年，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: First Trust Nasdaq Semiconductor ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq US Smart Semiconductor IndexTM. The fund invests at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depository receipts that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide exposure to U.S. companies comprising the semiconductor sector that have been selected based upon their liquidity and weighted based upon their cumulative score on three investing factors: volatility, value and growth. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust 納斯達克半導體 ETF 尋求與納斯達克美國智慧半導體指數TM 的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在提供對包括半導體行業在內的美國公司的投資，這些公司是根據其流動性進行選擇的，並根據其在三個投資因素（波動性、價值和增長）的累積得分進行加權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: FormFactor, Inc. engages in the provision of test and measurement solutions. It operates through the Probe Cards and Systems segments. The Probe Cards segment consists of technologies and product architectures, including micro-electromechanical systems technologies. The Systems segment consists of analytical probe solutions for on-wafer probing, board tests, and package tests. The company was founded by Igor Khandros on April 15, 1993 and is headquartered in Livermore, CA.
info.description_zh: FormFactor, Inc. 致力於提供測試和測量解決方案。它透過探針卡和系統部門運作。探針卡部分由技術和產品架構組成，包括微機電系統技術。系統部門包括用於晶圓探測、電路板測試和封裝測試的分析探針解決方案。該公司由 Igor Khandros 於 1993 年 4 月 15 日創立，總部位於加州利弗莫爾。

info.description: Invesco Nasdaq Biotechnology ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index . The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, Nasdaq compiles the underlying index, which is a modified market capitalization weighted index that is designed to measure the performance of securities listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market that are classified as either biotechnology or pharmaceutical companies. The index may include securities of large-, mid- and small-capitalization companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 景順納斯達克生物技術 ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克生物技術指數的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常會將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。納斯達克嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制基礎指數，這是一種修改後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量在納斯達克股票市場上市的生物技術或製藥公司證券的業績。該指數可能包括大、中、小型公司的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Japan AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Japan Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Japan Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Japan AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 日本指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克日本指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可能產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: ishares Breakthrough Environmental Solutions ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Morningstar Global Emerging Green Technologies Select Index. The underlying index measures the performance of equity securities issued by U.S. and non-U.S. companies involved in breakthrough innovations and new technologies that seek to address or combat climate change, as determined by Morningstar or its affiliates. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: isshares Breakthrough Environmental Solutions ETF 旨在追蹤晨星全球新興綠色技術精選指數的投資結果。該指數衡量由晨星或其附屬公司確定的涉及尋求解決或應對氣候變遷的突破性創新和新技術的美國和非美國公司發行的股本證券的表現。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Gravity Co., Ltd. engages in the development and publishing of online and mobile games, software, and other related services. It operates through the following business segments: Online Game, Mobile Game, and Others. The Online Game segment consists of Micro-transaction and subscription revenue, which is operated by the company, and royalties and license fee. The Mobile Game segment comprises of micro-transaction. The company was founded on April 4, 2000 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
info.description_zh: Gravity Co., Ltd.從事網路及手機遊戲、軟體及其他相關服務的開發與發行。它透過以下業務部門運作：網路遊戲、手機遊戲和其他。線上遊戲部門包括由公司經營的微交易和訂閱收入以及特許權使用費和許可費。手機遊戲部分包括微交易。該公司成立於2000年4月4日，總部位於韓國首爾。

info.description: Cytokinetics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which is focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing muscle activators and muscle inhibitors as potential treatments for people with debilitating diseases in which muscle performance is compromised and/or declining. The firm is developing small molecule drug candidates specifically engineered to impact muscle function and contractility. Its clinical-stage drug candidates include omecamtiv mecarbil, a novel cardiac myosin activator, CK-136, a novel cardiac troponin activator, reldesemtiv, a novel fast skeletal muscle troponin activator, aficamten, a novel cardiac myosin inhibitor, and CK-3772271, a novel cardiac myosin inhibitor. The company was founded by Ronald D. Vale, Lawrence S. B. Goldstein, James H. Sabry, and James A. Spudich in 1997 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Cytokinetics, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，專注於發現、開發和商業化肌肉激活劑和肌肉抑製劑，作為肌肉性能受損和/或下降的衰弱性疾病患者的潛在治療方法。該公司正在開發專門用於影響肌肉功能和收縮性的小分子候選藥物。其臨床階段候選藥物包括新型心肌肌球蛋白激活劑omecamtiv mecarbil、新型心肌肌鈣蛋白激活劑CK-136、新型快速骨骼肌肌鈣蛋白激活劑reldesemtiv、新型心肌肌球蛋白抑製劑aficamten和新型心肌肌球蛋白抑製劑CK-3772271。該公司由 Ronald D. Vale、Lawrence S. B. Goldstein、James H. Sabry 和 James A. Spudich 於 1997 年創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: iShares Environmental Infrastructure and Industrials ETF seeks to track the investment results of the FTSE Green Revenues Select Infrastructure and Industrials Index composed of U.S. and non-U.S. companies that provide infrastructure and industrials solutions aiming to support energy efficiency and emissions mitigation, pollution reduction or land and resource optimization. The fund seeks to track the investment results of the index, which has been developed by FTSE International Limited (the "index provider" or "FTSE"). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares環境基礎設施和工業ETF旨在追蹤富時綠色收入精選基礎設施和工業指數的投資結果，該指數由美國和非美國公司組成，這些公司提供基礎設施和工業解決方案，旨在支持能源效率和減排、減少污染或土地和資源最佳化。該基金旨在追蹤由 FTSE International Limited（「指數提供者」或「FTSE」）開發的指數的投資結果。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Macquarie Focused International Core ETF seeks to provide capital growth and appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the ETF will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity companies. The fund will invest primarily in common stocks of non-U.S. companies located or operating in both developed markets and emerging markets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 麥格理聚焦國際核心 ETF 致力於提供資本成長和增值。在正常情況下，ETF將至少80%的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於股權公司。該基金將主要投資於位於已開發市場和新興市場或在新興市場運營的非美國公司的普通股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Rayliant-ChinaAMC Transformative China Tech ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Solactive ChinaAMC Transformative China Tech Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index, as well as participatory notes that represent securities in the index. The underlying index will then select the top 300 eligible constituents based on their total market capitalization ranked in descending order. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Rayliant-ChinaAMC Transformative China Tech ETF旨在追蹤Solactive ChinaAMC Transformative China Tech Index的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成基礎指數的證券以及代表指數中證券的參與式票據。標的指數將依照總市值由大到小的順序選出符合資格的前 300 名樣本股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ProShares Nasdaq-100 Dynamic Buffer ETF seeks investment results, before fees and expenses, that track the performance of the Nasdaq-100 Dynamic Buffer Index. The index measures the performance of this Dynamic Buffer Strategy based on the Nasdaq-100 Index using a long position in the Nasdaq-100 Index along with three different Nasdaq-100 Index options that have one day to expiration. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets in components of the index or in instruments with similar economic characteristics. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Nasdaq-100 動態緩衝 ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前追蹤 Nasdaq-100 動態緩衝指數表現的投資結果。該指數使用 Nasdaq-100 指數的多頭部位以及距離到期日還有一天的三種不同的 Nasdaq-100 指數選擇權來衡量基於 Nasdaq-100 指數的動態緩衝策略的表現。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於指數成分股或具有類似經濟特徵的工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Indxx Metaverse ETF seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield, before fees and expenses, of an equity index called the Indxx Metaverse Index (the "Index"). Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is comprised of companies that provide services and products that support the infrastructure and applications of the Metaverse. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust Indxx Metaverse ETF 尋求的結果通常與名為 Indxx Metaverse 指數（「指數」）的股票指數（未計費用和開支）的價格和收益率相對應。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數由提供支援元宇宙基礎設施和應用程式的服務和產品的公司組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SEI Select Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of emerging market issuers. The fund normally maintains investments in at least six emerging market countries, however, it may invest a substantial amount of its assets in issuers located in a single country or a limited number of countries.
info.description_zh: SEI Select 新興市場股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於新興市場發行人的股本證券。該基金通常在至少六個新興市場國家進行投資，但也可能將大量資產投資於位於單一國家或有限數量國家的發行人。

info.description: Stocksnips AI-Powered Sentiment US ALL Cap ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by utilizing an investment strategy that leverages artificial intelligence ("AI") and natural language processing to derive a proprietary News Media Sentiment Signal (the "Sentiment Signal"). Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amounts of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of U.S.-listed large, mid and small capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Stocksnips AI-Powered Sentiment US ALL Cap ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過利用人工智慧（「AI」）和自然語言處理來得出專有新聞媒體情緒訊號（「情緒訊號」）的投資策略來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於美國上市的大、中、小型資本公司的證券。

info.description: Sarepta Therapeutics, Inc. is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, which is engaged in the discovery and development of therapeutics for the treatment of rare diseases. The company was founded on July 22, 1980, and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Sarepta Therapeutics, Inc.是一家商業階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發治療罕見疾病的療法。該公司成立於1980年7月22日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Grupo Aeroportuario del Centro Norte SAB de CV is a holding company, which engages in operating and managing airports. It operates through the following segments: Metropolitan, Tourist, Regional, Border, Hotel, Industrial Park, and Other. The Metropolitan segment handles operations of the Monterrey airport. The Tourist segment includes Acapulco, Mazatlan, and Zihuatanejo airports. The Regional segment consists of Chihuahua, Culiacan, Durango, San Luis Potosi, Tampico, Torreon, and Zacatecas. The Border segment comprises of Ciudad Juarez and Reynosa. The Hotel segment manages the Terminal 2 NH Collection Hotel and the Hilton Garden Inn Hotel. The Industrial Park segment operates the OMA-VYNMSA Industrial Park. The Other segment refers to the holding company and its service companies. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Mexico.
info.description_zh: Grupo Aeroportuario del Centro Norte SAB de CV 是一家控股公司，從事機場營運和管理。它透過以下部門運作：都市部門、旅遊部門、地區部門、邊境部門、飯店部門、工業園區部門和其他部門。大都會部分負責蒙特雷機場的營運。旅遊部分包括阿卡普爾科機場、馬薩特蘭機場和芝華塔尼歐機場。區域部分包括奇瓦瓦州、庫利亞坎州、杜蘭戈州、聖路易斯波托西州、坦皮科州、托雷翁州和薩卡特卡斯州。邊境部分包括華雷斯城和雷諾薩。飯店部門管理 2 號航站樓 NH Collection 酒店和希爾頓花園酒店。工業園區部門負責營運 OMA-VYNMSA 工業園區。其他部門是指控股公司及其服務公司。該公司成立於1998年，總部位於墨西哥。

info.description: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is an optimized equity index designed to reflect the equity performance of companies that have favorable ESG characteristics, while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the MSCI Emerging Markets Index (the "parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場擴展 ESG 焦點指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是優化的股票指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 特徵的公司的股票表現，同時表現出與 MSCI 新興市場指數（「母指數」）類似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: WisdomTree Asia Defense Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the WisdomTree Asia Defense Index (the "Index"). Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in constituents of the index and/or investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially similar to the economic characteristics of such constituents. The index has between 20 and 100 constituents with a maximum weight of 7.5% for "Exposure Score 3" constituents and 4% for "Exposure Score 2" and "Exposure Score 1" constituents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 亞洲防務基金致力於追蹤 WisdomTree 亞洲防務指數（「指數」）未計費用和開支的價格和收益率表現。在正常情況下，基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於指數成分股和/或具有與此類成分股經濟特徵基本相似的經濟特徵的投資。該指數有 20 至 100 隻成分股，其中「暴露評分 3」成分股的最大權重為 7.5%，「暴露評分 2」和「暴露評分 1」成分股的最大權重為 4%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR Galaxy Hedged Digital Asset Ecosystem ETF seeks to provide long term capital appreciation. The Sub-Adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing, directly or indirectly, in (i) equity securities of foreign and domestic companies within the crypto asset and blockchain industries, (ii) ETFs that primarily hold bitcoin and/or ether futures contracts, (iii) bitcoin and ether futures contracts, (iv) exchange-traded products that hold bitcoin or ether as a reference asset, and (v) covered call options and protective put options on investments held in the portfolio. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR Galaxy 對沖數位資產生態系統 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。副顧問尋求透過直接或間接投資於（i）加密資產和區塊鏈行業內的外國和國內公司的股本證券，（ii）主要持有比特幣和/或以太坊期貨合約的ETF，（iii）比特幣和以太坊期貨合約，（iv）以比特幣或以太幣作為參考資產交易所的投資期權產品，以及（v）投資組合中持有的投資基金的投資期權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Yoke Core ETF seeks to achieve capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a dynamic, tactical asset allocation portfolio across domestic and international equity markets. It invests in domestic and international equity securities (including common stock, other ETFs, real estate investment trusts ("REITs"), American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"), and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs")).
info.description_zh: Yoke Core ETF 尋求實現資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資於國內和國際股票市場的動態、戰術性資產配置組合來實現其投資目標。它投資於國內和國際股票證券（包括普通股、其他ETF、房地產投資信託（「REIT」）、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」））。

info.description: The KraneShares InspereX Nasdaq Dynamic Buffered High Income Index ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the price and yield performance of a specific equity and derivative securities index. The Fund's current index is the Nasdaq InspereX Dynamic Buffered High Income Index. The Underlying Index is designed to track the performance of a systematic enhanced collar strategy that seeks to limit losses while providing option income. The Underlying Index models a strategy that includes these components: 1.total return exposure to the Nasdaq-100 Index; 2.short call options (i.e., selling call options) on the Nasdaq-100 Index, which involve the selling of a series of short-dated call options (i.e., five days or less) to generate option income, with new call options being sold each day; and 3. short futures positions (i.e., selling futures) on the Nasdaq-100 Futures Excess Return Index, which is dynamically adjusted on a daily basis as it seeks to replicate the effect of rolling monthly put options on the Nasdaq-100 Index and provide downside protection against losses. The Fund may invest directly in any component of the Nasdaq-100 Index or may invest in an exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to track the Nasdaq-100 Index.
info.description_zh: KraneShares InspereX 納斯達克動態緩衝高收入指數 ETF 旨在提供未計費用和支出的投資結果，該結果通常與特定股票和衍生證券指數的價格和收益率表現相對應。該基金目前的指數是納斯達克InspereX動態緩衝高收入指數。基礎指數旨在追蹤系統性增強型領子策略的表現，該策略旨在限制損失，同時提供選擇權收入。基礎指數模型包含以下組成部分的策略： 1. 納斯達克 100 指數的總回報敞口； 2.納斯達克 100指數的空頭買權（即賣出買權），涉及賣出一系列短期（即五天或以下）買權以產生選擇權收入，每天都會賣出新的買權；期貨超額回報指數的空頭期貨部位（即賣出期貨），該指數每天動態調整，旨在複製納斯達克 100 指數每月滾動看跌期權的效果，並提供針對損失的下行保護。該基金可以直接投資於 Nasdaq-100 指數的任何組成部分，也可以投資於追蹤 Nasdaq-100 指數的交易所交易基金（「ETF」）。

info.description: iShares ESG MSCI EM Leaders ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI EM Extended ESG Leaders 5% Issuer Capped Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of emerging market companies with favorable environmental, social and governance ("ESG") characteristics.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG MSCI EM Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI EM Extended ESG Leaders 5% 發行人上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。基礎指數是自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）特徵的新興市場公司的股票表現。

info.description: CO2 Energy Transition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, and similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. It focuses on the carbon capture, utilization, and storage industries. The company was founded on September 30, 2021 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: CO2 Energy Transition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，從事與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組和類似業務合併。它專注於碳捕獲、利用和儲存產業。該公司成立於2021年9月30日，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: Capital One Financial Corp. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of financial products and services. It operates through the following segments: Credit Card, Consumer Banking, and Commercial Banking. The Credit Card segment includes domestic consumer and small business card lending, and international card lending businesses. The Consumer Banking segment consists of branch-based lending and deposit gathering activities for consumers and small businesses. The Commercial Banking segment includes lending, deposit gathering and treasury management services to commercial real estate and commercial and industrial customers. The company was founded by Richard D. Fairbank on July 21, 1994 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.description_zh: 第一資本金融公司是一家金融控股公司，從事提供金融產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：信用卡部門、消費者銀行部門和商業銀行部門。信用卡部門包括國內消費者和小型企業卡貸款以及國際卡貸款業務。消費者銀行業務部門包括面向消費者和小型企業的分行貸款和存款收集活動。商業銀行部門包括向商業房地產以及商業和工業客戶提供貸款、存款和資金管理服務。該公司由 Richard D. Fairbank 於 1994 年 7 月 21 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: JPMorgan Nasdaq Hedged Equity Laddered Overlay ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The manager seeks to provide capital appreciation through participation in the broad equity markets while hedging overall market exposure relative to traditional long-only equity strategies. The manager seeks to provide capital appreciation through participation in the broad equity markets while hedging overall market exposure relative to traditional long-only equity strategies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通納斯達克對沖股票階梯疊加 ETF 旨在提供資本增值。管理人尋求透過參與廣泛的股票市場來提供資本增值，同時對沖相對於傳統多頭股票策略的整體市場風險。管理人尋求透過參與廣泛的股票市場來提供資本增值，同時對沖相對於傳統多頭股票策略的整體市場風險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares MSCI ACWI ex U.S. ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI ACWI ex USA Index composed of large- and mid-capitalization non-U.S. equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to measure the combined equity market performance of developed and emerging markets countries, excluding the United States.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI ACWI（美國除外）ETF 旨在追蹤由大中型非美國股票組成的 MSCI ACWI（美國除外）指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量已開發市場和新興市場國家（不包括美國）的綜合股市表現。

info.description: REX Crypto Equity Premium Income ETF seeks capital appreciation and current income. The fund, under normal market conditions, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of companies comprising the BITA Crypto Assets & Digital Payments Index. The index is a rules-based composite index that tracks the market performance of 25 companies, listed on regulated exchanges based in the U.S., that are actively engaged in crypto-related activities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: REX 加密股票溢價收入 ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於包含 BITA 加密資產和數位支付指數的公司的股本證券。該指數是一個基於規則的綜合指數，追蹤 25 家在美國受監管交易所上市、積極從事加密貨幣相關活動的公司的市場表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares International Country Rotation Active ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests in securities to provide dynamic exposure to developed and emerging markets countries. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities of issuers economically tied to countries other than the United States and derivatives that provide investment exposure to such securities or to one or more market risk factors associated with such securities.
info.description_zh: iShares International Country Rotation Active ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金投資於證券，為已開發和新興市場國家提供動態投資。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於與美國以外國家有經濟聯繫的發行人的證券以及提供此類證券投資風險或與此類證券相關的一項或多項市場風險因素的衍生品。

info.description: ClearThink 1 Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company incorporated for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on September 11, 2025 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: ClearThink 1 Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其註冊目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 9 月 11 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: FG Merger II Corp. is a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 20, 2023 and is headquartered in Itasca, IL.
info.description_zh: FG Merger II Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於 2023 年 9 月 20 日，總部位於伊利諾伊州艾塔斯卡。

info.description: ChipMOS Technologies, Inc. provides total semiconductor testing and packaging solutions to fabless companies, integrated device manufacturers (IDM) and foundries. It operates through the segment Testing, Assembly, Crystal Display and other Flat-Panel Display Driver Semiconductors (LCDD), Bumping, and Others. The company was founded on July 28, 1997 and is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: ChipMOS Technologies, Inc. 為無晶圓廠公司、整合元件製造商 (IDM) 和代工廠提供全面的半導體測試和封裝解決方案。該公司透過測試、組裝、晶體顯示器和其他平板顯示器驅動器半導體 (LCDD)、凸點等部門進行營運。公司成立於1997年7月28日，總部位於台灣新竹。

info.description: Launchpad Cadenza Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or other similar business combination, involving one or more businesses or assets. The company was founded on June 27, 2025 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Launchpad Cadenza Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是實現涉及一項或多項業務或資產的合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或其他類似業務合併。该公司成立于2025年6月27日，总部位于加利福尼亚州奥克兰。

info.description: Mesoblast Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the research, development, and market of mesenchymal lineage adult stem cell technology platform. Its medicines target cardiovascular diseases, spine orthopedic disorders, oncology and hematology, immune-mediated, and inflammatory diseases. The company was founded by Silviu Itescu on June 8, 2004 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
info.description_zh: Mesoblast Ltd.是一家生物製藥公司，從事間質成體幹細胞技術平台的研發和銷售。其藥物針對心血管疾病、脊椎骨科疾病、腫瘤學和血液學、免疫介導疾病和發炎性疾病。該公司由Silviu Itescu於2004年6月8日創立，總部位於澳洲墨爾本。

info.description: RF Acquisition Corp. II operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on February 5, 2024, and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: RF Acquisition Corp. II 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年2月5日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: JPMorgan Nasdaq Equity Premium Yield ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified strategy designed to deliver consistent monthly income and total return by combining a long equity portfolio of Nasdaq-listed stocks with a proprietary options overlay. The fund utilizes a data science-driven investment approach to construct its equity holdings while selling call option spreads to generate premiums, aiming to provide a significant portion of the Nasdaq 100 Index's returns with lower overall volatility.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通納斯達克股票溢價收益 ETF 是一種主動管理的非多元化策略，旨在透過將納斯達克上市股票的長期股票投資組合與專有選擇權疊加相結合，提供穩定的每月收入和總回報。該基金利用數據科學驅動的投資方法來建立其股票持有量，同時出售看漲期權價差以產生溢價，旨在以較低的整體波動性提供納斯達克100指數回報的很大一部分。

info.description: Solarius Capital Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. The company was founded on April 1, 2025 and is headquartered in Darien, CT.
info.description_zh: Solarius Capital Acquisition Corp. 以空白支票公司營運。該公司成立於2025年4月1日，總部位於康乃狄克州達里恩。

info.description: 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals, Inc. develops medicines for the treatment and prevention of infectious diseases. Its product Arakoda helps in the prevention of malaria. The company was founded by Geoffrey Dow on September 9, 2010 and is headquartered in Washington, DC.
info.description_zh: 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 開發用於治療和預防傳染病的藥物。其產品 Arakoda 有助於預防瘧疾。該公司由 Geoffrey Dow 於 2010 年 9 月 9 日創立，總部位於華盛頓特區。

info.description: iShares MSCI China Multisector Tech ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI China Technology Sub-Industries Select Capped Index composed of Chinese equities in technology and technology-related industries. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 中國多板塊科技 ETF 旨在追蹤由中國科技及科技相關產業股票組成的 MSCI 中國科技次產業精選上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。它是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares Autocallable TSLA ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified fund that aims to generate current monthly income and provide limited downside protection by investing in a laddered portfolio of autocallable derivative instruments linked to the common stock of Tesla, Inc. (TSLA). The fund utilizes structured "autocallable" options that pay contingent coupons and include an automatic early redemption feature if the underlying asset's price meets or exceeds predefined barrier levels on specific observation dates.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares Autocallable TSLA ETF 是一檔主動管理的非多元化基金，旨在透過投資於與 Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) 普通股掛鉤的可自動贖回衍生性工具階梯投資組合，產生當前月收入並提供有限的下行保護。該基金利用結構化的「可自動贖回」選擇權，支付或有息票，並包括如果標的資產的價格在特定觀察日期達到或超過預定障礙水平時自動提前贖回的功能。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSLA ETF seeks current income; the secondary investment objective being exposure to the performance of one or more exchange-traded funds whose shares trade on a U.S.-regulated securities exchange and that seek daily leverage investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage of the common stock of Tesla Inc. subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the underlying TSLA ETF as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSLA ETF 尋求當前收益；次要投資目標是接觸一隻或多只交易所交易基金的業績，這些基金的股票在美國監管的證券交易所進行交易，並尋求每日槓桿投資結果為特斯拉公司普通股每日百分比的 2 倍 (200%)，但受到潛在投資收益的限制。該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於以標的TSLA ETF作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X S&P Catholic Values Developed ex-U.S. ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the S&P Developed ex-U.S. Catholic Values Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets, plus borrowings for investments purposes (if any), in the securities of the underlying index and in ADRs and GDRs based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to developed market equity securities outside the U.S. while maintaining alignment with the moral and social teachings of the Catholic Church. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 标准普尔天主教价值观在美国以外地区发展ETF 力求提供与美国以外标准普尔开发公司未计费用和开支前的价格和收益率表现大致相符的投资结果。天主教價值觀指數。该基金将其总资产的至少 80% 加上用于投资目的的借款（如有）投资于基础指数的证券以及基于基础指数中的证券的 ADR 和 GDR。基礎指數旨在提供美國境外已開發市場股票證券的曝險，同時與天主教會的道德和社會教義保持一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VII operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 27, 2024 and is headquartered in Zephyr Cave, NV.
info.description_zh: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VII 作為一家空白支票公司營運。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2024 年 9 月 27 日，總部位於內華達州 Zephyr Cave。

info.description: First Trust Emerging Markets Equity Select ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq Riskalyze Emerging Markets TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select low volatility securities issued by companies operating in emerging market countries.
info.description_zh: First Trust Emerging Markets Equity Select ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 Nasdaq Riskalyze Emerging Markets TM Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在選擇在新興市場國家營運的公司發行的低波動性證券。

info.description: AB Conservative Buffer ETF seeks a conservative level of capital appreciation while providing the potential for some downside protection against market declines. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal conditions, substantially all of its assets in a combination of exchange-traded options contracts on an underlying ETF. The underlying ETF (initially expected to be the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust) is an ETF that seeks to track the investment results of the S&P 500 Index, which measures the performance of the large-capitalization sector of the U.S. equity market, as determined by S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AB 保守緩衝 ETF 尋求保守的資本增值水平，同時提供一些針對市場下跌的下行保護潛力。該基金尋求透過在正常情況下將其大部分資產投資於標的 ETF 的交易所交易選擇權合約組合來實現其投資目標。標的 ETF（最初預計為 SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust）是一款旨在追蹤 S&P 500 指數投資結果的 ETF，該指數由 S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC 確定，衡量美國股市大盤股的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: K&F Growth Acquisition Corp. II operates as a blank check company. The company was founded by Edward King and Dan Fetters on July 2, 2024 and is headquartered in Manhattan Beach, CA.
info.description_zh: K&F Growth Acquisition Corp. II 以空白支票公司經營。該公司由 Edward King 和 Dan Fetters 於 2024 年 7 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州曼哈頓海灘。

info.description: Thornburg Focus Growth Fund is an actively managed U.S. equity strategy that targets long-term capital appreciation by investing in a concentrated yet diversified portfolio of 40-60 high-quality businesses identified through rigorous bottom-up fundamental research. The fund utilizes a unique three-basket portfolio construction to balance exposures across the growth spectrum, primarily targeting mid-to-large-capitalization U.S. companies that possess sustainable competitive advantages and trade below their estimated long-term intrinsic value.
info.description_zh: Thornburg Focus Growth Fund 是一項積極管理的美國股票策略，透過投資於透過嚴格的自下而上的基礎研究確定的 40-60 家優質企業的集中而多元化的投資組合，以實現長期資本增值。該基金利用獨特的三籃子投資組合結構來平衡整個成長範圍的風險敞口，主要針對擁有可持續競爭優勢且交易價格低於其估計長期內在價值的大中型美國公司。

info.description: Fidelity Disruptors ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests its assets in a combination of five Fidelity funds, each of which normally invests in equity securities of companies that represent a disruptive theme. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time.
info.description_zh: Fidelity Disruptors ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將其資產投資於五個富達基金的組合，每個基金通常投資於代表顛覆性主題的公司的股本證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。

info.description: Lazard Equity Megatrends ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The portfolio will seek to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in an actively managed portfolio of established, well managed companies located around the world, including emerging markets. Under normal circumstances, the portfolio invests at least 80% of its net assets in equity and equity-related securities (including common and preferred stock, warrants and rights, American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"), and Global Depositary Receipts). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Lazard Equity Megatrends ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該投資組合將透過主要投資於由位於世界各地（包括新興市場）的成熟、管理良好的公司組成的積極管理的投資組合來尋求實現其投資目標。正常情況下，投資組合至少80%的淨資產投資於股票和股票相關證券（包括普通股和優先股、認股權證和權利、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco QQQ Hedged Advantage ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The manager seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in a portfolio of U.S. equity securities that is intended to substantially replicate the performance of the Nasdaq-100 Index and utilizing an option overlay strategy designed to partially hedge the fund's downside exposure when equity markets decline. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco QQQ 對沖優勢 ETF 旨在提供資本增值。該管理人尋求透過主要投資於美國股票證券投資組合來實現其投資目標，該投資組合旨在大幅複製納斯達克 100 指數的表現，並利用旨在部分對沖股市下跌時基金下行風險的期權疊加策略。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Avos Global Equities ETF is an actively managed fund that targets long-term capital appreciation by investing in a diversified portfolio of global equity securities, including common and preferred stocks, depositary receipts, REITs, and underlying ETFs. The investment strategy utilizes a proprietary multi-step process that evaluates countries and companies based on long-term structural valuations and short-term market dynamics, ensuring exposure to at least three countries with a significant allocation to non-U.S. developed and emerging markets.
info.description_zh: Avos 全球股票 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，透過投資於全球股票證券的多元化投資組合（包括普通股和優先股、存託憑證、房地產投資信託基金和基礎 ETF）來實現長期資本增值。此投資策略採用專有的多步驟流程，根據長期結構性估值和短期市場動態對國家和公司進行評估，確保投資於至少三個國家，並在非美國已開發市場和新興市場上有大量配置。

info.description: iShares Disciplined Volatility Equity Active ETF seeks to provide risk-adjusted total return. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities. It seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in both equity and fixed-income securities, including money market securities and other short-term securities or instruments that the fund management team believes may offer attractive risk-adjusted returns. Equity securities include common stock, preferred stock, ADRs, or securities or other instruments whose price is linked to the value of common stock.
info.description_zh: iShares 紀律波動股票主動式 ETF 致力於提供風險調整後的總報酬。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於股本證券。它尋求透過投資股票和固定收益證券來實現其投資目標，包括貨幣市場證券和基金管理團隊認為可能提供有吸引力的風險調整回報的其他短期證券或工具。股本證券包括普通股、優先股、美國存託憑證或價格與普通股價值掛鉤的證券或其他工具。

info.description: STF Tactical Growth ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by allocating its investments among a combination of (i) U.S. equity securities or ETFs that, in the aggregate, seek to replicate the Nasdaq-100 Index (the "Index Allocation"), (ii) directly in, or in ETFs that hold, long-duration U.S. Treasury securities (the "Fixed Income Allocation"), and (iii) short-term U.S. Treasury bills, money market funds, and cash and/or cash equivalents (the "Cash Equivalents"). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: STF Tactical Growth ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金是一款主動管理型 ETF，旨在透過將其投資分配到以下組合中來實現其投資目標：(i) 總體而言旨在複製納斯達克 100 指數的美國股本證券或 ETF（「指數配置」），(ii) 直接投資或持有長期美國國債的 ETF（「固定收益配置」），以及 (iii) 短期貨幣基金等價物、現金、現金、現金、現金、現金等價物或現金（現金或現金基金等現金、現金或現金基金等現金（它是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Nasdaq Premium Income Active ETF seeks to provide current income with consideration for capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by employing a targeted outcome strategy that is intended to optimize, in the opinion of Fund management, premium income generation and the potential for capital appreciation. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market. Investments in derivatives are counted toward the fund's 80% policy to the extent that they provide investment exposure to the securities included within that policy or to one or more market risk factors associated with such securities.
info.description_zh: iShares Nasdaq Premium Income Active ETF 旨在提供當前收入，同時考慮資本增值。該基金尋求透過採用有針對性的結果策略來實現其投資目標，該策略旨在根據基金管理層的意見優化保費收入的產生和資本增值的潛力。該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於納斯達克股票市場上市的股票證券。衍生性商品投資計入基金的 80% 保單，只要它們提供對該保單中包含的證券或與此類證券相關的一個或多個市場風險因素的投資曝險。

info.description: Blackrock U.S. Industry Rotation ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to invest at least 80% of its net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in U.S.-listed equity securities and derivatives that have similar economic characteristics to such securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德美國產業輪動ETF尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金尋求將至少 80% 的淨資產加上用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於在美國上市的股本證券以及與此類證券具有類似經濟特徵的衍生品。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: MKAM ETF seeks to capture the majority of equity market returns, while exposing investors to less volatility and downside risk than other equity investments. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in U.S. equity securities that generally mimic the performance of the S&P 500 Index while attempting to reduce volatility and mitigate drawdowns. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: MKAM ETF 旨在獲取大部分股票市場回報，同時使投資者面臨比其他股票投資更少的波動性和下行風險。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資通常模仿標準普爾 500 指數表現的美國股票證券來實現其投資目標，同時試圖減少波動性和減少回撤。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco Global Water ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq OMX Global Water IndexSM (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index, as well as ADRs and GDRs that are based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index is comprised of securities of global exchange-listed companies located in the United States, as well as developed and emerging markets throughout the world, that create products designed to conserve and purify water for homes, businesses and industries. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Global Water ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 OMX 全球水指數 SM（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成基礎指數的證券，以及基於基礎指數中的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。基礎指數由位於美國以及世界各地已開發和新興市場的全球交易所上市公司的證券組成，這些公司生產旨在為家庭、企業和工業節約和淨化水的產品。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Marathon Bancorp, Inc. is a mutual bank holding company. It offers traditional, commercial, and mortgage banking services. The company was founded in December 2020 and is headquartered in Wausau, WI.
info.description_zh: Marathon Bancorp, Inc. 是一家互助銀行控股公司。它提供傳統、商業和抵押銀行服務。該公司成立於 2020 年 12 月，總部位於威斯康辛州沃索。

info.description: Global X Clean Water ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Global Clean Water Industry Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets, plus borrowings for investments purposes (if any), in the securities of the underlying index and in ADRs and GDRs based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to companies that have business operations in the provision of clean water. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X Clean Water ETF 力求提供與 Solactive 全球清潔水產業指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 加上用於投資目的的借款（如有）投資於基礎指數的證券以及基於基礎指數中的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。該指數旨在為從事清潔水供應業務的公司提供風險敞口。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Alpha Architect Value Momentum Trend ETF seeks long term capital appreciation while attempting to minimize market drawdowns. The fund is a "fund of funds," meaning that it primarily invests its assets in the shares of other ETFs, rather than in securities of individual companies. Its portfolio will be composed primarily of the other ETFs advised by the Adviser. Currently, there are four Alpha Architect ETFs, which invest in either domestic or international equity securities, and employ either a "momentum" or a "value" investment strategy.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect 價值動量趨勢 ETF 尋求長期資本增值，同時試圖盡量減少市場回檔。該基金是“基金中的基金”，這意味著它主要將其資產投資於其他 ETF 的股票，而不是個別公司的證券。其投資組合將主要由顧問建議的其他 ETF 組成。目前，Alpha Architect 有四種 ETF，投資於國內或國際股票證券，並採用「動量」或「價值」投資策略。

info.description: Goldman Sachs MSCI World Private Equity Return Tracker ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the MSCI World Private Equity Return Tracker Index (Net, USD, Unhedged). The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its total assets in securities included in its underlying index or in instruments with similar economic characteristics. The index seeks to approximate the returns of private equity investments by replicating region, sector and style exposures through publicly listed equities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 高盛 MSCI 世界私募股權回報追蹤 ETF 力求提供在費用和開支之前與 MSCI 世界私募股權回報追蹤指數（淨值、美元、未對沖）表現密切對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於其標的指數中包含的證券或具有類似經濟特徵的工具。該指數旨在透過公開上市股票複製地區、行業和風格的風險敞口來估算私募股權投資的回報率。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cantor Equity Partners VI, Inc. is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on April 30, 2021, and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Cantor Equity Partners VI, Inc. 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2021年4月30日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Cabana Target Drawdown 7 ETF seeks to provide long-term growth within a targeted risk parameter. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective with limited volatility and reduced correlation to the overall performance of the equity markets by allocating its assets among the following five major asset classes - equities, fixed income securities, real estate, currencies, and commodities. The Sub-Adviser's target drawdown for the fund is 7%; however, there can be no assurance, and the fund, the Adviser, and the Sub-Adviser do not represent or guarantee, that this target will be maintained.
info.description_zh: Cabana Target Drawdown 7 ETF 尋求在目標風險參數範圍內提供長期成長。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過將資產配置在以下五個主要資產類別（股票、固定收益證券、房地產、貨幣和大宗商品）之間，以有限的波動性並降低與股票市場整體表現的相關性來實現其投資目標。副顧問對該基金的目標提款是 7%；然而，不能保證，並且基金、顧問和副顧問也不聲明或保證這一目標將會得到維持。

info.description: Nomura Transformational Technologies ETF is an actively managed fund targeting capital growth by investing in global technology companies at the forefront of secular shifts and disruptive innovations. The strategy emphasizes a bottom-up stock selection process to identify businesses across any market capitalization that demonstrate high barriers to entry and the potential for rapid earnings growth relative to the broader economy.
info.description_zh: 野村轉型技術 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，透過投資處於長期變革和顛覆性創新前沿的全球科技公司來實現資本成長。該策略強調自下而上的選股流程，以識別任何市值的企業，這些企業表現出較高的進入障礙以及相對於更廣泛的經濟而言具有快速盈利增長潛力的企業。

info.description: Alphadroid Broad Markets Momentum ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the AlphaDroid EZ-MO Broad Markets Momentum Index ("Broad Markets Index" or the "Index"). The fund manager employs a "passive management" (or indexing) investment approach designed to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The fund invests in various types of U.S. publicly traded ETFs that comprise the index ("Underlying ETFs") and therefore operates as a "fund-of-funds." The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alphadroid Broad Markets Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 AlphaDroid EZ-MO Broad Markets Momentum Index（「Broad Markets Index」或「Index」）的總回報表現（扣除費用和開支）。基金經理人採用「被動管理」（或指數化）投資方法，旨在追蹤指數未計費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該基金投資於構成該指數的各種類型的美國公開交易 ETF（「基礎 ETF」），因此以「基金中的基金」的形式運作。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ARS Core Equity Portfolio ETF seeks to achieve long-term growth of capital and generate current income. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities or ETFs that provide exposure to equity securities. For purposes of the fund's 80% policy, the managers define equity securities as common stock or securities with similar characteristics, including American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ARS 核心股票投資組合 ETF 旨在實現資本的長期成長並產生當前收入。在正常情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於股本證券或提供股本證券敞口的ETF。就基金的 80% 政策而言，管理人將股本證券定義為普通股或具有類似特徵的證券，包括美國存託憑證（「ADR」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Enhanced Large Cap Core Active ETF seeks to outperform the Russell 1000 Index (the "Russell 1000 Index"). The fund is actively managed and seeks to pursue its investment objective while seeking to maintain a low tracking error to the Russell 1000 Index. The fund invests in a portfolio of large cap equity securities in a disciplined manner, using proprietary return forecast models that incorporate quantitative analysis. While the fund primarily invests in securities included in the Russell 1000 Index, the fund may also hold securities that are not included in the Russell 1000 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 增強型大盤核心主動 ETF 力求跑贏 Russell 1000 指數（「Russell 1000 指數」）。該基金採用積極管理方式，力求實現其投資目標，同時力求維持對羅素 1000 指數的低追蹤誤差。本基金採用結合定量分析的專有報酬預測模型，以嚴格的方式投資於大盤股證券投資組合。雖然該基金主要投資於羅素 1000 指數中包含的證券，但該基金也可能持有未包含在羅素 1000 指數中的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VictoryShares International Value Momentum ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Nasdaq Victory International Value Momentum Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index, depositary receipts on securities in the index and securities underlying depositary receipts in the index. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity market performance in non-U.S. developed markets and provide higher exposure to value and momentum factors within the parent index while also maintaining moderate Index turnover and lower realized volatility than traditional capitalization weighted indexes.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares 國際價值動量 ETF 力求提供在費用和支出之前與納斯達克勝利國際價值動量指數表現密切相關的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於指數中的證券、指數中證券的存託憑證以及指數中存託憑證的相關證券。該指數旨在提供對非美國已開發市場股票市場表現的曝險，並提供對母指數內更高的價值和動量因素的曝險，同時保持適度的指數換手率和比傳統資本加權指數更低的實際波動性。

info.description: Dakota Active Equity ETF seeks to achieve capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing directly or indirectly through other ETFs, in a portfolio of U.S. equity securities. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of U.S. companies or underlying ETFs that provide exposure to equity securities of U.S. companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Dakota Active Equity ETF 尋求實現資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過直接或透過其他 ETF 間接投資於美國股本證券投資組合來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款投資於美國公司的股本證券或提供美國公司股本證券敞口的基礎ETF。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco QQQ Equal Weight ETF is a non-diversified, index-based strategy that provides exposure to the 100 largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market using an equal-weighted methodology. The fund offers a balanced path to the Nasdaq-100 universe by assigning an initial 1% weight to each constituent, effectively mitigating the single-stock and mega-cap concentration risk inherent in market-capitalization-weighted strategies
info.description_zh: Invesco QQQ 等權重 ETF 是一種非多元化、基於指數的策略，採用等權重方法提供對納斯達克股票市場上市的 100 家最大非金融公司的投資。該基金為每個成分股分配初始 1% 的權重，為進入納斯達克 100 指數提供了一條平衡的路徑，有效降低了市值加權策略中固有的單股和大型股集中風險

info.description: Alpha Architect US Equity 2 ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in the equity securities of U.S. companies. The Sub-Adviser defines U.S. companies as companies whose securities are traded principally in the United States or that have their principal place of business in the United States. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect US Equity 2 ETF 尋求實現長期資本增值。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）將投資於美國公司的股本證券。副顧問將美國公司定義為證券主要在美國交易或主要營業地點在美國的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Tradr 2X Long Triple Q Quarterly ETF seeks calendar quarter investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (200%) the calendar quarter performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust. Under normal market circumstances, the fund will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide two times leveraged exposure to the calendar quarter performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tradr 2X Long Triple Q Quarterly ETF 尋求日曆季度投資結果（扣除費用和開支），相當於 Invesco QQQ Trust 日曆季度業績的兩倍 (200%)。在正常市場情況下，該基金將維持至少 80% 的金融工具敞口，這些金融工具為景順 QQQ 信託的日曆季度業績提供兩倍的槓桿敞口。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Alpha Architect US Equity ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in a diverse group of U.S. companies across market sectors, styles (e.g., value or growth), and industry groups or ETFs that provide similar exposure to U.S. companies. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in the equity securities of U.S. companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect 美國股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金主要投資於不同市場領域、風格（例如價值或成長）的美國公司，以及為美國公司提供類似曝險的產業集團或 ETF。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）將投資於美國公司的股本證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Tradr 2X Long Triple Q Monthly ETF seeks calendar month investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (200%) the calendar month performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust. Under normal market circumstances, the fund will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide two times leveraged exposure to the calendar month performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust. The fund will enter into one or more swaps with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return (or differentials in rates of return) earned or realized on the Invesco QQQ Trust. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tradr 2X Long Triple Q Monthly ETF 尋求不計費用和開支的日曆月投資結果，相當於 Invesco QQQ Trust 日曆月業績的兩倍 (200%)。在正常市場情況下，該基金將維持至少 80% 的金融工具敞口，這些金融工具為景順 QQQ 信託的日曆月表現提供兩倍的槓桿敞口。該基金將與全球主要金融機構進行一項或多項掉期，其中該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換在 Invesco QQQ Trust 上賺取或實現的回報（或回報率差異）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Switzerland AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Switzerland Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Switzerland Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Switzerland AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 瑞士指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，從納斯達克瑞士指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: VictoryShares Emerging Markets Value Momentum ETF seeks investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Nasdaq Victory Emerging Market Value Momentum Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index, depositary receipts on securities in the index and securities underlying depositary receipts in the index. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity market performance in the global emerging markets and provide higher exposure to value and momentum factors within the parent index while also maintaining moderate Index turnover and lower realized volatility than traditional capitalization weighted indexes.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares 新興市場價值動量 ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前與納斯達克勝利新興市場價值動量指數表現密切相關的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於指數中的證券、指數中證券的存託憑證以及指數中存託憑證的相關證券。該指數旨在提供對全球新興市場股票市場表現的曝險，並提供對母指數內更高的價值和動量因素的曝險，同時保持適度的指數換手率和比傳統資本加權指數更低的實際波動性。

info.description: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and Solana 75/25 Strategy ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 and S&P Solana 75/25 Blend Index. The index measures the weighted return performance of a multi-asset strategy that consists of a 75% weight in the S&P 500 Index and a 25% weight in the S&P Solana Index. The fund will invest approximately 75% of its assets in the stock of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and will invest in Solana so that the total value of the Solana to which the fund has economic exposure is approximately 25% of the assets of the fund.
info.description_zh: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 和 Solana 75/25 策略 ETF 力求在扣除費用和開支之前複製 S&P 500 和 S&P Solana 75/25 混合指數的總回報。該指數衡量多元資產策略的加權報酬表現，其中 S&P 500 指數權重為 75%，S&P Solana 指數權重為 25%。該基金將把約 75% 的資產投資於構成標準普爾 500 指數的美國大型公司的股票，並將投資於 Solana，以便該基金所涉經濟風險的 Solana 總價值約為該基金資產的 25%。

info.description: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and Bitcoin 75/25 Strategy ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 and S&P CME Bitcoin Futures Index 75/25 Blend Index. The index measures the weighted return performance of a multi-asset strategy that consists of a 75% weight in the S&P 500 Index and a 25% weight in the S&P CME Bitcoin Futures Index. The fund will invest approximately 75% of its assets in the stock of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and will invest in Bitcoin futures contracts so that the total value of the Bitcoin to which the fund has economic exposure is approximately 25% of the assets of the fund.
info.description_zh: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 和比特幣 75/25 策略 ETF 旨在複製 S&P 500 和 S&P CME 比特幣期貨指數 75/25 混合指數的總回報（扣除費用和開支）。該指數衡量多元資產策略的加權回報表現，其中標普 500 指數佔 75% 的權重，標普 CME 比特幣期貨指數佔 25% 的權重。該基金將把約75%的資產投資於構成標準普爾500指數的美國大型公司的股票，並將投資於比特幣期貨合約，以便該基金所擁有的經濟風險敞口的比特幣總價值約佔該基金資產的25%。

info.description: The BeeHive ETF seeks capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund primarily invests in equity securities of domestic companies with large and mid-sized market capitalizations. Equity securities in which the fund invests on a principal basis include common stock and sponsored and unsponsored American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"). The fund may also invest in foreign securities and equity securities of domestic companies with small market capitalizations.
info.description_zh: BeeHive ETF 尋求資本增值。在正常市場情況下，該基金主要投資於境內大中型市值公司的股票型證券。本基金主要投資的股本證券包括普通股以及保薦和非保薦美國存託憑證（「ADR」）。該基金亦可投資於外國證券及國內小市值公司的股本證券。

info.description: Value Line, Inc. engages in the provision of investment research. It produces investment periodicals based on underlying research and making available copyright data, including certain proprietary ranking system and other proprietary information, to third parties under written agreements for use in third-party managed and marketed investment products and for other purposes. The company was founded by Arnold Bernhard in 1931 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: Value Line, Inc. 從事提供投資研究。它根據基礎研究製作投資期刊，並根據書面協議向第三方提供版權數據，包括某些專有排名系統和其他專有信息，以用於第三方管理和營銷的投資產品以及其他目的。該公司由阿諾德伯恩哈德 (Arnold Bernhard) 於 1931 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Baron Financials ETF invests in equity securities (including depositary receipts) of Financials and Financials-related companies of any market capitalization as defined by BAMCO, Inc. ("BAMCO" or the "Adviser"). Financials and Financials related companies are companies that the Adviser determines own, operate, or have substantial investments in businesses that provide banking, lending, capital markets, financial data analytics, insurance, payments, asset management or wealth management; or develop, use, or rely on innovative technologies or services, in a significant way for banking, lending, capital markets, financial data analytics, insurance, payments, asset management or wealth management. The Fund may purchase securities of companies of any market capitalization and may invest in foreign stocks, including securities of companies in developing countries, however, investments in non-U.S. securities are limited to 35% of the Fund's total assets at the time of purchase.
info.description_zh: Baron Financials ETF 投資於 BAMCO, Inc.（「BAMCO」或「顧問」）定義的任何市值的金融和金融相關公司的股本證券（包括存託憑證）。金融和金融相關公司是指顧問確定擁有、經營或對提供銀行、貸款、資本市場、金融數據分析、保險、支付、資產管理或財富管理的業務進行大量投資的公司；或以重要方式開發、使用或依賴創新技術或服務，用於銀行、貸款、資本市場、金融數據分析、保險、支付、資產管理或財富管理。本基金可購買任何市值公司的證券，並可投資外國股票，包括發展中國家公司的證券，但對非美國證券的投資僅限於購買時基金總資產的 35%。

info.description: Thornburg American Opportunities Fund is an actively managed, high-conviction U.S. equity strategy that targets long-term capital appreciation by investing in a concentrated portfolio of 30-40 securities identified through fundamental, bottom-up research. The fund maintains a quality-biased valuation discipline, primarily selecting large-cap companies with durable business models and identifiable catalysts for value realization, while retaining the flexibility to invest across all market capitalizations and debt obligations.
info.description_zh: Thornburg American Opportunities Fund 是一項積極管理、高信念的美國股票策略，透過投資於透過基本面、自下而上的研究確定的 30-40 種證券的集中投資組合，以實現長期資本增值。該基金維持以品質為導向的估值原則，主要選擇具有持久商業模式和可識別的價值實現催化劑的大盤股公司，同時保留在所有市值和債務方面進行投資的靈活性。

info.description: Global X Disruptive Materials ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Disruptive Materials Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the index and in ADRs and GDRs based on the securities in the index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that produce metals and other raw or composite materials that have been identified as being essential to disruptive technologies such as lithium batteries, solar panels, wind turbines, fuel cells, robotics, and 3D printers. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 顛覆性材料 ETF 尋求與 Solactive 顛覆性材料指數的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於該指數的證券以及基於該指數的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。該指數旨在為那些生產金屬和其他原材料或複合材料的公司提供投資機會，這些材料被認為對鋰電池、太陽能電池板、風力渦輪機、燃料電池、機器人和 3D 列印機等顛覆性技術至關重要。它是非多元化的。

info.description: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and Ethereum 75/25 Strategy ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 and S&P Ether Futures 75/25 Blend Index. The index measures the weighted return performance of a multi-asset strategy that consists of a 75% weight in the S&P 500 Index and a 25% weight in the S&P Ether Futures Index. The fund will invest approximately 75% of its assets in the stock of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and will invest in Ether futures contracts so that the total value of the Ether to which the fund has economic exposure is approximately 25% of the assets of the fund.
info.description_zh: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 和以太坊 75/25 策略 ETF 力求在扣除費用和開支之前複製 S&P 500 和 S&P 以太期貨 75/25 混合指數的總回報。該指數衡量多元資產策略的加權回報表現，其中標普 500 指數權重為 75%，標普以太期貨指數權重為 25%。該基金將把約 75% 的資產投資於構成標準普爾 500 指數的美國大型公司的股票，並將投資於以太坊期貨合約，以便該基金所擁有的經濟風險敞口的以太幣總價值約佔該基金資產的 25%。

info.description: Magyar Bancorp, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It offers commercial and retail financial services, including the taking of time, savings and demand deposits, the making of commercial, consumer and home equity loans, and the provision of other financial services. The company was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in New Brunswick, NJ.
info.description_zh: Magyar Bancorp, Inc. 是一家銀行控股公司，提供金融服務。它提供商業和零售金融服務，包括提取時間、儲蓄和活期存款、發放商業、消費者和房屋淨值貸款，以及提供其他金融服務。該公司成立於 1922 年，總部位於新澤西州新不倫瑞克。

info.description: Defiance Gold Enhanced Options Income ETF seeks current income; secondary objective being exposure to the performance of SPDR Gold Shares subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks current income while maintaining the opportunity for indirect exposure to the share price of SPDR Gold Shares, subject to a limit on potential gains related to increases in the price of GLD's shares. While maintaining indirect exposure to the underlying ETP, the fund aims to generate additional income from its options investments when GLD's share price rises, based on the specific put options it sold. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Gold 增強型選擇權收益 ETF 尋求當前收益；次要目標是了解 SPDR 黃金股的表現，但潛在投資收益受到限制。該基金是一款主動管理的 ETF，尋求當前收入，同時保持間接接觸 SPDR Gold Shares 股價的機會，但受到與 GLD 股價上漲相關的潛在收益的限制。在保持對標的 ETP 的間接敞口的同時，該基金的目標是在 GLD 股價上漲時，根據其出售的具體看跌期權，從其期權投資中產生額外收入。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ-100 Ex-Technology Sector Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ-100 Ex-Tech Sector TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is an equal-weighted index composed of the securities comprising the NASDAQ-100 Index that are not classified as "technology" according to the Industry Classification Benchmark ("ICB") classification system.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ-100 Ex-Technology Sector Index Fund 尋求的投資結果通常與稱為 NASDAQ-100 Ex-Tech Sector TM Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數是一個等權重指數，由納斯達克 100 指數中根據行業分類基準（「ICB」）分類系統未歸類為「科技」的證券組成。

info.description: iShares Emerging Markets Infrastructure ETF seeks to track the investment results of the S&P Emerging Markets Infrastructure IndexTM, which is designed to track the performance of 30 of the largest publicly listed companies in the infrastructure industry in emerging markets. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents, as well as in securities not included in the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 新興市場基礎設施​​ ETF 旨在追蹤標普新興市場基礎設施​​指數™的投資結果，該指數旨在追蹤新興市場基礎設施​​產業 30 家最大的上市公司的表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於指數的組成證券以及具有與指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、期權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物以及未納入指數的證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Developed Markets ex-US Small Cap AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Developed Markets Ex-US Small Cap Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Developed Markets Ex-US Index that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 已開發市場（美國除外）小型股 AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 已開發市場（美國除外）小型股指數的股票指數的價格和收益率相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克發達市場（美國除外）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Canary Marinade Solana ETF is passively structured digital-asset trust that seeks to provide direct exposure to the price of Solana (SOL) held by the Trust while earning additional SOL via participation in Solana's proof-of-stake staking; the Fund holds SOL, is not registered under the Investment Company Act of 1940, and will not be actively managed to mitigate SOL price volatility.
info.description_zh: Canary Marinade Solana ETF 是被動結構的數位資產信託，旨在直接投資信託持有的 Solana (SOL) 價格，同時透過參與 Solana 的權益證明質押賺取額外的 SOL；該基金持有 SOL，未根據 1940 年《投資公司法》註冊，並且不會進行積極管理以減輕 SOL 價格波動。

info.description: BioNexus Gene Lab Corp. operates as a holding company, which engages in the sale of chemical raw materials for the manufacture of industrial, medical, appliance, aero, automotive, mechanical, and electronic industries. It is also involved in the development of liquid biopsy tests for the early detection of biomarkers that are linked to diseases. It operates through the BioNexus Malaysia and Chemrex segments. The company was founded by Liew Choong-Chin on May 12, 2017 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: BioNexus Gene Lab Corp. 作為一家控股公司經營，從事工業、醫療、家電、航空、汽車、機械和電子行業製造的化學原材料銷售。它還參與液體活檢測試的開發，以早期檢測與疾病相關的生物標記。它透過 BioNexus Malaysia 和 Chemrex 部門運作。該公司由Liew Choong-Chin於2017年5月12日創立，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: GSR Crypto Core3 ETF provides diversified exposure to a basket of major digital assets, specifically Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana, utilizing a proprietary dynamic allocation framework. The strategy combines direct holdings-facilitated via a subsidiary to enable staking capabilities on eligible assets-and indirect exposure through various exchange-traded products to capture potential price appreciation alongside staking yield.
info.description_zh: GSR Crypto Core3 ETF 利用專有的動態分配框架，提供對一籃子主要數位資產的多元化投資，特別是比特幣、以太坊和 Solana。該策略結合了直接持有（透過子公司促進對合格資產的質押能力）和透過各種交易所交易產品的間接敞口，以捕捉潛在的價格升值和質押收益。

info.description: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and XRP 75/25 Strategy ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 and S&P XRP 75/25 Blend Index. The index measures the weighted return performance of a multi-asset strategy that consists of a 75% weight in the S&P 500 Index and a 25% weight in the S&P XRP Index. The fund will invest approximately 75% of its assets in the stock of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and will invest in XRP so that the total value of the XRP to which the fund has economic exposure is approximately 25% of the assets of the fund.
info.description_zh: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 和 XRP 75/25 策略 ETF 力求在費用和支出之前複製 S&P 500 和 S&P XRP 75/25 混合指數的總回報。該指數衡量多元資產策略的加權報酬表現，其中 S&P 500 指數權重為 75%，S&P XRP 指數權重為 25%。该基金将把约 75% 的资产投资于构成标准普尔 500 指数的美国大型公司的股票，并将投资 XRP，以便该基金所拥有的经济风险敞口的 XRP 总价值约为该基金资产的 25%。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Ether ETF is an actively managed fund that employs a synthetic income-generation strategy by selling put options on leveraged exchange-traded funds linked to the daily performance of Ether. The fund seeks to achieve 200% of the income derived from standard option strategies on the reference asset while maintaining exposure to the underlying leveraged instrument, albeit constrained by a cap on potential capital appreciation.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST 以太 ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過出售與以太每日表現掛鉤的槓桿交易所交易基金看跌期權，採用合成創收策略。該基金力求實現參考資產標準選擇權策略所產生的 200% 的收入，同時保持對基礎槓桿工具的曝險，儘管受到潛在資本增值上限的限制。

info.description: Themes Gold Miners ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Global Pure Gold Miners Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that are active in the gold mining industry and is denominated in U.S. dollars. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the securities that comprise the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Gold Miners ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive Global Pure Gold Miners Index 扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數旨在為活躍於黃金開採行業的公司提供風險敞口，並以美元計價。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券以及基於該指數中的證券的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Builders FirstSource, Inc. engages in the supply and manufacture of building materials, manufactured components, and construction services to professional homebuilders, sub-contractors, remodelers, and consumers. Its products include factory-built roof and floor trusses, wall panels and stairs, vinyl windows, custom millwork and trim, and engineered wood. The company was founded by Kevin P. O'Meara, Donald F. McAleenan and John D. Roach in March 1998 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.description_zh: Builders FirstSource, Inc. 從事向專業住宅建築商、分包商、改造商和消費者供應和製造建築材料、製造組件和建築服務。其產品包括工廠製造的屋頂和地板桁架、牆板和樓梯、乙烯基窗戶、客製化木製品和裝飾以及工程木材。該公司由 Kevin P. O'Meara、Donald F. McAleenan 和 John D. Roach 於 1998 年 3 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

info.description: Sprott Active Gold & Silver Miners ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing 80% of its net assets in shares of gold and silver, focused companies that are engaged in exploring, developing and mining; or royalty and streaming companies engaged in the financing of gold and silver assets. The investment strategy of the fund is value oriented and contrarian. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Active Gold & Silver Miners ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金尋求透過將80%的淨資產投資於黃金和白銀的股票來實現其投資目標，重點關注從事勘探、開發和採礦的公司；或從事黃金和白銀資產融資的特許權使用費和串流媒體公司。該基金的投資策略為價值導向、逆向投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Themes Silver Miners ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the STOXX Global Silver Mining Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to global companies in the large-, mid- and small- capitalization segments that have significant exposure to the silver mining industry. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the securities that comprise the Index and in ADRs and GDRs based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Silver Miners ETF 旨在追蹤 STOXX 全球白銀礦業指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該指數旨在為全球大、中、小型資本市場公司提供投資機會，這些公司在銀礦開採行業擁有大量投資。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成指數的證券以及基於指數中的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Papa John's International, Inc. engages in the operation and franchise of pizza delivery and carryout restaurants. It operates through the following segments: Domestic Company-owned Restaurants, North America Franchising, North America Commissaries, International Operations, and All Others. The Domestic Company-Owned Restaurants segment consists of retail sales of pizza and side items, breadsticks, cheese sticks, chicken poppers and wings, dessert items, and canned and bottled beverages. The North America Franchising segment involves the offering of sales and support activities, development rights, and collection of royalties from franchisees located in the United States and Canada. The North America Commissaries segment includes the eleven full-service regional dough production and distribution and quality control centers. The International Operations segment represents all restaurant operations outside of the United States and Canada. The All Others segment focuses on franchise contributions to marketing funds and sale, company-owned and franchised restaurants, information systems and related services used in restaurant operations, point-of-sale system, online and other technology-based ordering platforms, printing, and promotional items. The company was founded by John H. Schnatter in 1984 and is headquartered in Louisville, KY.
